id: Choose your path.
en: Choose your path.
it: Scegli il tuo percorso.

id: \bMilo: Well then, shall we get this haystack rolling? This is gonna be a doozy!
en: \bMilo: Well then, shall we get this haystack rolling?  This is gonna be a doozy!
it: \bMilo: Bene allora, che ne dici di dare il via a questa mietitura?  Sarà una gran bella sfida!

id: \rNessa: No matter what kind of plan you may be plotting, my partner and I will be sure to sink it.
en: \rNessa: No matter what kind of plan you may be plotting, my partner and I will be sure to sink it.
it: \rAzzurra: Qualunque piano tu stia tramando, io e il mio partner faremo in modo di affondarlo.

id: \bKabu: In the end, the match will be decided by which side is able to unleash their true potential.
en: \bKabu: In the end, the match will be decided by which side is able to unleash their true potential.
it: \bKabu: Alla fine, l'incontro sarà deciso da chi riuscirà a liberare il proprio vero potenziale.

id: \rBea: I think I'll test that unshakable spirit of yours, shall I?
en: \rBea: I think I'll test that unshakable spirit of yours, shall I?
it: \rFabia: Credo che metterò alla prova quel tuo spirito incrollabile, che ne dici?

id: \bAllister: H...here...I go...
en: \bAllister: H...here...I go...
it: \bOnion: E...ecco...arrivo...

id: \rOpal: I'll keep an eye on you, child. Show me what you can do when you go all out.
en: \rOpal: I'll keep an eye on you, child. Show me what you can do when you go all out.
it: \rPoppy: Ti terrò d'occhio, piccolo. Mostrami cosa sai fare quando dai il massimo.

id: \bGordie: Size means strength! Savor this pain!
en: \bGordie: Size means strength! Savor this pain!
it: \bGordie: La stazza è forza! Assapora questo dolore!

id: \rMelony: All righty, I suppose we should get started. You won't be able to escape when I freeze you solid.
en: \rMelony: All righty, I suppose we should get started. You won't be able to escape when I freeze you solid.
it: \rMelony: Bene bene, direi di cominciare. Non potrai scappare quando ti avrò congelato da capo a piedi.

id: \bAvery: Prepare to experience psychic powers that defy human comprehension!
en: \bAvery: Prepare to experience psychic powers that defy human comprehension!
it: \bAvery: Preparati a provare poteri psichici che sfidano la comprensione umana!

id: \rKlara: You'll never know what hit you!
en: \rKlara: You'll never know what hit you!
it: \rKlara: Non capirai nemmeno cosa ti ha colpito!

id: \bPiers: Get ready for a mosh pit with me and my party! It's time to rock!
en: \bPiers: Get ready for a mosh pit with me and my party! It's time to rock!
it: \bGinepro: Preparati a pogare con me e la mia squadra! È ora di fare rock!

id: \bPeony: Brace yourself, I'm pretty ferocious in battle! Don't you fret!
en: \bPeony: Brace yourself, I'm pretty ferocious in battle! Don't you fret!
it: \bPeony: Tieniti forte, in lotta sono parecchio feroce! Ma non preoccuparti!

id: \bRaihan: Bring the storm! I, the Mighty Raihan, will send everyone flying!
en: \bRaihan: Bring the storm! I, the Mighty Raihan, will send everyone flying!
it: \bRaihan: Che arrivi la tempesta! Io, il Possente Raihan, farò volare via tutti!

id: \bMustard: Don't keep this old man waiting too long! Just say the word when you're ready!
en: \bMustard: Don't keep this old man waiting too long!  Just say the word when you're ready!
it: \bMustard: Non far aspettare troppo questo vecchietto!  Dimmelo quando sei pronto!

id: \bLeon: I can feel my partners itching with anticipation... We're gonna have an absolutely champion time!
en: \bLeon: I can feel my partners itching with anticipation... We're gonna have an absolutely champion time!
it: \bDandel: Sento i miei compagni fremere d'impazienza... Ci divertiremo da veri campioni!

id: \bHop: So let's show everyone the greatest battle ever!
en: \bHop: So let's show everyone the greatest battle ever!
it: \bHop: Allora mostriamo a tutti la lotta più grandiosa di sempre!

id: \bBede: I suppose I should prove beyond doubt just how pathetic you are and how strong I am.
en: \bBede: I suppose I should prove beyond doubt just how pathetic you are and how strong I am.
it: \bBeet: Immagino di dover dimostrare senza ombra di dubbio quanto tu sia patetico e quanto io sia forte.

id: \rMarnie: It'd be no fun if things ended quick... Got some fight in you? Wicked!
en: \rMarnie: It'd be no fun if things ended quick... Got some fight in you? Wicked!
it: \rMary: Non sarebbe divertente se finisse subito... Hai grinta da vendere? Forte!

id: \bVictor: My Pokémon are prepped and ready! Wanna give it a taste test?
en: \bVictor: My Pokémon are prepped and ready! Wanna give it a taste test?
it: \bVictor: I miei Pokémon sono pronti e carichi! Vuoi assaggiarli?

id: \rGloria: Ok, wait no further! All pumped up and ready to go!
en: \rGloria: Ok, wait no further! All pumped up and ready to go!
it: \rGloria: Ok, non aspettare oltre! Sono carica e pronta a partire!

id: \rMagnolia: So, \PN. Time to show me your true strength in the bonds of trust you have.
en: \rMagnolia: So, \PN. Time to show me your true strength in the bonds of trust you have.
it: \rMagnolia: Allora, \PN. È ora di mostrarmi la tua vera forza, nei legami di fiducia che hai creato.

id: \rSonia: Let's give it our all now!
en: \rSonia: Let's give it our all now!
it: \rSonia: Diamo il massimo!

id: \rOleana: Once I beat you to pieces, then Chairman Rose will be one step closer to his goal!
en: \rOleana: Once I beat you to pieces, then Chairman Rose will be one step closer to his goal!
it: \rOleana: Una volta che ti avrò fatto a pezzi, il Presidente Rose sarà un passo più vicino al suo obiettivo!

id: \bRose: I saw talent in you. You reminded me a little bit of myself, back when I was young. Show me your energy, required to keep this brilliant, glittering world alive!
en: \bRose: I saw talent in you. You reminded me a little bit of myself, back when I was young. Show me your energy, required to keep this brilliant, glittering world alive!
it: \bRose: Ho visto del talento in te. Mi hai ricordato un po' me stesso da giovane. Mostrami la tua energia, quella che serve a mantenere vivo questo mondo brillante e scintillante!

id: \rMai: So let's have a fun and intense battle that both our teams can really enjoy!
en: \rMai: So let's have a fun and intense battle that both our teams can really enjoy!
it: \rMai: Allora facciamo una lotta divertente e intensa che entrambe le nostre squadre possano godersi!

id: \bLian: I'm keen to advance further, so withdraw while you still can. Or face the wrath of my Pokemon!
en: \bLian: I'm keen to advance further, so withdraw while you still can. Or face the wrath of my Pokemon!
it: \bLian: Voglio andare avanti, quindi ritirati finché sei in tempo. O affronta l'ira dei miei Pokémon!

id: \rArezu: Real nice to meet you! Let's begin!
en: \rArezu: Real nice to meet you! Let's begin!
it: \rArezu: Piacere di conoscerti davvero! Cominciamo!

id: \rCalaba: Now let's not be distracted further.
en: \rCalaba: Now let's not be distracted further.
it: \rCalaba: Ora non distraiamoci oltre.

id: \bIscan: N-now, you insist... We can begin.
en: \bIscan: N-now, you insist... We can begin.
it: \bIscan: B-beh, se insisti... Possiamo cominciare.

id: \rPalina: Without any further, show me your team.
en: \rPalina: Without any further, show me your team.
it: \rPalina: Senza indugiare oltre, mostrami la tua squadra.

id: \bMelli: Accept your loss and out of my way!
en: \bMelli: Accept your loss and out of my way!
it: \bMelli: Accetta la sconfitta e levati di mezzo!

id: \bIngo: Perhaps a Pokémon battle with you would jog this memory loose... Would you honor me with a battle?
en: \bIngo: Perhaps a Pokémon battle with you would jog this memory loose... Would you honor me with a battle?
it: \bIngo: Forse una lotta Pokémon con te potrebbe risvegliare questo ricordo... Mi faresti l'onore di lottare con me?

id: \rSabi: Well, you'll get your rewards... if you can win me first!
en: \rSabi: Well, you'll get your rewards... if you can win me first!
it: \rSabi: Beh, avrai le tue ricompense... se riesci a battermi prima!

id: \bGaeric: If you hope to accomplish victory, then we must judge whether are you up to the task!
en: \bGaeric: If you hope to accomplish victory, then we must judge whether are you up to the task!
it: \bGaeric: Se speri di ottenere la vittoria, dobbiamo prima giudicare se sei all'altezza del compito!

id: \rCharm: I'm the eldest Fortune, and I'll be your unlucky Charm!
en: \rCharm: I'm the eldest Fortune, and I'll be your unlucky Charm!
it: \rCharm: Sono la maggiore delle Fortune, e sarò il tuo portafortuna... al contrario!

id: \rClover: I'm the middle Fortune, and I'm one Clover you can't pick!
en: \rClover: I'm the middle Fortune, and I'm one Clover you can't pick!
it: \rClover: Sono la mezzana delle Fortune, e sono un quadrifoglio che non potrai cogliere!

id: \rCoin: I'm the youngest Fortune, Coin, but I'm definitely not your good-luck piece.
en: \rCoin: I'm the youngest Fortune, Coin, but I'm definitely not your good-luck piece.
it: \rCoin: Sono la più giovane delle Fortune, Coin, ma di certo non sono la tua monetina fortunata.

id: \bBeni: You, the opponent worthy of my great ninja techniques that have been left to molder all these long years!
en: \bBeni: You, the opponent worthy of my great ninja techniques that have been left to molder all these long years!
it: \bBeni: Tu, l'avversario degno delle mie grandi tecniche ninja, lasciate ad ammuffire per tutti questi lunghi anni!

id: \rZisu: Show me what you can do. I will carefully observe your every moves!
en: \rZisu: Show me what you can do. I will carefully observe your every moves!
it: \rZisu: Mostrami cosa sai fare. Osserverò attentamente ogni tua mossa!

id: \bKamado: We will let fate decide what happens next! Whichever of us is stronger will prevail!
en: \bKamado: We will let fate decide what happens next! Whichever of us is stronger will prevail!
it: \bKamado: Lasceremo che sia il destino a decidere cosa accadrà! Il più forte di noi prevarrà!

id: \bAdaman: Oh. I'll cut the greetings! We don't have any more time to waste! Let's begin!
en: \bAdaman: Oh. I'll cut the greetings! We don't have any more time to waste! Let's begin!
it: \bAdaman: Oh. Saltiamo i saluti! Non abbiamo altro tempo da perdere! Cominciamo!

id: \rIrida: Let's compare what we know, whose's world is vast in comparison.
en: \rIrida: Let's compare what we know, whose's world is vast in comparison.
it: \rIrida: Confrontiamo ciò che sappiamo, e vediamo quale mondo è più vasto.

id: \rCyllene: You know what is expected of you. Now it is up to you to see things through.
en: \rCyllene: You know what is expected of you. Now it is up to you to see things through.
it: \rCyllene: Sai cosa ci si aspetta da te. Ora sta a te portare a termine il compito.

id: \bRei: Now it's time for our partners to shine.
en: \bRei: Now it's time for our partners to shine.
it: \bRei: Ora è il momento di far brillare i nostri compagni.

id: \rAkari: Here I go now! Get ready to face my full power!
en: \rAkari: Here I go now! Get ready to face my full power!
it: \rAkari: Eccomi! Preparati ad affrontare tutta la mia forza!

id: \bLaventon: Come now! What do you say? Shall we help one another out, for me to seek understanding of your Pokemon?
en: \bLaventon: Come now! What do you say? Shall we help one another out, for me to seek understanding of your Pokemon?
it: \bLaventon: Suvvia! Che ne dici? Ci aiutiamo a vicenda, così posso cercare di comprendere i tuoi Pokémon?

id: \rCogita: I will have to pardon this only time, to further strengthen your resolve. Let's battle.
en: \rCogita: I will have to pardon this only time, to further strengthen your resolve. Let's battle.
it: \rCogita: Per stavolta farò un'eccezione, per rafforzare ancora di più la tua determinazione. Lottiamo.

id: \bVolo: TO CREATE A BRAND NEW WORLD! Everyone will vanish, for the forging of a NEW BETTER WORLD!
en: \bVolo: TO CREATE A BRAND NEW WORLD! Everyone will vanish, for the forging of a NEW BETTER WORLD!
it: \bVolo: PER CREARE UN MONDO NUOVO DI ZECCA! Tutti svaniranno, per forgiare un NUOVO MONDO MIGLIORE!

id: \bMilo: Hmmm? Oh, you must be one of those challengers, right? My name's Milo.
en: \bMilo: Hmmm? Oh, you must be one of those challengers, right? My name's Milo.
it: \bMilo: Mmm? Oh, devi essere uno di quegli sfidanti, giusto? Mi chiamo Milo.

id: \bWe're gonna be as tough as weeds! But... that's not gonna keep you down! What a proper job!
en: \bWe're gonna be as tough as weeds! But... that's not gonna keep you down! What a proper job!
it: \bSaremo tenaci come le erbacce! Ma... questo non ti fermerà! Che bel lavoro!

id: \bWell then, shall we get this haystack rolling? This is gonna be a doozy!
en: \bWell then, shall we get this haystack rolling? This is gonna be a doozy!
it: \bBene allora, che ne dici di dare il via a questa mietitura? Sarà una gran bella sfida!

id: \bMilo: Battling with you seems to perk my Grass- type Pokémon right up! I hope that has been a fulfilling Pokémon battle for you too!
en: \bMilo: Battling with you seems to perk my Grass- type Pokémon right up! I hope that has been a fulfilling Pokémon battle for you too!
it: \bMilo: Lottare con te sembra aver rinvigorito i miei Pokémon di tipo Erba! Spero che sia stata una lotta Pokémon appagante anche per te!

id: \bWe'll be cheering you on from the bleachers!
en: \bWe'll be cheering you on from the bleachers!
it: \bTi faremo il tifo dagli spalti!

id: \rNessa: You're one of the ones endorsed by Hitsu, right? You've become something of a hot topic among us.
en: \rNessa: You're one of the ones endorsed by Hitsu, right? You've become something of a hot topic among us.
it: \rAzzurra: Sei uno di quelli raccomandati da Hitsu, giusto? Tra noi sei diventato un argomento caldo.

id: \rI think you've already realized, but I'm Nessa. I don't doubt that your mind as a Pokémon Trainer must be quite refined.
en: \rI think you've already realized, but I'm Nessa. I don't doubt that your mind as a Pokémon Trainer must be quite refined.
it: \rCredo che tu l'abbia già capito, ma io sono Azzurra. Non dubito che la tua mente di Allenatore di Pokémon sia piuttosto raffinata.

id: \rBut no matter what kind of plan you may be plotting, my partner and I will be sure to sink it.
en: \rBut no matter what kind of plan you may be plotting, my partner and I will be sure to sink it.
it: \rMa qualunque piano tu stia tramando, io e il mio partner faremo in modo di affondarlo.

id: \rNessa: Your teamwork was just flawless! It's enough to make me a bit jealous.
en: \rNessa: Your teamwork was just flawless! It's enough to make me a bit jealous.
it: \rAzzurra: Il tuo gioco di squadra è stato semplicemente impeccabile! Quasi quasi sono un po' gelosa.

id: \rRide that current all the way to the end! Give the crowd what they want!
en: \rRide that current all the way to the end! Give the crowd what they want!
it: \rCavalca quella corrente fino alla fine! Dai al pubblico ciò che vuole!

id: \bKabu: Every Trainer and Pokémon trains hard in pursuit of victory. But that means your opponent is also working hard to win.
en: \bKabu: Every Trainer and Pokémon trains hard in pursuit of victory. But that means your opponent is also working hard to win.
it: \bKabu: Ogni Allenatore e ogni Pokémon si allenano duramente per vincere. Ma questo significa che anche il tuo avversario si impegna per la vittoria.

id: \bI was training right up until the last moment so that I can guarantee you the best match when we face off!
en: \bI was training right up until the last moment so that I can guarantee you the best match when we face off!
it: \bMi sono allenato fino all'ultimo momento per garantirti il miglior incontro possibile quando ci affronteremo!

id: \bBut in the end, the match is decided by which side is able to unleash their true potential.
en: \bBut in the end, the match is decided by which side is able to unleash their true potential.
it: \bMa alla fine, l'incontro è deciso da chi riesce a liberare il proprio vero potenziale.

id: \bKabu: Clearly, your talent surpassed my many years of experience. I'm glad I could also feel my own growth.
en: \bKabu: Clearly, your talent surpassed my many years of experience. I'm glad I could also feel my own growth.
it: \bKabu: Chiaramente il tuo talento ha superato i miei tanti anni di esperienza. Sono contento di aver potuto sentire anche la mia crescita.

id: \bAnd I plan to keep growing and battling, until I become an old coot that nobody can beat!
en: \bAnd I plan to keep growing and battling, until I become an old coot that nobody can beat!
it: \bE ho intenzione di continuare a crescere e a lottare, finché non diventerò un vecchietto che nessuno riesce a battere!

id: \rBea: One has to be careful not to let a single victory lull oneself into complacency.
en: \rBea: One has to be careful not to let a single victory lull oneself into complacency.
it: \rFabia: Bisogna fare attenzione a non lasciare che una singola vittoria ci culli nell'autocompiacimento.

id: \rDo you also have an unshakable spirit that won't be moved, no matter what you face?
en: \rDo you also have an unshakable spirit that won't be moved, no matter what you face?
it: \rAnche tu hai uno spirito incrollabile che non si lascia scuotere, qualunque cosa tu debba affrontare?

id: \rI think I'll just test that out, shall I?
en: \rI think I'll just test that out, shall I?
it: \rCredo che lo metterò alla prova, che ne dici?

id: \rBea: Facing you gave me all the explanation I needed.
en: \rBea: Facing you gave me all the explanation I needed.
it: \rFabia: Affrontarti mi ha dato tutte le spiegazioni di cui avevo bisogno.

id: \rBea: It's good to be unshakable in the face of battle. But it's good to be moved by battle, as well.
en: \rBea: It's good to be unshakable in the face of battle.  But it's good to be moved by battle, as well.
it: \rFabia: È bene essere incrollabili di fronte alla lotta.  Ma è bene anche lasciarsi emozionare dalla lotta.

id: \bAllister: ......Oh. You.
en: \bAllister: ......Oh. You.
it: \bOnion: ......Oh. Tu.

id: \b...I'm Allister. ...You look well.
en: \b...I'm Allister. ...You look well.
it: \b...Sono Onion. ...Hai una bella cera.

id: \bH-here... I go...
en: \bH-here... I go...
it: \bE-ecco... arrivo...

id: \bAllister: ...That was ace. I will rem... ember you...
en: \bAllister: ...That was ace. I will rem... ember you...
it: \bOnion: ...È stato fantastico. Mi ricor... derò di te...

id: \bG-give it your best out there.
en: \bG-give it your best out there.
it: \bD-dai il massimo là fuori.

id: \rOpal: There you are, child. Though you are really lacking in the color pink, you seem like a fine candidate to be my successor.
en: \rOpal: There you are, child. Though you are really lacking in the color pink, you seem like a fine candidate to be my successor.
it: \rPoppy: Eccoti qua, piccolo. Anche se ti manca proprio il colore rosa, sembri un buon candidato come mio successore.

id: \rMy morning tea is finally kicking in, and I suppose it's a bit late to introduce myself, but... I'm Opal.
en: \rMy morning tea is finally kicking in, and I suppose it's a bit late to introduce myself, but... I'm Opal.
it: \rIl mio tè del mattino sta finalmente facendo effetto, e suppongo sia un po' tardi per presentarmi, ma... sono Poppy.

id: \rI'll keep an eye on you, child. Show me what you can do when you go all out.
en: \rI'll keep an eye on you, child. Show me what you can do when you go all out.
it: \rTi terrò d'occhio, piccolo. Mostrami cosa sai fare quando dai il massimo.

id: \rOpal: Still not what I'm looking for... Oh, don't worry yourself about it, child. It's just a matter of my preference.
en: \rOpal: Still not what I'm looking for... Oh, don't worry yourself about it, child. It's just a matter of my preference.
it: \rPoppy: Non è ancora quello che cerco... Oh, non preoccupartene, piccolo. È solo una questione di gusti miei.

id: \rIt's time for me to step out of the spotlight soon. For young, fresh talents to really shine.
en: \rIt's time for me to step out of the spotlight soon. For young, fresh talents to really shine.
it: \rPresto sarà ora che io esca dai riflettori. Perché i giovani talenti possano davvero brillare.

id: \bGordie: The name's Gordie. I admit I feel a little bad for doing this to you, but...
en: \bGordie: The name's Gordie. I admit I feel a little bad for doing this to you, but...
it: \bGordie: Mi chiamo Gordie. Ammetto che mi dispiace un po' farti questo, ma...

id: \bI'm going to use this match to show the crowd that my Pokémon are unbeatable!
en: \bI'm going to use this match to show the crowd that my Pokémon are unbeatable!
it: \bUserò questo incontro per mostrare al pubblico che i miei Pokémon sono imbattibili!

id: \bSize means strength! Savor this pain!
en: \bSize means strength! Savor this pain!
it: \bLa stazza è forza! Assapora questo dolore!

id: \bGordie: That was... impressive. Rules are rules. You get to move on.
en: \bGordie: That was... impressive. Rules are rules.  You get to move on.
it: \bGordie: È stato... notevole. Le regole sono regole.  Puoi andare avanti.

id: \bI pride myself on my solid Pokémon. I just need to train harder, that's all.
en: \bI pride myself on my solid Pokémon. I just need to train harder, that's all.
it: \bVado fiero dei miei Pokémon solidi come la roccia. Devo solo allenarmi di più, tutto qui.

id: \rMelony: I am Melony. Well, you'll find my battle style is quite severe.
en: \rMelony: I am Melony. Well, you'll find my battle style is quite severe.
it: \rMelony: Sono Melony. Beh, scoprirai che il mio stile di lotta è piuttosto severo.

id: \rIf You're not careful, I could sweep your feet right out from under you.
en: \rIf You're not careful, I could sweep your feet right out from under you.
it: \rSe non stai attento, potrei farti scivolare via il terreno da sotto i piedi.

id: \rAlrighty, I suppose we should get started. You won't be able to escape when I freeze you solid.
en: \rAlrighty, I suppose we should get started. You won't be able to escape when I freeze you solid.
it: \rBene bene, direi di cominciare. Non potrai scappare quando ti avrò congelato da capo a piedi.

id: \rMelony: Of course seeing my Pokémon lose is sad, but to meet someone so young with such ability is quite grand.
en: \rMelony: Of course seeing my Pokémon lose is sad, but to meet someone so young with such ability is quite grand.
it: \rMelony: Certo, vedere i miei Pokémon perdere è triste, ma incontrare qualcuno così giovane e con tanto talento è davvero splendido.

id: \rGive the next one a right thrashing, would you?
en: \rGive the next one a right thrashing, would you?
it: \rDai una bella batosta al prossimo, d'accordo?

id: \bAvery: Quite the commendable punctuality. My name is Avery.
en: \bAvery: Quite the commendable punctuality. My name is Avery.
it: \bAvery: Una puntualità davvero lodevole. Mi chiamo Avery.

id: \bI don't think you're quite up to snuff... And it's up to me, as an elegant adult, to make sure you get the message.
en: \bI don't think you're quite up to snuff... And it's up to me, as an elegant adult, to make sure you get the message.
it: \bNon credo che tu sia all'altezza... E spetta a me, da adulto elegante quale sono, fartelo capire.

id: \bPrepare to experience psychic powers that defy human comprehension!
en: \bPrepare to experience psychic powers that defy human comprehension!
it: \bPreparati a provare poteri psichici che sfidano la comprensione umana!

id: \bAvery: Improbable... No, impossible!
en: \bAvery: Improbable... No, impossible!
it: \bAvery: Improbabile... No, impossibile!

id: \bPerhaps I am just an average man who gave everything he possibly could...
en: \bPerhaps I am just an average man who gave everything he possibly could...
it: \bForse sono solo un uomo qualunque che ha dato tutto ciò che poteva...

id: \rKlara: Aha, there you are, right on time too! I'm the colorful, caring and charismatic Klara!
en: \rKlara: Aha, there you are, right on time too! I'm the colorful, caring and charismatic Klara!
it: \rKlara: Ah, eccoti qua, e pure puntuale! Io sono la colorata, premurosa e carismatica Klara!

id: \r......What's with the silence? Am I being mocked... by a kid?! Gosh, you're a pain in the neck...
en: \r......What's with the silence? Am I being mocked... by a kid?! Gosh, you're a pain in the neck...
it: \r......Cos'è questo silenzio? Mi stai prendendo in giro... un ragazzino?! Uffa, che rompiscatole che sei...

id: \rYou'll never know what hit you!
en: \rYou'll never know what hit you!
it: \rNon capirai nemmeno cosa ti ha colpito!

id: \rKlara: Huh?! No no no! NO no no! There must be some kind of mistake!
en: \rKlara: Huh?! No no no! NO no no! There must be some kind of mistake!
it: \rKlara: Eh?! No no no! NO no no! Dev'esserci un errore!

id: \rAaagh! Why can't I win?! All that effort, and nothing to show for it?!
en: \rAaagh! Why can't I win?! All that effort, and nothing to show for it?!
it: \rAaagh! Perché non riesco a vincere?! Tutto quell'impegno, e niente da mostrare?!

id: \bPiers: *sigh*... So you're finally here, huh? Reckoned nobody was comin' to challenge.
en: \bPiers: *sigh*... So you're finally here, huh?  Reckoned nobody was comin' to challenge.
it: \bPiers: *sigh*... Quindi alla fine sei arrivato, eh?  Pensavo che non sarebbe venuto nessuno a sfidarmi.

id: \bThe only thing a humble singer can do is sing a humble song. I still hope you enjoy the battle, though you know you'll lose!
en: \bThe only thing a humble singer can do is sing a humble song. I still hope you enjoy the battle, though you know you'll lose!
it: \bTutto ciò che un umile cantante può fare è cantare un'umile canzone. Spero comunque che la lotta ti piaccia, anche se sai già che perderai!

id: \bGet ready for a mosh pit with me and my party! It's time to rock!
en: \bGet ready for a mosh pit with me and my party! It's time to rock!
it: \bPreparati a un pogo scatenato con me e la mia squadra! È ora di fare rock!

id: \bPiers: Piers doesn't do encores, but I admit I'm tempted right now.
en: \bPiers: Piers doesn't do encores, but I admit I'm tempted right now.
it: \bPiers: Piers non concede bis, ma ammetto che stavolta sono tentato.

id: \bLet's meet up again for a battle some time!
en: \bLet's meet up again for a battle some time!
it: \bRivediamoci per un'altra lotta, prima o poi!

id: \bPeony: Gahahaha! Aren't you the brave one, pickin' a fight with me!
en: \bPeony: Gahahaha! Aren't you the brave one, pickin' a fight with me!
it: \bPeony: Gahahaha! Ma che coraggio, a mettersi contro di me!

id: \bCan't say I hate you buttin' in here... The name's Peony!
en: \bCan't say I hate you buttin' in here... The name's Peony!
it: \bNon posso dire che mi dispiaccia che tu sia piombato qui... Il nome è Peony!

id: \bBrace yourself, I'm pretty ferocious in battle! Don't you fret!
en: \bBrace yourself, I'm pretty ferocious in battle! Don't you fret!
it: \bPreparati, in lotta sono parecchio feroce! Ma non preoccuparti!

id: \bPeony: Gahahaaa! Look at me, takin' a thrashin' from a youngster like you!
en: \bPeony: Gahahaaa! Look at me, takin' a thrashin' from a youngster like you!
it: \bPeony: Gahahaaa! Guardami, a prenderle di santa ragione da un ragazzino come te!

id: \bThat was one ultra-mega-heated final battle! Hats off to you. In more ways than one!
en: \bThat was one ultra-mega-heated final battle! Hats off to you. In more ways than one!
it: \bÈ stata una lotta finale ultra-mega-infuocata! Giù il cappello. E non solo per modo di dire!

id: \bRaihan: Oh! If it isn't the Trainer endorsed by the Hitsu! Let's see... What was your name again?
en: \bRaihan: Oh! If it isn't the Trainer endorsed by the Hitsu! Let's see... What was your name again?
it: \bRaihan: Oh! Ma guarda, l'Allenatore raccomandato da Hitsu! Vediamo... Com'è che ti chiamavi?

id: \bAh, right! \PN! And if Hitsu himself recognized your potential... Then I guess you'll be quite the Trainer.
en: \bAh, right! \PN! And if Hitsu himself recognized your potential... Then I guess you'll be quite the Trainer.
it: \bAh, giusto! \PN! E se Hitsu in persona ha riconosciuto il tuo potenziale... Allora devi essere un Allenatore niente male.

id: \bBring the storm! I, the Mighty Raihan, will send everyone flying!
en: \bBring the storm! I, the Mighty Raihan, will send everyone flying!
it: \bScatenate la tempesta! Io, il grande Raihan, spazzerò via tutti!

id: \bRaihan: In the aftermath of that furious battle... I feel as pure and refreshed as when the sky clears after a storm.
en: \bRaihan: In the aftermath of that furious battle... I feel as pure and refreshed as when the sky clears after a storm.
it: \bRaihan: Dopo una lotta così furiosa... Mi sento puro e rinfrescato come il cielo che si rasserena dopo una tempesta.

id: \bI might have lost, but I still look good. Maybe I should snap a quick selfie...
en: \bI might have lost, but I still look good. Maybe I should snap a quick selfie...
it: \bAvrò anche perso, ma sono sempre bellissimo. Forse dovrei scattarmi un selfie al volo...

id: \bMustard: Why, hello there! I'm pleased as cheese that you could join me for a battle.
en: \bMustard: Why, hello there! I'm pleased as cheese that you could join me for a battle.
it: \bMustard: Ma bene, ciao! Sono felice come una pasqua che tu sia venuto a lottare con me.

id: \bYou seem to be the hardworking type too! My name's Mustard!
en: \bYou seem to be the hardworking type too! My name's Mustard!
it: \bAnche tu mi sembri un gran lavoratore! Il mio nome è Mustard!

id: \bDon't keep this old man waiting too long! Just say the word when you're ready!
en: \bDon't keep this old man waiting too long! Just say the word when you're ready!
it: \bNon far aspettare troppo questo vecchietto! Dimmi solo quando sei pronto!

id: \bMustard: Strength ebbs and flows in an endless cycle. One moment you grasp it, and the next, it slips from your hand.
en: \bMustard: Strength ebbs and flows in an endless cycle. One moment you grasp it, and the next, it slips from your hand.
it: \bMustard: La forza va e viene in un ciclo senza fine. Un attimo la stringi in pugno, e quello dopo ti scivola via dalle mani.

id: \bYou young folks grow so fast! It never ceases to amaze me. Congratulations, from the bottom of my heart!
en: \bYou young folks grow so fast! It never ceases to amaze me. Congratulations, from the bottom of my heart!
it: \bVoi giovani crescete così in fretta! Non smetterà mai di stupirmi. Congratulazioni, dal profondo del cuore!

id: \bLeon: It probably goes without saying, but... hello! I'm Galar's Champion, Leon!
en: \bLeon: It probably goes without saying, but... hello!  I'm Galar's Champion, Leon!
it: \bDandel: Forse non serve neanche dirlo, ma... ciao!  Sono il Campione di Galar, Dandel!

id: \bI love giving it everything I've got as a Trainer and seeing my team give everything they've got to seize another victory!
en: \bI love giving it everything I've got as a Trainer and seeing my team give everything they've got to seize another victory!
it: \bAdoro dare il massimo come Allenatore e vedere la mia squadra dare tutto ciò che ha per conquistare un'altra vittoria!

id: \bI can feel my partners itching with anticipation... We're gonna have an absolute Champion Time!
en: \bI can feel my partners itching with anticipation...  We're gonna have an absolute Champion Time!
it: \bSento i miei compagni fremere per l'attesa...  Sarà uno spettacolo da veri Campioni!

id: \bLeon: You've beat even the unbeatable Champion! I offer you my heartfelt congratulations!
en: \bLeon: You've beat even the unbeatable Champion! I offer you my heartfelt congratulations!
it: \bDandel: Hai battuto perfino il Campione imbattibile! Hai le mie più sincere congratulazioni!

id: \bI hope this isn't the last time I get to meet you in battle! Keep challenging me so that I can keep reaching ever greater heights!
en: \bI hope this isn't the last time I get to meet you in battle! Keep challenging me so that I can keep reaching ever greater heights!
it: \bSpero che questa non sia l'ultima volta che ci affrontiamo in lotta! Continua a sfidarmi, così potrò raggiungere vette sempre più alte!

id: \bHop: It's me, Hop! It's time for my new legend to begin here with my Pokémon!
en: \bHop: It's me, Hop! It's time for my new legend to begin here with my Pokémon!
it: \bHop: Sono io, Hop! È ora che la mia nuova leggenda cominci qui, insieme ai miei Pokémon!

id: \bMy goal's to take on my bro. But not just that, I want to beat him! I want to be the one who beats the unbeatable Champion!
en: \bMy goal's to take on my bro. But not just that, I want to beat him! I want to be the one who beats the unbeatable Champion!
it: \bIl mio obiettivo è affrontare mio fratello. Ma non solo: voglio batterlo! Voglio essere io a sconfiggere il Campione imbattibile!

id: \bSo let's show everyone the greatest battle ever, to be one step closer to Leon!
en: \bSo let's show everyone the greatest battle ever, to be one step closer to Leon!
it: \bQuindi facciamo vedere a tutti la lotta più grande di sempre, per avvicinarci di un altro passo a Dandel!

id: \bHop: That was a real nail-biter of a match! I'm happy for you!
en: \bHop: That was a real nail-biter of a match! I'm happy for you!
it: \bHop: È stata una sfida da mangiarsi le unghie! Sono contento per te!

id: \bI'm a bit disappointed in myself, but you won't get me so easily next time, mate!
en: \bI'm a bit disappointed in myself, but you won't get me so easily next time, mate!
it: \bSono un po' deluso da me stesso, ma la prossima volta non mi batterai così facilmente, amico!

id: \bBede: What a joke. It's positively criminal of you, wasting my time here. So why don't you walk out of here now?
en: \bBede: What a joke. It's positively criminal of you, wasting my time here. So why don't you walk out of here now?
it: \bBede: Che barzelletta. È davvero criminale da parte tua farmi perdere tempo qui. Perché non te ne vai subito?

id: \bYou're aware that I was chosen by Hitsu and Galar's Chairman himself, so that makes me more amazing than you!
en: \bYou're aware that I was chosen by Hitsu and Galar's Chairman himself, so that makes me more amazing than you!
it: \bSai bene che sono stato scelto da Hitsu e dal Presidente di Galar in persona, quindi sono molto più straordinario di te!

id: \bI suppose I should prove beyond doubt just how strong I am and how pathetic you are.
en: \bI suppose I should prove beyond doubt just how strong I am and how pathetic you are.
it: \bImmagino di dover dimostrare senza ombra di dubbio quanto sono forte io e quanto sei patetico tu.

id: \bBede: This isn't what I planned. If I was able to defeat you, then everything would've been fine...
en: \bBede: This isn't what I planned. If I was able to defeat you, then everything would've been fine...
it: \bBede: Non era questo il piano. Se fossi riuscito a sconfiggerti, sarebbe andato tutto bene...

id: \bNext time... I'll prove I'm a notch above the competition to everyone before me.
en: \bNext time... I'll prove I'm a notch above the competition to everyone before me.
it: \bLa prossima volta... dimostrerò a tutti quelli che ho davanti che sono una spanna sopra la concorrenza.

id: \rMarnie: Fancy seein' you again. I'm Marnie. Seems like I'm gonna have to watch out for you, huh?
en: \rMarnie: Fancy seein' you again. I'm Marnie. Seems like I'm gonna have to watch out for you, huh?
it: \rMary: Che sorpresa rivederti. Sono Mary. Sembra che dovrò stare attenta a te, eh?

id: \rWhat're you gawkin' at? It's exactly what you think. I'm goin' to be the one to win.
en: \rWhat're you gawkin' at? It's exactly what you think.  I'm goin' to be the one to win.
it: \rChe hai da fissare? È esattamente quello che pensi.  Sarò io a vincere.

id: \rIt'd be no fun if things ended just yet... Got some fight in you? Wicked!
en: \rIt'd be no fun if things ended just yet... Got some fight in you? Wicked!
it: \rNon sarebbe divertente se finisse tutto adesso... Hai ancora voglia di lottare? Grande!

id: \rMarnie: Ok, I got to see a lot of the good points of you and your Pokémon! Guess that's not so bad!
en: \rMarnie: Ok, I got to see a lot of the good points of you and your Pokémon! Guess that's not so bad!
it: \rMary: Ok, ho visto un sacco di pregi tuoi e dei tuoi Pokémon! Non è poi così male!

id: \rJust so y'know... I still haven't decided if I'm gonna cheer for you... See ya!
en: \rJust so y'know... I still haven't decided if I'm gonna cheer for you... See ya!
it: \rGiusto perché tu lo sappia... Non ho ancora deciso se farò il tifo per te... Ciao!

id: \bVictor: Victor here. I've just finished cooking something tasty back there... Would you like to have some later?
en: \bVictor: Victor here. I've just finished cooking something tasty back there... Would you like to have some later?
it: \bVictor: Sono Victor. Ho appena finito di cucinare qualcosa di buono là dietro... Ne vuoi un po' dopo?

id: \bNo? I'm pretty confident when it comes to cooking and Pokémon battles, y'know.
en: \bNo? I'm pretty confident when it comes to cooking and Pokémon battles, y'know.
it: \bNo? Guarda che sono piuttosto sicuro di me quando si tratta di cucina e di lotte Pokémon.

id: \bWanna have a taste test? My Pokémon are prepped and ready!
en: \bWanna have a taste test? My Pokémon are prepped and ready!
it: \bTi va un assaggio? I miei Pokémon sono pronti e ben conditi!

id: \bVictor: Thorough preparation is important for both cooking and Pokémon battles.
en: \bVictor: Thorough preparation is important for both cooking and Pokémon battles.
it: \bVictor: Una preparazione accurata è importante sia in cucina che nelle lotte Pokémon.

id: \bYour teamwork is just like a bowl of great curry! I gotta learn the secret to your recipe!
en: \bYour teamwork is just like a bowl of great curry! I gotta learn the secret to your recipe!
it: \bIl vostro gioco di squadra è proprio come un piatto di curry squisito! Devo scoprire il segreto della tua ricetta!

id: \rGloria: Pleased to meetcha! I'm Gloria! And everywhere is a great stage for adventure and battle!
en: \rGloria: Pleased to meetcha! I'm Gloria! And everywhere is a great stage for adventure and battle!
it: \rGloria: Piacere di conoscerti! Sono Gloria! E ogni luogo è un palcoscenico perfetto per avventure e lotte!

id: \rAnd all that got me more peckish than usual. I think I'll make some sandwiches after this! It'll really hit the spot!
en: \rAnd all that got me more peckish than usual. I think I'll make some sandwiches after this! It'll really hit the spot!
it: \rE tutto questo mi ha messo più fame del solito. Credo che dopo preparerò dei panini! Ci vorrebbero proprio!

id: \rOk, wait no further! I'm all pumped up and ready to go!
en: \rOk, wait no further! I'm all pumped up and ready to go!
it: \rOk, non aspettare oltre! Sono carichissima e pronta a partire!

id: \rGloria: Strength is hard to obtain, and even harder to keep! Or so they say...
en: \rGloria: Strength is hard to obtain, and even harder to keep! Or so they say...
it: \rGloria: La forza è difficile da ottenere, e ancora più difficile da mantenere! O almeno così dicono...

id: \rWith your performance, there's no doubt you'll be smashing all obstacles!
en: \rWith your performance, there's no doubt you'll be smashing all obstacles!
it: \rCon prestazioni come la tua, non c'è dubbio che abbatterai ogni ostacolo!

id: \rMagnolia: Oh goodness, dear me. I'm sorry. I didn't even notice my guest! My name is Magnolia. Welcome, young trainer!
en: \rMagnolia: Oh goodness, dear me. I'm sorry. I didn't even notice my guest! My name is Magnolia.  Welcome, young trainer!
it: \rMagnolia: Oh cielo, povera me. Scusami. Non mi ero nemmeno accorta del mio ospite! Mi chiamo Magnolia.  Benvenuto, giovane Allenatore!

id: \rAs you know, we Dynamax our Pokémon today using the energy from Wishing Stars that have fallen to us.
en: \rAs you know, we Dynamax our Pokémon today using the energy from Wishing Stars that have fallen to us.
it: \rCome sai, oggi facciamo dynamaxizzare i nostri Pokémon usando l'energia delle Stelle dei Desideri cadute fino a noi.

id: \rDynamaxing draws out the true strength from the trust between a Pokémon and their Trainer.
en: \rDynamaxing draws out the true strength from the trust between a Pokémon and their Trainer.
it: \rIl Dynamax fa emergere la vera forza nata dalla fiducia tra un Pokémon e il suo Allenatore.

id: \rSo, \PN. Time to show me your true strength in the bonds of trust you have.
en: \rSo, \PN. Time to show me your true strength in the bonds of trust you have.
it: \rDunque, \PN. È ora di mostrarmi la vera forza dei legami di fiducia che hai stretto.

id: \rMagnolia: You have certainly grown strong in the face of adversity, dearie. It's up to you to figure out what to do with it.
en: \rMagnolia: You have certainly grown strong in the face of adversity, dearie. It's up to you to figure out what to do with it.
it: \rMagnolia: Sei diventato davvero forte di fronte alle avversità, caro. Ora sta a te capire cosa farne.

id: \rThere are things that only young people like you can do, and there are other things that only you can do. Dream big.
en: \rThere are things that only young people like you can do, and there are other things that only you can do.  Dream big.
it: \rCi sono cose che solo i giovani come te possono fare, e altre che solo tu puoi fare.  Sogna in grande.

id: \rSonia: Name's Sonia. I'm the professor's assistant. I've been on a journey to solve the Galar region's biggest mysteries!
en: \rSonia: Name's Sonia. I'm the professor's assistant.  I've been on a journey to solve the Galar region's biggest mysteries!
it: \rSonia: Mi chiamo Sonia. Sono l'assistente della professoressa.  Sto viaggiando per risolvere i più grandi misteri della regione di Galar!

id: \rAh, here! It's a book I wrote! I even signed it - that makes it a collector's item. Don't want it? Okay.
en: \rAh, here! It's a book I wrote! I even signed it - that makes it a collector's item. Don't want it? Okay.
it: \rAh, ecco! È un libro che ho scritto io! L'ho anche autografato: così è un pezzo da collezione. Non lo vuoi? Va bene.

id: \rLet's give it our all now!
en: \rLet's give it our all now!
it: \rDiamo il massimo adesso!

id: \rSonia: Whoa, what's all this about all of a sudden? I've never seen anything like this before!
en: \rSonia: Whoa, what's all this about all of a sudden?  I've never seen anything like this before!
it: \rSonia: Wow, ma cos'è tutto questo all'improvviso?  Non ho mai visto niente del genere!

id: \rYour feat today is gonna be featured in my book!
en: \rYour feat today is gonna be featured in my book!
it: \rLa tua impresa di oggi finirà nel mio libro!

id: \rOleana: So, you got through all they have to stop you. I would expect nothing less of the Trainers handpicked by Hitsu himself.
en: \rOleana: So, you got through all they have to stop you. I would expect nothing less of the Trainers handpicked by Hitsu himself.
it: \rOleana: Dunque, hai superato tutti quelli che dovevano fermarti. Non mi aspettavo niente di meno dagli Allenatori scelti da Hitsu in persona.

id: \rBut I am afraid it is now time for you to go home. I'll treat you to something truly spectacular.
en: \rBut I am afraid it is now time for you to go home. I'll treat you to something truly spectacular.
it: \rMa temo che ora sia il momento di tornartene a casa. Ti offrirò qualcosa di davvero spettacolare.

id: \rOnce I beat you to pieces, Chairman Rose will be one step closer to his goal!
en: \rOnce I beat you to pieces, Chairman Rose will be one step closer to his goal!
it: \rUna volta che ti avrò fatto a pezzi, il Presidente Rose sarà un passo più vicino al suo obiettivo!

id: \rOleana: Arghhh! This is inexcusable... What was I thinking... Anyone who's made it this far would be no pushover...
en: \rOleana: Arghhh! This is inexcusable... What was I thinking... Anyone who's made it this far would be no pushover...
it: \rOleana: Arghhh! Questo è imperdonabile... Cosa mi è saltato in mente... Chiunque sia arrivato fin qui non poteva essere un avversario facile...

id: \rEverything I did, I did to further the chairman's own goals...
en: \rEverything I did, I did to further the chairman's own goals...
it: \rTutto ciò che ho fatto, l'ho fatto per realizzare gli obiettivi del Presidente...

id: \bRose: Ladies and gentlemen! To everyone watching from the lobby and from home, you have all been waiting for this big moment!
en: \bRose: Ladies and gentlemen! To everyone watching from the lobby and from home, you have all been waiting for this big moment!
it: \bRose: Signore e signori! A tutti voi che guardate dalla hall e da casa, avete atteso tutti questo grande momento!

id: \bBefore I get carried away, please allow me to introduce myself once again. My name is Rose, and it is a pleasure to be here.
en: \bBefore I get carried away, please allow me to introduce myself once again. My name is Rose, and it is a pleasure to be here.
it: \bPrima di lasciarmi trasportare, permettetemi di presentarmi ancora una volta. Mi chiamo Rose, ed è un piacere essere qui.

id: \bI saw talent in you. You reminded me a little bit of myself, back when I was young. Show me your energy, required to keep this brilliant, glittering world alive!
en: \bI saw talent in you. You reminded me a little bit of myself, back when I was young. Show me your energy, required to keep this brilliant, glittering world alive!
it: \bHo visto del talento in te. Mi hai ricordato un po' me stesso da giovane. Mostrami la tua energia, quella che serve a mantenere in vita questo mondo brillante e scintillante!

id: \bRose: Hmm, this isn't looking too good for me... Most impressive, \PN. I wouldn't expect any less from a challenger endorsed by Hitsu.
en: \bRose: Hmm, this isn't looking too good for me... Most impressive, \PN. I wouldn't expect any less from a challenger endorsed by Hitsu.
it: \bRose: Mmh, la situazione non si mette bene per me... Davvero notevole, \PN. Non mi aspettavo di meno da uno sfidante raccomandato da Hitsu.

id: \bIt's too bad, but it can't be helped... I do tend to ramble on, I know. I love to make speeches. But I think I can stop talking now.
en: \bIt's too bad, but it can't be helped... I do tend to ramble on, I know. I love to make speeches. But I think I can stop talking now.
it: \bPeccato, ma non c'è niente da fare... Lo so, tendo a dilungarmi. Adoro fare discorsi. Ma credo di poter smettere di parlare, ora.

id: \rMai: Trying to bring out the best in our partners is one thing we might have in common.
en: \rMai: Trying to bring out the best in our partners is one thing we might have in common.
it: \rMai: Cercare di tirare fuori il meglio dai nostri compagni è una cosa che forse abbiamo in comune.

id: \rDo you feel confident that you can lead your Pokémon in battle? Well, I guess such talk can wait.
en: \rDo you feel confident that you can lead your Pokémon in battle? Well, I guess such talk can wait.
it: \rTi senti sicuro di poter guidare i tuoi Pokémon in lotta? Beh, credo che questi discorsi possano aspettare.

id: \rSo let's have a fun and intense battle that both of our teams can really enjoy!
en: \rSo let's have a fun and intense battle that both of our teams can really enjoy!
it: \rQuindi facciamo una lotta divertente e intensa, che entrambe le nostre squadre possano davvero godersi!

id: \rMai: Through battling, I feel that I'm coming to a greater understanding both of you and of my own Pokémon.
en: \rMai: Through battling, I feel that I'm coming to a greater understanding both of you and of my own Pokémon.
it: \rMai: Lottando, sento di capire meglio sia te che i miei Pokémon.

id: \rI hope I can come to understand the feelings of wild Pokémon in this way too.
en: \rI hope I can come to understand the feelings of wild Pokémon in this way too.
it: \rSpero di riuscire a capire allo stesso modo anche i sentimenti dei Pokémon selvatici.

id: \bLian: I'm Lian. I've already deduced that you've come here well-prepared. Such an earnest desire.
en: \bLian: I'm Lian. I've already deduced that you've come here well-prepared. Such an earnest desire.
it: \bLian: Sono Lian. Ho già dedotto che sei venuto qui ben preparato. Che desiderio sincero.

id: \bBut I must turn you away, even if it pains me.
en: \bBut I must turn you away, even if it pains me.
it: \bMa devo respingerti, anche se mi addolora.

id: \bI'm keen to advance further, so withdraw while you still can. Or... face the wrath of my Pokemon!
en: \bI'm keen to advance further, so withdraw while you still can. Or... face the wrath of my Pokemon!
it: \bVoglio andare avanti, quindi ritirati finché puoi. Oppure... affronta l'ira dei miei Pokemon!

id: \bLian: I apologize for becoming briefly incomposed. I may've been defeated, but my passion still stands!
en: \bLian: I apologize for becoming briefly incomposed. I may've been defeated, but my passion still stands!
it: \bLian: Chiedo scusa per aver perso per un attimo la compostezza. Sarò anche stato sconfitto, ma la mia passione resta intatta!

id: \bAnd it seems we've settled things here. Don't get cold feet after me!
en: \bAnd it seems we've settled things here. Don't get cold feet after me!
it: \bE pare che qui abbiamo chiuso la questione. Non tirarti indietro dopo di me!

id: \rArezu: You've got quite the reputation, you know. I mean, your journey is one to reckon.
en: \rArezu: You've got quite the reputation, you know. I mean, your journey is one to reckon.
it: \rArezu: Sai, ti sei fatto proprio una bella reputazione. Voglio dire, il tuo viaggio è roba seria.

id: \rSome people are actually kinda scared of you for doing something so amazing.
en: \rSome people are actually kinda scared of you for doing something so amazing.
it: \rC'è chi ha persino un po' paura di te per aver fatto qualcosa di così incredibile.

id: \rI'm Arezu, by the way! Real nice to meet you! Let's begin!
en: \rI'm Arezu, by the way! Real nice to meet you! Let's begin!
it: \rA proposito, sono Arezu! Piacere di conoscerti! Cominciamo!

id: \rArezu: My luck's run out, though... as you can most likely tell.
en: \rArezu: My luck's run out, though... as you can most likely tell.
it: \rArezu: Però la mia fortuna è finita... come avrai sicuramente notato.

id: \rBut you're amazing, you know that? Your display of control was beautiful!
en: \rBut you're amazing, you know that? Your display of control was beautiful!
it: \rMa sei fantastico, lo sai? Il controllo che hai dimostrato è stato bellissimo!

id: \rCalaba: That's Warden Calaba to you. Ho? Now would you look at that... I've heard about you.
en: \rCalaba: That's Warden Calaba to you. Ho? Now would you look at that... I've heard about you.
it: \rCalaba: Per te sono la Guardiana Calaba. Oh? Ma guarda un po'... Ho sentito parlare di te.

id: \rThe chosen one? More like a whelp in my view. Waste no more of my time.
en: \rThe chosen one? More like a whelp in my view.  Waste no more of my time.
it: \rIl prescelto? Per me sei solo un pivello.  Non farmi perdere altro tempo.

id: \rNow let's not be distracted further.
en: \rNow let's not be distracted further.
it: \rOra non distraiamoci oltre.

id: \rCalaba: I owe you an apology. I treated you with disrespect, thinking you were just some whelp.
en: \rCalaba: I owe you an apology. I treated you with disrespect, thinking you were just some whelp.
it: \rCalaba: Ti devo delle scuse. Ti ho trattato con mancanza di rispetto, credendo che fossi solo un pivello.

id: \rI didn't even have the courtesy to listen to you. You'd think someone who's lived as long as I have would be more patient.
en: \rI didn't even have the courtesy to listen to you.  You'd think someone who's lived as long as I have would be more patient.
it: \rNon ho avuto nemmeno la cortesia di ascoltarti.  Si penserebbe che chi ha vissuto a lungo quanto me sia più paziente.

id: \bIscan: Give me a moment... So, um... I'm Iscan...
en: \bIscan: Give me a moment... So, um... I'm Iscan...
it: \bIscan: Dammi un attimo... Allora, ehm... Io sono Iscan...

id: \bWell, sudden visits give me quite a shock... I do hope you'll give me advance notice in the future.
en: \bWell, sudden visits give me quite a shock... I do hope you'll give me advance notice in the future.
it: \bBeh, le visite improvvise mi fanno prendere un bello spavento... Spero che in futuro mi avviserai prima.

id: \bN-now, if you insist... We can begin.
en: \bN-now, if you insist... We can begin.
it: \bB-beh, se insisti... Possiamo cominciare.

id: \bIscan: Your nerves aren't just steel... They're... titanium. It's positively frightening how, um, fearless you are.
en: \bIscan: Your nerves aren't just steel... They're...  titanium. It's positively frightening how, um, fearless you are.
it: \bIscan: I tuoi nervi non sono solo d'acciaio... Sono...  di titanio. È davvero spaventoso quanto tu sia, ehm, impavido.

id: \bI'll, um... I'll just take my leave here then.
en: \bI'll, um... I'll just take my leave here then.
it: \bIo, ehm... Io allora tolgo il disturbo.

id: \rPalina: You're that child who they speak of. Your strength must be amazing, and yet... you have such a gentle face.
en: \rPalina: You're that child who they speak of. Your strength must be amazing, and yet... you have such a gentle face.
it: \rPalina: Sei tu quel ragazzo di cui tutti parlano. La tua forza dev'essere incredibile, eppure... hai un viso così gentile.

id: \rI believe you have the potential to do great things. But let's not force that onto you.
en: \rI believe you have the potential to do great things.  But let's not force that onto you.
it: \rCredo che tu abbia il potenziale per fare grandi cose.  Ma non voglio metterti pressione.

id: \rWithout further ado, show me your team.
en: \rWithout further ado, show me your team.
it: \rSenza ulteriori indugi, mostrami la tua squadra.

id: \rPalina: That was a splendid match! I'm so proud of both you and your team.
en: \rPalina: That was a splendid match! I'm so proud of both you and your team.
it: \rPalina: È stata una lotta splendida! Sono così fiera sia di te che della tua squadra.

id: \rThank you, truly, for battling together with me. It means so much.
en: \rThank you, truly, for battling together with me. It means so much.
it: \rGrazie, davvero, per aver lottato insieme a me. Significa tantissimo.

id: \bMelli: Heh, it looks like even a slight breeze could topple you. Can you really defeat me?
en: \bMelli: Heh, it looks like even a slight breeze could topple you. Can you really defeat me?
it: \bMelli: Heh, sembra che basti un filo di vento per buttarti giù. Credi davvero di potermi battere?

id: \bStop trying to humiliate yourself. I can't be stopped by the likes of you!
en: \bStop trying to humiliate yourself. I can't be stopped by the likes of you!
it: \bSmettila di renderti ridicolo. Uno come te non può fermarmi!

id: \bAccept your loss and get out of my way!
en: \bAccept your loss and get out of my way!
it: \bAccetta la sconfitta e levati di mezzo!

id: \bMelli: Listen here! Neither I nor my Pokemon admit defeat just yet. That was a fluke!
en: \bMelli: Listen here! Neither I nor my Pokemon admit defeat just yet. That was a fluke!
it: \bMelli: Ascoltami bene! Né io né i miei Pokemon ci arrendiamo ancora. È stato un colpo di fortuna!

id: \bHowever! I will withdraw to allow them to recover. There's no shame in a tactical retreat. Keep your guard up!
en: \bHowever! I will withdraw to allow them to recover.  There's no shame in a tactical retreat. Keep your guard up!
it: \bTuttavia! Mi ritirerò per permettere loro di riprendersi.  Non c'è vergogna in una ritirata strategica. Stai in guardia!

id: \bIngo: Good day, good trainer. Pleased to properly meet you. Your presence... reminded me of... uhh.
en: \bIngo: Good day, good trainer. Pleased to properly meet you. Your presence... reminded me of... uhh.
it: \bIngo: Buongiorno, buon Allenatore. Lieto di conoscerti come si deve. La tua presenza... mi ha ricordato... ehm.

id: \bI recall faintly, that I had a partner once, who looked... like me. His name escapes me; all I could remember was my own name.
en: \bI recall faintly, that I had a partner once, who looked... like me. His name escapes me; all I could remember was my own name.
it: \bRicordo vagamente di aver avuto un compagno, un tempo, che mi somigliava... Il suo nome mi sfugge; ricordavo soltanto il mio.

id: \bPerhaps a Pokémon battle with you would jog this memory... Would you honor me with a battle?
en: \bPerhaps a Pokémon battle with you would jog this memory... Would you honor me with a battle?
it: \bForse una lotta Pokémon con te mi rinfrescherebbe la memoria... Mi faresti l'onore di lottare con me?

id: \bIngo: Sometimes I find myself saying things without knowing where the words come from... yet those words seem to fill me with power.
en: \bIngo: Sometimes I find myself saying things without knowing where the words come from... yet those words seem to fill me with power.
it: \bIngo: A volte mi ritrovo a dire cose senza sapere da dove vengano quelle parole... eppure sembrano riempirmi di forza.

id: \bAh, but now I've sidetracked us with this talk. Please convey my well wishes to your next challenger. Hurry onward!
en: \bAh, but now I've sidetracked us with this talk.  Please convey my well wishes to your next challenger. Hurry onward!
it: \bAh, ma ora ci ho fatto divagare con queste chiacchiere.  Ti prego, porgi i miei migliori auguri al tuo prossimo sfidante. Avanti, sbrigati!

id: \rSabi: My clairvoyance told me... You're super talented, right? I bet you're gonna be fun to play with!
en: \rSabi: My clairvoyance told me... You're super talented, right? I bet you're gonna be fun to play with!
it: \rSabi: La mia chiaroveggenza mi ha detto... Che hai un sacco di talento, vero? Scommetto che sarà divertente giocare con te!

id: \rI'm Sabi! I know why you're here too! To get to the end and get your rewards!
en: \rI'm Sabi! I know why you're here too! To get to the end and get your rewards!
it: \rIo sono Sabi! So anche perché sei qui! Per arrivare fino in fondo e ottenere le tue ricompense!

id: \rWell, you'll get it... if you can win against me first!
en: \rWell, you'll get it... if you can win against me first!
it: \rBeh, le avrai... se prima riuscirai a battermi!

id: \rSabi: Wow, you caught us AND you beat us. You've won my respect!
en: \rSabi: Wow, you caught us AND you beat us. You've won my respect!
it: \rSabi: Wow, ci hai beccati E ci hai battuti. Ti sei guadagnato il mio rispetto!

id: \rOooh, and one more thing: Am I even really clairvoyant? Am I really having fun, or am I bored? Hmm. No one but me could really know, right?
en: \rOooh, and one more thing: Am I even really clairvoyant? Am I really having fun, or am I bored?  Hmm. No one but me could really know, right?
it: \rOooh, e un'ultima cosa: sono davvero chiaroveggente? Mi sto davvero divertendo, o mi annoio?  Mmh. Nessuno a parte me potrebbe saperlo davvero, giusto?

id: \bGaeric: Let's begin with some proper introductions! I am Gaeric. And you must be \PN, right?
en: \bGaeric: Let's begin with some proper introductions!  I am Gaeric. And you must be \PN, right?
it: \bGaeric: Cominciamo con le dovute presentazioni!  Io sono Gaeric. E tu devi essere \PN, giusto?

id: \bOn what grounds do you come here seeking for the title of the best? What does your heart tell you to do?
en: \bOn what grounds do you come here seeking for the title of the best? What does your heart tell you to do?
it: \bCon quale diritto vieni qui a cercare il titolo di migliore? Cosa ti dice di fare il tuo cuore?

id: \bIf that is what you hope to accomplish, then we must judge whether are you up to the task!
en: \bIf that is what you hope to accomplish, then we must judge whether are you up to the task!
it: \bSe è questo ciò che speri di ottenere, allora dobbiamo giudicare se sei all'altezza del compito!

id: \bGaeric: I'm tough as an iceberg, but you smashed me through and through!
en: \bGaeric: I'm tough as an iceberg, but you smashed me through and through!
it: \bGaeric: Sono duro come un iceberg, ma tu mi hai frantumato da cima a fondo!

id: \bI suppose you can get on with it now. This one's alright!
en: \bI suppose you can get on with it now. This one's alright!
it: \bImmagino che ora tu possa proseguire. Questo qui è a posto!

id: \rCharm: Now who might you be? Not some stray traveler, from the looks of you.
en: \rCharm: Now who might you be? Not some stray traveler, from the looks of you.
it: \rCharm: E tu chi saresti? Non un viaggiatore qualunque, a giudicare dall'aspetto.

id: \rI bring good luck to my sisters wherever I go, and ill luck to anyone who crosses our paths.
en: \rI bring good luck to my sisters wherever I go, and ill luck to anyone who crosses our paths.
it: \rPorto fortuna alle mie sorelle ovunque vada, e sfortuna a chiunque incroci la nostra strada.

id: \rI'm the eldest, and I'll be your unlucky Charm!
en: \rI'm the eldest, and I'll be your unlucky Charm!
it: \rSono la maggiore, Charm, e sarò il tuo portasfortuna!

id: \rCharm: You're really going to insist on getting in the way, you little runt?
en: \rCharm: You're really going to insist on getting in the way, you little runt?
it: \rCharm: Hai davvero intenzione di continuare a metterti in mezzo, piccolo moccioso?

id: \rNow I know more about how you fight, and I won't hold back next time.
en: \rNow I know more about how you fight, and I won't hold back next time.
it: \rOra so meglio come combatti, e la prossima volta non mi tratterrò.

id: \rClover: Your luck's just run out. A vicious trap, laid out by yours truly.
en: \rClover: Your luck's just run out. A vicious trap, laid out by yours truly.
it: \rClover: La tua fortuna è appena finita. Una trappola crudele, preparata dalla sottoscritta.

id: \rThought you spotted a four-leaf clover? Well, I'll soon have you seeing double!
en: \rThought you spotted a four-leaf clover? Well, I'll soon have you seeing double!
it: \rPensavi di aver trovato un quadrifoglio? Beh, presto ci vedrai doppio!

id: \rI'm the middle sister, and I'm one Clover you can't pick!
en: \rI'm the middle sister, and I'm one Clover you can't pick!
it: \rSono la sorella di mezzo, Clover, e questo quadrifoglio non lo raccoglierai!

id: \rClover: This place... You gotta be kidding me! It wasn't a fair battle!
en: \rClover: This place... You gotta be kidding me! It wasn't a fair battle!
it: \rClover: Questo posto... Ma stai scherzando?! Non è stata una lotta leale!

id: \rWe were basically goin' easy on you! I'll make you regret that confidence next time!!!
en: \rWe were basically goin' easy on you! I'll make you regret that confidence next time!!!
it: \rTi stavamo praticamente trattando con i guanti! La prossima volta ti farò pentire di tutta questa sicurezza!!!

id: \rCoin: I should introduce myself properly... before I show you poor fool how wrong it was to assume that you could ever beat me.
en: \rCoin: I should introduce myself properly... before I show you poor fool how wrong it was to assume that you could ever beat me.
it: \rCoin: Dovrei presentarmi come si deve... prima di mostrarti, povero sciocco, quanto sbagliavi a credere di potermi battere.

id: \rHeads, I win, and tails, you lose. You've got no chance in this game of fortunes.
en: \rHeads, I win, and tails, you lose. You've got no chance in this game of fortunes.
it: \rTesta vinco io, croce perdi tu. Non hai nessuna possibilità in questo gioco della sorte.

id: \rI'm the youngest, Coin, but I'm definitely not your good-luck piece.
en: \rI'm the youngest, Coin, but I'm definitely not your good-luck piece.
it: \rSono la più giovane, Coin, ma di certo non sono la tua moneta portafortuna.

id: \rCoin: What a blithering mooncalf I am. I guess I lose the coin toss sometimes...
en: \rCoin: What a blithering mooncalf I am. I guess I lose the coin toss sometimes...
it: \rCoin: Che razza di babbea sono. Immagino che a volte il lancio della moneta vada male anche a me...

id: \rYou will pay for this embarrassment. I swear I will make you pay with interest!
en: \rYou will pay for this embarrassment. I swear I will make you pay with interest!
it: \rLa pagherai per quest'umiliazione. Giuro che te la farò pagare con gli interessi!

id: \bBeni: Lively and kicking, are you? Good to see that.
en: \bBeni: Lively and kicking, are you? Good to see that.
it: \bBeni: Vivo e vegeto, eh? Mi fa piacere vederlo.

id: \bI heard you managed to quell your foes one after another, oh, did it ever make my blood run hot and my heart pound... At last... at last...
en: \bI heard you managed to quell your foes one after another, oh, did it ever make my blood run hot and my heart pound... At last... at last...
it: \bHo sentito che hai sbaragliato i tuoi avversari uno dopo l'altro, oh, quanto mi ha fatto ribollire il sangue e battere il cuore... Finalmente... finalmente...

id: \bYou, the opponent worthy of my great ninja techniques that have been left to smolder for all these long years!
en: \bYou, the opponent worthy of my great ninja techniques that have been left to smolder for all these long years!
it: \bTu, l'avversario degno delle mie grandi tecniche ninja, rimaste a covare sotto la cenere per tutti questi lunghi anni!

id: \bBeni: It doesn't matter to me who wins and who loses. I'm here to show you how a ninja fights, the style of a dying breed!
en: \bBeni: It doesn't matter to me who wins and who loses. I'm here to show you how a ninja fights, the style of a dying breed!
it: \bBeni: Non m'importa chi vince e chi perde. Sono qui per mostrarti come combatte un ninja, lo stile di una stirpe in via d'estinzione!

id: \bAnyway, they say hunger is the best seasoning. I'm going off to eat my fill.
en: \bAnyway, they say hunger is the best seasoning.  I'm going off to eat my fill.
it: \bComunque, si dice che la fame sia il miglior condimento.  Vado a mangiare a sazietà.

id: \rZisu: The name's Zisu. Captain of the Security Corps. So you're the one that everyone's talking about?
en: \rZisu: The name's Zisu. Captain of the Security Corps. So you're the one that everyone's talking about?
it: \rZisu: Mi chiamo Zisu. Capitana della Squadra Sicurezza. Allora sei tu quello di cui parlano tutti?

id: \rI see you've got some fight in you. Figured I'd give what advice I could.
en: \rI see you've got some fight in you. Figured I'd give what advice I could.
it: \rVedo che hai grinta da vendere. Ho pensato di darti qualche consiglio, per quel che posso.

id: \rShow me what you can do. I'll carefully observe your every move!
en: \rShow me what you can do. I'll carefully observe your every move!
it: \rMostrami cosa sai fare. Osserverò attentamente ogni tua mossa!

id: \rZisu: Strong style, agile style... You know what is right for a given situation, and direct your Pokemon with a little nudge.
en: \rZisu: Strong style, agile style... You know what is right for a given situation, and direct your Pokemon with a little nudge.
it: \rZisu: Stile forte, stile rapido... Sai cosa è giusto in ogni situazione, e guidi i tuoi Pokemon con una piccola spinta.

id: \rYou are a true veteran in Pokemon battles. That's a lot coming from me!
en: \rYou are a true veteran in Pokemon battles. That's a lot coming from me!
it: \rSei un vero veterano delle lotte Pokemon. Detto da me, non è poco!

id: \bKamado: I have been waiting for you! I am Kamado, commander of the Galaxy Expedition Team!
en: \bKamado: I have been waiting for you! I am Kamado, commander of the Galaxy Expedition Team!
it: \bKamado: Ti stavo aspettando! Sono Kamado, comandante del Team Galassia!

id: \bHrrrm! You've got vigor, I'll give you that! You've come far enough to face me.
en: \bHrrrm! You've got vigor, I'll give you that! You've come far enough to face me.
it: \bHrrrm! Hai vigore, te lo concedo! Sei arrivato abbastanza lontano da affrontarmi.

id: \bLet fate decide what happens next! Whichever of us is stronger will prevail!
en: \bLet fate decide what happens next! Whichever of us is stronger will prevail!
it: \bChe sia il destino a decidere cosa accadrà! Chi di noi è più forte prevarrà!

id: \bKamado: You truly are a force to be reckoned with...
en: \bKamado: You truly are a force to be reckoned with...
it: \bKamado: Sei davvero una forza con cui fare i conti...

id: \bI'm grateful to you for showing me what a heartening presence Pokémon can be. We must spar again sometime!
en: \bI'm grateful to you for showing me what a heartening presence Pokémon can be. We must spar again sometime!
it: \bTi sono grato per avermi mostrato quanto possa essere confortante la presenza dei Pokémon. Dobbiamo sfidarci di nuovo, un giorno!

id: \bAdaman: Look who's being punctual! Good to finally meet you, stranger! I'm Adaman, leader of the Diamond Clan.
en: \bAdaman: Look who's being punctual! Good to finally meet you, stranger! I'm Adaman, leader of the Diamond Clan.
it: \bAdaman: Guarda chi è puntuale! Finalmente ci conosciamo, straniero! Sono Adaman, capo del Clan Diamante.

id: \bTime is all about change, and we can't live in fear of that. We can only try to change the time we live in for the better.
en: \bTime is all about change, and we can't live in fear of that. We can only try to change the time we live in for the better.
it: \bIl tempo è cambiamento, e non possiamo vivere nella paura di questo. Possiamo solo cercare di cambiare in meglio il tempo in cui viviamo.

id: \bOh, look at the time. I'll cut the greetings then! We don't have any more time to waste! Let's begin!
en: \bOh, look at the time. I'll cut the greetings then! We don't have any more time to waste! Let's begin!
it: \bOh, guarda che ore sono. Allora taglio corto con i saluti! Non abbiamo più tempo da perdere! Cominciamo!

id: \bAdaman: Well, you've done it! That was amazing! I'm still shaking, even now.
en: \bAdaman: Well, you've done it! That was amazing!  I'm still shaking, even now.
it: \bAdaman: Beh, ce l'hai fatta! È stato fantastico!  Sto ancora tremando, adesso.

id: \bNext time we'll come at you even harder and give you a battle you won't forget!
en: \bNext time we'll come at you even harder and give you a battle you won't forget!
it: \bLa prossima volta ti attaccheremo ancora più duramente e ti daremo una lotta che non dimenticherai!

id: \rIrida: This stage is just for the both of us. I'm Irida, leader of the Pearl Clan!
en: \rIrida: This stage is just for the both of us. I'm Irida, leader of the Pearl Clan!
it: \rIrida: Questo palcoscenico è solo per noi due. Sono Irida, capo del Clan Perla!

id: \rThe world before our eyes grows broader when we achieve true understanding with Pokémon.
en: \rThe world before our eyes grows broader when we achieve true understanding with Pokémon.
it: \rIl mondo davanti ai nostri occhi si allarga quando raggiungiamo una vera comprensione con i Pokémon.

id: \rLet's compare what we know to see whose world is vaster.
en: \rLet's compare what we know to see whose world is vaster.
it: \rConfrontiamo ciò che sappiamo per vedere quale mondo è più vasto.

id: \rIrida: Your sheer power, it's as unfathomably vast as space itself. I'm in awe before it.
en: \rIrida: Your sheer power, it's as unfathomably vast as space itself. I'm in awe before it.
it: \rIrida: La tua pura potenza è insondabile e vasta come lo spazio stesso. Ne sono ammirata.

id: \rI know I may never come to understand everything out there, but I'll keep my heart open to trying.
en: \rI know I may never come to understand everything out there, but I'll keep my heart open to trying.
it: \rSo che forse non arriverò mai a capire tutto ciò che c'è là fuori, ma continuerò a provarci con il cuore aperto.

id: \rCyllene: I am the captain of the Galaxy Team's Survey Corps. You may call me Cyllene.
en: \rCyllene: I am the captain of the Galaxy Team's Survey Corps. You may call me Cyllene.
it: \rCyllene: Sono la capitana della Squadra Ricerca del Team Galassia. Puoi chiamarmi Cyllene.

id: \rWe are here to prove our capability in taming and handling our Pokémon.
en: \rWe are here to prove our capability in taming and handling our Pokémon.
it: \rSiamo qui per dimostrare la nostra capacità nel domare e gestire i nostri Pokémon.

id: \rYou know what is expected of you. Now it is up to you to see things through.
en: \rYou know what is expected of you. Now it is up to you to see things through.
it: \rSai cosa ci si aspetta da te. Ora sta a te portare a termine il compito.

id: \rCyllene: I set a high hurdle to judge whether a stranger like yourself could be worthy, but you cleared it. You've passed your trial.
en: \rCyllene: I set a high hurdle to judge whether a stranger like yourself could be worthy, but you cleared it. You've passed your trial.
it: \rCyllene: Ho posto un ostacolo alto per giudicare se un forestiero come te potesse esserne degno, ma l'hai superato. Hai superato la prova.

id: \rBe proud. Present yourself orderly for whoever may come before you next.
en: \rBe proud. Present yourself orderly for whoever may come before you next.
it: \rSii fiero. Presentati in modo composto a chiunque ti si pari davanti.

id: \bRei: I'm Rei, a member of the Galaxy Team's Survey Corps!
en: \bRei: I'm Rei, a member of the Galaxy Team's Survey Corps!
it: \bRei: Sono Rei, un membro della Squadra Ricerca del Team Galassia!

id: \bI want to conduct survey work so I can reach a point where if I meet a Pokémon, we can understand each other, even without battling.
en: \bI want to conduct survey work so I can reach a point where if I meet a Pokémon, we can understand each other, even without battling.
it: \bVoglio fare ricerche sul campo per arrivare al punto in cui, se incontro un Pokémon, possiamo capirci a vicenda, anche senza lottare.

id: \bHow about you then? It's time for our partners to shine!
en: \bHow about you then? It's time for our partners to shine!
it: \bE tu, allora? È ora che i nostri compagni brillino!

id: \bRei: The way you fight alongside your Pokémon - you don't seem scared of battling one bit.
en: \bRei: The way you fight alongside your Pokémon - you don't seem scared of battling one bit.
it: \bRei: Il modo in cui combatti al fianco dei tuoi Pokémon... Non sembri avere la minima paura di lottare.

id: \bFair enough. We'll just have to catch up the best we can.
en: \bFair enough. We'll just have to catch up the best we can.
it: \bD'accordo. Dovremo solo recuperare il terreno come meglio possiamo.

id: \rAkari: Hi! I'm Akari, a member of the Galaxy Team's Survey Corps! Nice to meet you!
en: \rAkari: Hi! I'm Akari, a member of the Galaxy Team's Survey Corps! Nice to meet you!
it: \rAkari: Ciao! Sono Akari, un membro della Squadra Ricerca del Team Galassia! Piacere di conoscerti!

id: \rOur job as the Survey Corps is to research Pokémon and find out what kind of creatures they are!
en: \rOur job as the Survey Corps is to research Pokémon and find out what kind of creatures they are!
it: \rIl nostro compito come Squadra Ricerca è studiare i Pokémon e scoprire che tipo di creature siano!

id: \rHere I go now! Get ready to face my full power!
en: \rHere I go now! Get ready to face my full power!
it: \rEccomi! Preparati ad affrontare tutta la mia potenza!

id: \rAkari: I guess doing research tasks and learning is one thing, and using that knowledge well is another...
en: \rAkari: I guess doing research tasks and learning is one thing, and using that knowledge well is another...
it: \rAkari: Credo che svolgere ricerche e imparare sia una cosa, e usare bene quelle conoscenze un'altra...

id: \rBattling certainly has its merits... I think I understand my Pokémon a bit better now.
en: \rBattling certainly has its merits... I think I understand my Pokémon a bit better now.
it: \rLottare ha sicuramente i suoi pregi... Credo di capire un po' meglio i miei Pokémon, adesso.

id: \bLaventon: Ah! You gave me quite the shock, coming to me like that...
en: \bLaventon: Ah! You gave me quite the shock, coming to me like that...
it: \bLaventon: Ah! Mi hai fatto prendere un bello spavento, a piombarmi addosso così...

id: \bOh yes, and...what might your name be? Oho! So you're called \PN! My name is Laventon.
en: \bOh yes, and...what might your name be? Oho! So you're called \PN! My name is Laventon.
it: \bOh sì, e... come ti chiami? Oho! Allora ti chiami \PN! Il mio nome è Laventon.

id: \bI am something of a scholar seeking to deepen our understanding of Pokémon.
en: \bI am something of a scholar seeking to deepen our understanding of Pokémon.
it: \bSono una specie di studioso che cerca di approfondire la nostra conoscenza dei Pokémon.

id: \bCome now! What do you say? Shall we help one another out, for me to seek understanding of your Pokemon?
en: \bCome now! What do you say? Shall we help one another out, for me to seek understanding of your Pokemon?
it: \bSu, allora! Che ne dici? Ci aiutiamo a vicenda, così che io possa capire meglio i tuoi Pokemon?

id: \bLaventon: Splendiferous results! I daresay you've earned yourself a pat on the back!
en: \bLaventon: Splendiferous results! I daresay you've earned yourself a pat on the back!
it: \bLaventon: Risultati splendiferosi! Oserei dire che ti sei meritato una pacca sulla spalla!

id: \bYou know, I expect great things of you. Carry on the good fight out there!
en: \bYou know, I expect great things of you. Carry on the good fight out there!
it: \bSai, mi aspetto grandi cose da te. Continua a combattere la buona battaglia là fuori!

id: \rCogita: First off, no "mistress," thank you. Just Cogita. It seems I'll be able to fulfil my duty at long last, thanks to you.
en: \rCogita: First off, no "mistress," thank you. Just Cogita. It seems I'll be able to fulfil my duty at long last, thanks to you.
it: \rCogita: Innanzitutto, niente "signora", grazie. Solo Cogita. Sembra che finalmente potrò adempiere al mio dovere, grazie a te.

id: \rIndeed, I am to guide you, lost one. For the task of preventing great disaster falls to you.
en: \rIndeed, I am to guide you, lost one. For the task of preventing great disaster falls to you.
it: \rEsatto, sono qui per guidarti, anima smarrita. Perché il compito di impedire un grande disastro spetta a te.

id: \rThis is the only time I will have to pardon myself, to further strengthen your resolve. Let's battle.
en: \rThis is the only time I will have to pardon myself, to further strengthen your resolve. Let's battle.
it: \rQuesta è l'unica volta in cui dovrò concedermi una deroga, per rafforzare ulteriormente la tua determinazione. Lottiamo.

id: \rCogita: There is nobility in knowing what must be done and seeing to it. You see, don't you?
en: \rCogita: There is nobility in knowing what must be done and seeing to it. You see, don't you?
it: \rCogita: C'è nobiltà nel sapere cosa va fatto e nel farlo. Lo capisci, vero?

id: \rI have passed on to you all there is to pass. Where history goes from here... I leave it to you to see it through.
en: \rI have passed on to you all there is to pass. Where history goes from here... I leave it to you to see it through.
it: \rTi ho trasmesso tutto ciò che c'era da trasmettere. Dove andrà la storia da qui in poi... Lascio a te il compito di guidarla.

id: \bVolo: Ever since I was young, whenever I encounterd something painful or heartbreaking... I couldn't help but wonder why life was so unfair and why I was cursed to live through such things.
en: \bVolo: Ever since I was young, whenever I encounterd something painful or heartbreaking... I couldn't help but wonder why life was so unfair and why I was cursed to live through such things.
it: \bVolo: Fin da quando ero piccolo, ogni volta che mi capitava qualcosa di doloroso o straziante... non potevo fare a meno di chiedermi perché la vita fosse così ingiusta e perché fossi condannato a vivere cose simili.

id: \bEventually, I chose to direct all my energy into my own natural curiosity and ambition. And what tickled my curiosity stronger than anything else were the mysteries to be found in legends, in history, in ruins...
