en: \bEventually, I chose to direct all my energy into my own natural curiosity and ambition. And what tickled my curiosity stronger than anything else were the mysteries to be found in legends, in history, in ruins...
it: \bAlla fine, ho scelto di incanalare tutte le mie energie nella mia curiosità e nella mia ambizione naturali. E ciò che stuzzicava la mia curiosità più di ogni altra cosa erano i misteri custoditi nelle leggende, nella storia, nelle rovine...

id: \bEver since I becoming convinced that Arceus really does exist, I also realised I need to be able to subjugate its power... TO CREATE A BRAND NEW WORLD! Everyone will vanish, for the forging of a NEW BETTER WORLD!
en: \bEver since I becoming convinced that Arceus really does exist, I also realised I need to be able to subjugate its power... TO CREATE A BRAND NEW WORLD! Everyone will vanish, for the forging of a NEW BETTER WORLD!
it: \bDa quando mi sono convinto che Arceus esiste davvero, ho capito anche di dover essere in grado di soggiogare il suo potere... PER CREARE UN MONDO COMPLETAMENTE NUOVO! Tutti spariranno, per forgiare un NUOVO MONDO MIGLIORE!

id: \bVolo: I've devoted myself to Arceus beyond any other! I worshiped it as the creator of our entire world! I dedicated all of my passion and interest to studying it! All the time I've spent poring over the legends... Everything that I've done!
en: \bVolo: I've devoted myself to Arceus beyond any other! I worshiped it as the creator of our entire world! I dedicated all of my passion and interest to studying it! All the time I've spent poring over the legends... Everything that I've done!
it: \bVolo: Mi sono votato ad Arceus più di chiunque altro! L'ho venerato come il creatore del nostro intero mondo! Ho dedicato tutta la mia passione e il mio interesse a studiarlo! Tutto il tempo passato a studiare le leggende... Tutto ciò che ho fatto!

id: \bDo you mean to tell me that this world doesn't need to be remade? Then, my journey is over. My story ended when I lost to you.
en: \bDo you mean to tell me that this world doesn't need to be remade? Then, my journey is over. My story ended when I lost to you.
it: \bVuoi dirmi che questo mondo non ha bisogno di essere rifatto? Allora il mio viaggio è finito. La mia storia è finita quando ho perso contro di te.

id: The door is locked...
en: The door is locked...
it: La porta è chiusa a chiave...

id: \bBrock: Hi, I believe having rock hard defense and determination will overcome all obstacles!
en: \bBrock: Hi, I believe having rock hard defense and determination will overcome all obstacles!
it: \bBrock: Ciao, io credo che una difesa dura come la roccia e tanta determinazione possano superare qualsiasi ostacolo!

id: \bYou'd better have true-grit determination, or you will have a hard time hurting my pals!
en: \bYou'd better have true-grit determination, or you will have a hard time hurting my pals!
it: \bFaresti meglio ad avere una determinazione di ferro, o avrai vita dura contro i miei amici!

id: \bShow me your best!
en: \bShow me your best!
it: \bMostrami il meglio di te!

id: \bBrock: The world is huge. There are still many strong trainers like you.
en: \bBrock: The world is huge. There are still many strong trainers like you.
it: \bBrock: Il mondo è enorme. Ci sono ancora molti Allenatori forti come te.

id: \bI have faith that you will overcome them!
en: \bI have faith that you will overcome them!
it: \bSono sicuro che riuscirai a superarli!

id: \rMisty: You are looking at the world-famous beauty, Misty, here!
en: \rMisty: You are looking at the world-famous beauty, Misty, here!
it: \rMisty: Hai davanti la bellezza famosa in tutto il mondo, Misty!

id: \rYou'd better not get blown away by my looks and my all-out offense!
en: \rYou'd better not get blown away by my looks and my all-out offense!
it: \rFaresti meglio a non farti travolgere dal mio fascino e dal mio attacco a tutto spiano!

id: \rAre you ready, sweetie?
en: \rAre you ready, sweetie?
it: \rSei pronto, tesoro?

id: \rMisty: Aiyeee! This makes me so angry!
en: \rMisty: Aiyeee! This makes me so angry!
it: \rMisty: Aaargh! Questa cosa mi fa davvero arrabbiare!

id: \rI need to clear my head of these defeats... I definitely won't lose next time!
en: \rI need to clear my head of these defeats... I definitely won't lose next time!
it: \rDevo togliermi dalla testa queste sconfitte... La prossima volta non perderò di sicuro!

id: \bLt. Surge: Hey, puny kid! I have to hand it to you.
en: \bLt. Surge: Hey, puny kid! I have to hand it to you.
it: \bLt. Surge: Ehi, piccoletto! Devo ammetterlo.

id: \bIt takes guts to take me on. And you'd better keep your nerves tight.
en: \bIt takes guts to take me on. And you'd better keep your nerves tight.
it: \bCi vuole fegato per sfidarmi. E farai bene a tenere i nervi saldi.

id: \bBecause Pokémon battles are war! I'll show you and shock you into surrender!
en: \bBecause Pokémon battles are war! I'll show you and shock you into surrender!
it: \bPerché le lotte Pokémon sono una guerra! Ti farò vedere io e ti fulminerò fino alla resa!

id: \bLt. Surge: Okay! You're the real deal, kid!
en: \bLt. Surge: Okay! You're the real deal, kid!
it: \bLt. Surge: Ok! Sei proprio in gamba, ragazzo!

id: \bBack to brushin' up. Keep goin' like lightning!
en: \bBack to brushin' up. Keep goin' like lightning!
it: \bSi torna ad allenarsi. Continua così, veloce come un fulmine!

id: \rErika: ...Zzz... zzz... Hm? Oh, good day to you. It makes me sleepy to be here alone.
en: \rErika: ...Zzz... zzz... Hm? Oh, good day to you.  It makes me sleepy to be here alone.
it: \rErika: ...Zzz... zzz... Mh? Oh, buongiorno a te.  Stare qui da sola mi fa venire sonno.

id: \rDid you perhaps wish to challenge me? Very well... I, Erika, graciously accept.
en: \rDid you perhaps wish to challenge me? Very well...  I, Erika, graciously accept.
it: \rDesideravi forse sfidarmi? Molto bene...  Io, Erika, accetto con piacere.

id: \rLet my ladies demonstrate the art of Ikebana.
en: \rLet my ladies demonstrate the art of Ikebana.
it: \rLascia che le mie signore ti mostrino l'arte dell'ikebana.

id: \rErika: Oh! I admire your technique.
en: \rErika: Oh! I admire your technique.
it: \rErika: Oh! Ammiro la tua tecnica.

id: \rI would be really happy to see your demonstration again next time.
en: \rI would be really happy to see your demonstration again next time.
it: \rSarei davvero felice di rivedere la tua dimostrazione la prossima volta.

id: \rSabrina: I had a vision of your arrival, and I know you are not a simpleton.
en: \rSabrina: I had a vision of your arrival, and I know you are not a simpleton.
it: \rSabrina: Ho avuto una visione del tuo arrivo, e so che non sei uno sprovveduto.

id: \rI saw a challenge from you, but intentionally didn't see further than that.
en: \rI saw a challenge from you, but intentionally didn't see further than that.
it: \rHo visto una tua sfida, ma di proposito non ho guardato oltre.

id: \rGetting ready, aren't you? Let's find out who the victor will be.
en: \rGetting ready, aren't you? Let's find out who the victor will be.
it: \rTi stai preparando, vero? Scopriamo chi sarà il vincitore.

id: \rSabrina: Your power... far exceeds what I foresaw...
en: \rSabrina: Your power... far exceeds what I foresaw...
it: \rSabrina: Il tuo potere... supera di gran lunga ciò che avevo previsto...

id: \rYou'll become even stronger than you are now, I know it...
en: \rYou'll become even stronger than you are now, I know it...
it: \rDiventerai ancora più forte di quanto sei ora, lo so...

id: \rJanine: Hi! I'm Janine! Remember the name!
en: \rJanine: Hi! I'm Janine! Remember the name!
it: \rNina: Ciao! Sono Nina! Ricordati il mio nome!

id: \rKnow that even though I'm the daughter of a reowned Elite Four, it doesn't mean that I'm inferior!
en: \rKnow that even though I'm the daughter of a reowned Elite Four, it doesn't mean that I'm inferior!
it: \rSappi che anche se sono la figlia di un celebre membro dei Superquattro, non significa che io sia da meno!

id: \rOtherwise you're going to pay the consequences of the horror I'm about to give you!
en: \rOtherwise you're going to pay the consequences of the horror I'm about to give you!
it: \rAltrimenti pagherai le conseguenze dell'orrore che sto per scatenarti contro!

id: \rJanine: Fufufufu... I'm sorry to disappoint you... You're the real deal.
en: \rJanine: Fufufufu... I'm sorry to disappoint you...  You're the real deal.
it: \rNina: Fufufufu... Mi dispiace deluderti...  Sei proprio in gamba.

id: \rI'm going to reapply myself and improve my skills, to become much better than both my father and you!
en: \rI'm going to reapply myself and improve my skills, to become much better than both my father and you!
it: \rMi impegnerò di nuovo e affinerò le mie abilità, per diventare molto più brava sia di mio padre che di te!

id: \bBlaine: Good day! Do you know all about Pokémon? Especially yours?
en: \bBlaine: Good day! Do you know all about Pokémon?  Especially yours?
it: \bBlaine: Buongiorno! Sai tutto sui Pokémon?  Soprattutto sui tuoi?

id: \bHow about the best type of Pokémon to train and cultivate? Bet that got you puzzled huh.
en: \bHow about the best type of Pokémon to train and cultivate? Bet that got you puzzled huh.
it: \bE qual è il tipo di Pokémon migliore da allenare e crescere? Scommetto che ti ho messo in difficoltà, eh.

id: \bWanna know the burning answer? Let me give you a lesson on that!
en: \bWanna know the burning answer? Let me give you a lesson on that!
it: \bVuoi conoscere la risposta infuocata? Lascia che ti dia una lezione!

id: \bBlaine: Impressive! You have shown the wits and knowledge to overcome me.
en: \bBlaine: Impressive! You have shown the wits and knowledge to overcome me.
it: \bBlaine: Notevole! Hai dimostrato l'ingegno e la conoscenza per superarmi.

id: \bIt makes me all fired up for more! Be passionate! Feel the burning curiosity!
en: \bIt makes me all fired up for more! Be passionate!  Feel the burning curiosity!
it: \bMi fa venire voglia di altre lotte infuocate! Sii appassionato!  Senti la curiosità che brucia!

id: \bBill: Hiya! Call me Bill! I'm a true-blue Poké Maniac! I'm the one who developed the system to transfer Pokémon!
en: \bBill: Hiya! Call me Bill! I'm a true-blue Poké Maniac!  I'm the one who developed the system to transfer Pokémon!
it: \bBill: Ciao! Chiamami Bill! Sono un vero Pokémaniaco!  Sono io che ho sviluppato il sistema per trasferire i Pokémon!

id: \bHey! What's with that skeptical look? I'm not joshing you, pal. Speaking of that, why am I here?
en: \bHey! What's with that skeptical look? I'm not joshing you, pal. Speaking of that, why am I here?
it: \bEhi! Cos'è quello sguardo scettico? Non ti sto prendendo in giro, amico. A proposito, perché sono qui?

id: \bDid you come to see my Pokémon collection? Check this out!
en: \bDid you come to see my Pokémon collection? Check this out!
it: \bSei venuto a vedere la mia collezione di Pokémon? Guarda qua!

id: \bBill: That's a bummer. I've got to thank you for the great time.
en: \bBill: That's a bummer. I've got to thank you for the great time.
it: \bBill: Che peccato. Devo ringraziarti per esserci divertiti così tanto.

id: \bNow, I've gotta find out why am I here with the other Kanto gym leaders...
en: \bNow, I've gotta find out why am I here with the other Kanto gym leaders...
it: \bOra devo scoprire perché sono qui con gli altri Capipalestra di Kanto...

id: \rLorelei: Are you well versed in handling icy creatures? No one can best me on that.
en: \rLorelei: Are you well versed in handling icy creatures? No one can best me on that.
it: \rLorelei: Sei esperto nel gestire creature di ghiaccio? Nessuno può battermi in questo.

id: \rWith my well-planned strategy, all Pokémon will be frozen solid at my mercy!
en: \rWith my well-planned strategy, all Pokémon will be frozen solid at my mercy!
it: \rCon la mia strategia ben studiata, tutti i Pokémon finiranno congelati e alla mia mercé!

id: \rHope you brought your winter coat along, heh.
en: \rHope you brought your winter coat along, heh.
it: \rSpero che tu abbia portato il cappotto, eh eh.

id: \rLorelei: You're better than I thought. I'm feeling the heat now!
en: \rLorelei: You're better than I thought. I'm feeling the heat now!
it: \rLorelei: Sei più bravo di quanto pensassi. Ora sì che sento il calore!

id: \rI will be sure to think of a counter-strategy after this battle!
en: \rI will be sure to think of a counter-strategy after this battle!
it: \rDopo questa lotta penserò di sicuro a una contromossa!

id: \bRyuki: The name's Ryuki. I'm what you might call a star.
en: \bRyuki: The name's Ryuki. I'm what you might call a star.
it: \bRyuki: Mi chiamo Ryuki. Sono quella che si dice una star.

id: \bI'm gonna be a Kantonian Gym Leader one day! The whole world will know me soon enough!
en: \bI'm gonna be a Kantonian Gym Leader one day!  The whole world will know me soon enough!
it: \bUn giorno diventerò un Capopalestra di Kanto!  Presto tutto il mondo mi conoscerà!

id: \bYou're gonna be my fan, right? Let our fiery spirits clash in a blaze of glory!
en: \bYou're gonna be my fan, right? Let our fiery spirits clash in a blaze of glory!
it: \bDiventerai un mio fan, vero? Facciamo scontrare i nostri spiriti ardenti in un tripudio di gloria!

id: \bRyuki: What a gig. You're a hidden talent too!
en: \bRyuki: What a gig. You're a hidden talent too!
it: \bRyuki: Che concerto. Anche tu sei un talento nascosto!

id: \bIf we played it loud and well enough, our fame will be unstoppable!
en: \bIf we played it loud and well enough, our fame will be unstoppable!
it: \bSe suonassimo forte e bene abbastanza, la nostra fama sarebbe inarrestabile!

id: \rAgatha: Why are you here noseying about, pesky child?
en: \rAgatha: Why are you here noseying about, pesky child?
it: \rAgatha: Perché sei qui a ficcanasare, moccioso fastidioso?

id: \rYou have a Pokédex on you! You're the child that Oak's taken under his wing, aren't you?
en: \rYou have a Pokédex on you! You're the child that Oak's taken under his wing, aren't you?
it: \rHai un Pokédex con te! Sei il ragazzino che Oak ha preso sotto la sua ala, vero?

id: \rPokémon are meant for battling! Not to be collected! I'll show you how a real Trainer battles!
en: \rPokémon are meant for battling! Not to be collected!  I'll show you how a real Trainer battles!
it: \rI Pokémon sono fatti per lottare! Non per essere collezionati!  Ti mostrerò come lotta un vero Allenatore!

id: \rAgatha: You win. I've nothing else to say.
en: \rAgatha: You win. I've nothing else to say.
it: \rAgatha: Hai vinto. Non ho altro da dire.

id: \rWell, what are you waiting for? Run along now, child! Shoo!
en: \rWell, what are you waiting for? Run along now, child! Shoo!
it: \rBeh, cosa aspetti? Fila via, moccioso! Sciò!

id: \bTrace: Hi. You must have taken a long path to get here. Was it to get a worthy challenge?
en: \bTrace: Hi. You must have taken a long path to get here. Was it to get a worthy challenge?
it: \bTrace: Ciao. Devi aver fatto molta strada per arrivare qui. Cercavi una sfida degna di te?

id: \bAs for me, I wanna catch tons of different Pokémon and train them up to be strong! Heh!
en: \bAs for me, I wanna catch tons of different Pokémon and train them up to be strong! Heh!
it: \bQuanto a me, voglio catturare tantissimi Pokémon diversi e allenarli per renderli forti! Eh eh!

id: \bMaybe I should check if your Pokémon really are doing well... with a battle!
en: \bMaybe I should check if your Pokémon really are doing well... with a battle!
it: \bForse dovrei controllare se i tuoi Pokémon stanno davvero bene... con una lotta!

id: \bTrace: Man, you truly are something! But that doesn't mean I'm giving up!
en: \bTrace: Man, you truly are something! But that doesn't mean I'm giving up!
it: \bTrace: Accidenti, sei davvero forte! Ma questo non significa che mi arrenda!

id: \bI'll keep taking on your challenges if we meet again!
en: \bI'll keep taking on your challenges if we meet again!
it: \bSe ci incontreremo di nuovo, continuerò ad accettare le tue sfide!

id: \bBlue: Who are you? My name's Blue. I was once the Kanto Champion, although it was short-lived.
en: \bBlue: Who are you? My name's Blue. I was once the Kanto Champion, although it was short-lived.
it: \bBlu: Chi sei? Mi chiamo Blu. Un tempo sono stato il Campione di Kanto, anche se per poco.

id: \bBut I ain't any ordinary chump then! If I see a strong opponent, it makes me want to battle.
en: \bBut I ain't any ordinary chump then! If I see a strong opponent, it makes me want to battle.
it: \bMa non ero certo un pivello qualunque! Se vedo un avversario forte, mi viene voglia di lottare.

id: \bWanna give it a try? I'll know if you're good or not by battling you right now.
en: \bWanna give it a try? I'll know if you're good or not by battling you right now.
it: \bVuoi provarci? Capirò se sei bravo o no lottando con te subito.

id: \bBlue: You're tough, I'll give you that. But there's always someone better. You have to be more dedicated!
en: \bBlue: You're tough, I'll give you that. But there's always someone better. You have to be more dedicated!
it: \bBlu: Sei tosto, te lo concedo. Ma c'è sempre qualcuno più bravo. Devi impegnarti di più!

id: \bI gotta get back to training. Smell ya later!
en: \bI gotta get back to training. Smell ya later!
it: \bDevo tornare ad allenarmi. Ci si becca!

id: \rLeaf: Oh, whoops! You're not a Pokémon! Sorry, I thought you were some kind of Pokémon.
en: \rLeaf: Oh, whoops! You're not a Pokémon! Sorry, I thought you were some kind of Pokémon.
it: \rLeaf: Oh, ops! Non sei un Pokémon! Scusa, pensavo fossi una specie di Pokémon.

id: \rWell, uh… nice to meet you. I'm Green! Are you here because you're also looking for… something special?
en: \rWell, uh… nice to meet you. I'm Green! Are you here because you're also looking for… something special?
it: \rBeh, ehm... piacere di conoscerti. Sono Green! Sei qui perché anche tu stai cercando... qualcosa di speciale?

id: \rI noticed you got some good Pokémon there too, can I have them?
en: \rI noticed you got some good Pokémon there too, can I have them?
it: \rHo notato che anche tu hai dei bei Pokémon, me li dai?

id: \rGreen: Wow, you're strong! Oh, I know! Why don't you become one of my Pokémon!
en: \rGreen: Wow, you're strong! Oh, I know! Why don't you become one of my Pokémon!
it: \rGreen: Wow, sei forte! Oh, ho un'idea! Perché non diventi uno dei miei Pokémon?

id: \rThink about it, ok? Hehe.
en: \rThink about it, ok? Hehe.
it: \rPensaci, ok? Ih ih.

id: \bWords are unnecessary!
en: \bWords are unnecessary!
it: \bLe parole sono superflue!

id: \rRoxanne: Hi, Roxanne here. I like to strategize before a battle, applying what I've studied till now.
en: \rRoxanne: Hi, Roxanne here. I like to strategize before a battle, applying what I've studied till now.
it: \rPetra: Ciao, sono Petra. Mi piace studiare una strategia prima di lottare, applicando ciò che ho imparato finora.

id: \rI'm sure we've both experienced many battles, gaining immense knowledge on battling.
en: \rI'm sure we've both experienced many battles, gaining immense knowledge on battling.
it: \rSono sicura che entrambi abbiamo affrontato molte lotte, acquisendo un'enorme esperienza.

id: \rWould you kindly demonstrate how you battle so I could learn? I would also see how much better I've become.
en: \rWould you kindly demonstrate how you battle so I could learn? I would also see how much better I've become.
it: \rSaresti così gentile da mostrarmi come lotti, così posso imparare? Vedrei anche quanto sono migliorata.

id: \rRoxanne: You were flawless. I still have much to learn.
en: \rRoxanne: You were flawless. I still have much to learn.
it: \rPetra: Sei stato impeccabile. Ho ancora molto da imparare.

id: \rI want to learn even more from you. Will you be my opponent then as well?
en: \rI want to learn even more from you. Will you be my opponent then as well?
it: \rVoglio imparare ancora di più da te. Sarai il mio avversario anche la prossima volta?

id: \bBrawly: Huge wave incoming! Look out! Right on it!
en: \bBrawly: Huge wave incoming! Look out! Right on it!
it: \bRudi: Arriva un'onda enorme! Attenzione! Ci sono!

id: \bChurned by the rough waves of the seas, toughened by the cave of the outskirts. I'm Brawly!
en: \bChurned by the rough waves of the seas, toughened by the cave of the outskirts. I'm Brawly!
it: \bSballottato dalle onde dei mari in tempesta, temprato nella grotta della periferia. Sono Rudi!

id: \bYou want a challenge? Let's see what you're made of.
en: \bYou want a challenge? Let's see what you're made of.
it: \bVuoi una sfida? Vediamo di che pasta sei fatto.

id: \bBrawly: Whoa. Wow! You made a bigger splash than I expected.
en: \bBrawly: Whoa. Wow! You made a bigger splash than I expected.
it: \bRudi: Wow. Accidenti! Hai fatto più scalpore di quanto mi aspettassi.

id: \bYour talent brings forth a wave of astonishment, overwhelming me. I look forward to it again. Ride on!
en: \bYour talent brings forth a wave of astonishment, overwhelming me. I look forward to it again. Ride on!
it: \bIl tuo talento solleva un'onda di stupore che mi travolge. Non vedo l'ora di rifarlo. Cavalca l'onda!

id: \bWattson: Ah-ha! Fine young soul. Brimming with vigor.
en: \bWattson: Ah-ha! Fine young soul. Brimming with vigor.
it: \bWalter: Ah-ha! Che bel giovane. Traboccante di energia.

id: \bI know what you want. You want to battle my Pokémon! Wahahahaha!
en: \bI know what you want. You want to battle my Pokémon! Wahahahaha!
it: \bSo cosa vuoi. Vuoi lottare contro i miei Pokémon! Wahahahaha!

id: \bI'll make sparks fly from you! Don't say I didn't warn you!
en: \bI'll make sparks fly from you! Don't say I didn't warn you!
it: \bFarò sprizzare scintille! Non dire che non ti avevo avvertito!

id: \bWattson: Wahaha. You ended up giving me a thrill! I'm so impressed that I can't help but laugh!
en: \bWattson: Wahaha. You ended up giving me a thrill!  I'm so impressed that I can't help but laugh!
it: \bWalter: Wahaha. Alla fine mi hai proprio elettrizzato!  Sono così colpito che non riesco a smettere di ridere!

id: \bI swell with optimism, seeing a promising young Trainer like you!
en: \bI swell with optimism, seeing a promising young Trainer like you!
it: \bMi sento pieno di ottimismo, vedendo un giovane Allenatore promettente come te!

id: \rFlannery: Welcome... No, puny trainer! I see you've made it here to look for capable foes!
en: \rFlannery: Welcome... No, puny trainer! I see you've made it here to look for capable foes!
it: \rFiammetta: Benvenuto... No, piccolo Allenatore! Vedo che sei arrivato fin qui in cerca di avversari all'altezza!

id: \rUh... dare not underestimate me, I shall, uh... demonstrate the hot moves I have honed with my grandfather!
en: \rUh... dare not underestimate me, I shall, uh...  demonstrate the hot moves I have honed with my grandfather!
it: \rEhm... non osare sottovalutarmi, io ti, ehm...  mostrerò le mosse infuocate che ho affinato con mio nonno!

id: \rBrace yourself! Haiyaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
en: \rBrace yourself! Haiyaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
it: \rPreparati! Haiyaaaaaaaaaaaaa!

id: \rFlannery: Your strength sure reminds me of my grandfather. I guess I was trying too hard to be someone I'm not.
en: \rFlannery: Your strength sure reminds me of my grandfather. I guess I was trying too hard to be someone I'm not.
it: \rFiammetta: La tua forza mi ricorda proprio mio nonno. Forse mi sforzavo troppo di essere qualcuno che non sono.

id: \rWhen I don't act like myself, no wonder Pokémon that battle at my side get confused.
en: \rWhen I don't act like myself, no wonder Pokémon that battle at my side get confused.
it: \rSe non mi comporto da me stessa, non c'è da stupirsi che i Pokémon che lottano al mio fianco siano confusi.

id: \bNorman: Well, the world of Pokémon is deep. I honestly think that no amount of training would ever be enough.
en: \bNorman: Well, the world of Pokémon is deep. I honestly think that no amount of training would ever be enough.
it: \bNorman: Beh, il mondo dei Pokémon è profondo. Sinceramente penso che nessun allenamento sarebbe mai abbastanza.

id: \bBut there's no challenge for me to battle a greenhorn Trainer!
en: \bBut there's no challenge for me to battle a greenhorn Trainer!
it: \bMa non c'è gusto a lottare contro un Allenatore alle prime armi!

id: \bSo you'd better give it your best shot. I will do everything in my power to win!
en: \bSo you'd better give it your best shot. I will do everything in my power to win!
it: \bQuindi farai meglio a dare il massimo. Farò tutto ciò che è in mio potere per vincere!

id: \bNorman: You did a great job. You went all out and earned that victory...
en: \bNorman: You did a great job. You went all out and earned that victory...
it: \bNorman: Hai fatto un ottimo lavoro. Hai dato tutto e ti sei meritato questa vittoria...

id: \bI want my kid to learn from you. Hope you will meet him soon.
en: \bI want my kid to learn from you. Hope you will meet him soon.
it: \bVorrei che mio figlio imparasse da te. Spero che lo incontrerai presto.

id: \rWinona: I'm one with the birds and have soared the skies...
en: \rWinona: I'm one with the birds and have soared the skies...
it: \rAlice: Sono una cosa sola con gli uccelli e ho solcato i cieli...

id: \rHowever grueling, we have triumphed with elegance and grace.
en: \rHowever grueling, we have triumphed with elegance and grace.
it: \rPer quanto estenuante, abbiamo trionfato con eleganza e grazia.

id: \rWitness the elegant choreography by us. Don't blink or you will regret it!
en: \rWitness the elegant choreography by us. Don't blink or you will regret it!
it: \rAmmira la nostra elegante coreografia. Non battere ciglio o te ne pentirai!

id: \rWinona: I see you are one with your Pokémon as well. I recognize your talent.
en: \rWinona: I see you are one with your Pokémon as well. I recognize your talent.
it: \rAlice: Vedo che anche tu sei una cosa sola con i tuoi Pokémon. Riconosco il tuo talento.

id: \rI know you'll keep aiming higher and higher! That's what brought you victory.
en: \rI know you'll keep aiming higher and higher! That's what brought you victory.
it: \rSo che continuerai a puntare sempre più in alto! È questo che ti ha portato alla vittoria.

id: \bTate: Heh heh heh... Were you surprised? \rLiza: Tee hee hee... Were you surprised?
en: \bTate: Heh heh heh... Were you surprised? \rLiza: Tee hee hee... Were you surprised?
it: \bTell: Eh eh eh... Sorpreso? \rPat: Ih ih ih... Sorpreso?

id: \bWe don't need to talk..... \r....because we can each tell....
en: \bWe don't need to talk..... \r....because we can each tell....
it: \bNon abbiamo bisogno di parlare..... \r....perché ognuno di noi sa....

id: \b....what the other is thinking... \r...all in our minds!
en: \b....what the other is thinking... \r...all in our minds!
it: \b....cosa pensa l'altro... \r...tutto nella nostra mente!

id: \bThis combinations of ours! \rCan you beat it?
en: \bThis combinations of ours! \rCan you beat it?
it: \bQuesta nostra combinazione! \rRiesci a batterla?

id: \bTate: The bond between you and your Pokémon... \rLiza: ...far stronger than ours. We can tell.
en: \bTate: The bond between you and your Pokémon... \rLiza: ...far stronger than ours. We can tell.
it: \bTell: Il legame tra te e i tuoi Pokémon... \rPat: ...è molto più forte del nostro. Lo sentiamo.

id: \bWe will meet again someday.... \r...we are very sure of that.
en: \bWe will meet again someday.... \r...we are very sure of that.
it: \bCi rivedremo un giorno.... \r...ne siamo certissimi.

id: \bJuan: It seems you have a compelling reason to battle me. Did you know that I am a retired trainer?
en: \bJuan: It seems you have a compelling reason to battle me. Did you know that I am a retired trainer?
it: \bRodrigo: Sembra che tu abbia un valido motivo per sfidarmi. Sapevi che sono un Allenatore in pensione?

id: \bI had given up my position as Gym Leader once. I had entrusted everything to my student.
en: \bI had given up my position as Gym Leader once. I had entrusted everything to my student.
it: \bUna volta avevo lasciato il mio posto di Capopalestra. Avevo affidato tutto al mio allievo.

id: \bBut enough chatter. I guess a Coordinator could show you a trick or two today. Witness the grand illusion of water sculpted by us!
en: \bBut enough chatter. I guess a Coordinator could show you a trick or two today. Witness the grand illusion of water sculpted by us!
it: \bMa basta chiacchiere. Credo che un Coordinatore possa insegnarti un paio di trucchi oggi. Ammira la grande illusione d'acqua scolpita da noi!

id: \bJuan: Like the finest music, the battles we made together strikes chords of inspiration in my heart.
en: \bJuan: Like the finest music, the battles we made together strikes chords of inspiration in my heart.
it: \bRodrigo: Come la musica più raffinata, le lotte che abbiamo fatto insieme toccano corde d'ispirazione nel mio cuore.

id: \bI close my eyes, and I see visions of you soaring. A certain sign of nobility!
en: \bI close my eyes, and I see visions of you soaring. A certain sign of nobility!
it: \bChiudo gli occhi e ti vedo spiccare il volo. Un chiaro segno di nobiltà!

id: \bSidney: They said I was a punk, but I showed them what the dark side's beauties are made of!
en: \bSidney: They said I was a punk, but I showed them what the dark side's beauties are made of!
it: \bFosco: Dicevano che ero un teppista, ma ho mostrato loro di cosa sono fatte le bellezze del lato oscuro!

id: \bYou can also talk all you want, but offense over defense! All that matters is how strong I am!
en: \bYou can also talk all you want, but offense over defense! All that matters is how strong I am!
it: \bPuoi parlare quanto vuoi, ma l'attacco viene prima della difesa! Conta solo quanto sono forte!

id: \bNow I like that look you're giving me. I guess you'll give me a good match. Let's get down to it!
en: \bNow I like that look you're giving me. I guess you'll give me a good match. Let's get down to it!
it: \bMi piace lo sguardo che mi stai lanciando. Credo che mi darai del filo da torcere. Diamoci dentro!

id: \bSidney: Listen to what this loser has to say. It's a long way, but you've got what it takes.
en: \bSidney: Listen to what this loser has to say.  It's a long way, but you've got what it takes.
it: \bFosco: Ascolta cos'ha da dire questo perdente.  La strada è lunga, ma tu hai la stoffa.

id: \bAnd when you gain new strength, come back here! No holds barred. No hard feelings!
en: \bAnd when you gain new strength, come back here!  No holds barred. No hard feelings!
it: \bE quando sarai diventato più forte, torna qui!  Senza esclusione di colpi. Senza rancore!

id: \rPhoebe: Uh-huh.. Uh-huh... Hahaha! You're right. Oh? Gimme a minute.... Hi! My friend's saying you are looking for me.
en: \rPhoebe: Uh-huh.. Uh-huh... Hahaha! You're right.  Oh? Gimme a minute.... Hi! My friend's saying you are looking for me.
it: \rEster: Ah-ah.. Ah-ah... Ahahah! Hai ragione.  Oh? Dammi un minuto.... Ciao! La mia amica dice che mi stai cercando.

id: \rYou can't see her? Ahahaha. Of course. She is a ghost, and I am one of the few able to communicate with her.
en: \rYou can't see her? Ahahaha. Of course. She is a ghost, and I am one of the few able to communicate with her.
it: \rNon la vedi? Ahahaha. Ma certo. È un fantasma, e io sono una delle poche persone in grado di comunicare con lei.

id: \rDon't be afraid. Anyway, if you are looking for a challenge, see if you can hurt my friends!
en: \rDon't be afraid. Anyway, if you are looking for a challenge, see if you can hurt my friends!
it: \rNon avere paura. Comunque, se cerchi una sfida, vediamo se riesci a fare del male ai miei amici!

id: \rPhoebe: There's definitely a stronger bond between you and your team. It's only natural that I lost.
en: \rPhoebe: There's definitely a stronger bond between you and your team. It's only natural that I lost.
it: \rEster: C'è sicuramente un legame più forte tra te e la tua squadra. È naturale che io abbia perso.

id: \rI'd like to see how far your bond can carry you. Don't bring shame to us by losing!
en: \rI'd like to see how far your bond can carry you.  Don't bring shame to us by losing!
it: \rVorrei vedere fin dove può portarti il tuo legame.  Non farci vergognare perdendo!

id: \rGlacia: I've traveled afar, so that I can hone my icy skills. But all I have seen are weak trainers.
en: \rGlacia: I've traveled afar, so that I can hone my icy skills.  But all I have seen are weak trainers.
it: \rFrida: Ho viaggiato lontano per affinare le mie abilità glaciali.  Ma ho incontrato solo Allenatori deboli.

id: \rWhat about you? It would please me to no end if you could go all out on me.
en: \rWhat about you? It would please me to no end if you could go all out on me.
it: \rE tu? Mi farebbe immensamente piacere se dessi il massimo contro di me.

id: \rI wonder what are you going to show me. Bring it.
en: \rI wonder what are you going to show me. Bring it.
it: \rChissà cosa mi mostrerai. Fatti sotto.

id: \rGlacia: What a relief, how fiery that was! Spirits burning high that my icy moves pale in comparison.
en: \rGlacia: What a relief, how fiery that was! Spirits burning high that my icy moves pale in comparison.
it: \rFrida: Che sollievo, che lotta infuocata! Spiriti così ardenti che le mie mosse di ghiaccio impallidiscono al confronto.

id: \rDon't be complacent. If you feel the need to cool your emotions, come to me again.
en: \rDon't be complacent. If you feel the need to cool your emotions, come to me again.
it: \rNon adagiarti sugli allori. Se senti il bisogno di raffreddare le tue emozioni, torna da me.

id: \bDrake: In their natural state, Pokémon are wild living things. They can help us, hinder us, and they are free.
en: \bDrake: In their natural state, Pokémon are wild living things. They can help us, hinder us, and they are free.
it: \bDrake: Allo stato naturale, i Pokémon sono creature selvagge. Possono aiutarci, ostacolarci, e sono liberi.

id: \bFor us to battle with Pokémon as partners, do you know what it takes? Do you know what is needed?
en: \bFor us to battle with Pokémon as partners, do you know what it takes? Do you know what is needed?
it: \bSai cosa serve per lottare con i Pokémon come compagni? Sai di cosa c'è bisogno?

id: \bIf you don't, you will never prevail over me!
en: \bIf you don't, you will never prevail over me!
it: \bSe non lo sai, non riuscirai mai a prevalere su di me!

id: \bDrake: You deserve every bit of credit for coming this far. You do seem to know what is needed.
en: \bDrake: You deserve every bit of credit for coming this far. You do seem to know what is needed.
it: \bDrake: Ti meriti tutto il merito per essere arrivato fin qui. Sembri proprio sapere cosa serve.

id: \bYes, a true virtuous heart. It is through that that Pokémon learn right from wrong. The influence helps them grow strong!
en: \bYes, a true virtuous heart. It is through that that Pokémon learn right from wrong. The influence helps them grow strong!
it: \bSì, un cuore davvero virtuoso. È grazie a esso che i Pokémon imparano a distinguere il bene dal male. Quell'influenza li aiuta a diventare forti!

id: \bSteven: You... What did you see on your journey with your Pokémon? What did you feel, meeting so many Trainers like you?
en: \bSteven: You... What did you see on your journey with your Pokémon? What did you feel, meeting so many Trainers like you?
it: \bRocco: Tu... Cos'hai visto nel tuo viaggio con i tuoi Pokémon? Cos'hai provato, incontrando tanti Allenatori come te?

id: \bWhat has awakened in you? I want you to hit me with it all of it!
en: \bWhat has awakened in you? I want you to hit me with it all of it!
it: \bCosa si è risvegliato in te? Voglio che mi colpisca con tutto quello che hai!

id: \bBring me your best shot!
en: \bBring me your best shot!
it: \bMostrami il tuo colpo migliore!

id: \bSteven: Congratulations! The feelings you have... and the Pokémon that responded with all their might...
en: \bSteven: Congratulations! The feelings you have...  and the Pokémon that responded with all their might...
it: \bRocco: Congratulazioni! I sentimenti che provi...  e i Pokémon che hanno risposto con tutte le loro forze...

id: \bThey came together as one, and created an even greater power. And thus, you were able to grasp victory!
en: \bThey came together as one, and created an even greater power. And thus, you were able to grasp victory!
it: \bSi sono uniti come una cosa sola, creando un potere ancora più grande. Ed è così che hai conquistato la vittoria!

id: \bWallace: At times your Pokémon should dance like a spring breeze, at others they should strike like lightning. I want to feel bedazzled by your performance!
en: \bWallace: At times your Pokémon should dance like a spring breeze, at others they should strike like lightning. I want to feel bedazzled by your performance!
it: \bAdriano: A volte i tuoi Pokémon dovrebbero danzare come una brezza primaverile, altre colpire come un fulmine. Voglio restare abbagliato dalla tua esibizione!

id: \bWho can most elegantly dance with their Pokémon? Who can exhibit the most graceful art in battle, you or me and my grand illusion of water?
en: \bWho can most elegantly dance with their Pokémon?  Who can exhibit the most graceful art in battle, you or me and my grand illusion of water?
it: \bChi sa danzare con più eleganza insieme ai propri Pokémon?  Chi sa esibire l'arte più aggraziata in lotta, tu o io con la mia grande illusione d'acqua?

id: \bShow me right here and now!
en: \bShow me right here and now!
it: \bMostramelo qui e ora!

id: \bWallace: Bravo! I realize now your authencity and magnificence as a Pokémon Trainer.
en: \bWallace: Bravo! I realize now your authencity and magnificence as a Pokémon Trainer.
it: \bAdriano: Bravo! Ora riconosco la tua autenticità e la tua magnificenza come Allenatore di Pokémon.

id: \bI find much joy in having met you and your Pokémon. Encore!
en: \bI find much joy in having met you and your Pokémon. Encore!
it: \bSono felicissimo di aver conosciuto te e i tuoi Pokémon. Bis!

id: \bWally: N-nice to meet you! I'm Wally. My Pokémon and I are always moving together, little by little, day by day!
en: \bWally: N-nice to meet you! I'm Wally. My Pokémon and I are always moving together, little by little, day by day!
it: \bWally: P-piacere di conoscerti! Sono Wally. Io e i miei Pokémon andiamo sempre avanti insieme, un po' alla volta, giorno dopo giorno!

id: \bI'm sure that you and your Pokémon must have had to overcome a lot too.
en: \bI'm sure that you and your Pokémon must have had to overcome a lot too.
it: \bSono sicuro che anche tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete dovuto superare tante difficoltà.

id: \bMy Pokémon have given me courage and strength to fight. I have to win for their sake! So get ready!
en: \bMy Pokémon have given me courage and strength to fight. I have to win for their sake! So get ready!
it: \bI miei Pokémon mi hanno dato il coraggio e la forza di lottare. Devo vincere per loro! Quindi preparati!

id: \bWally: Arghhhh!!! Hah... you. Thank you for not holding back. I feel like I've been able to take another step forward thanks to you.
en: \bWally: Arghhhh!!! Hah... you. Thank you for not holding back. I feel like I've been able to take another step forward thanks to you.
it: \bWally: Arghhhh!!! Ah... tu. Grazie per non esserti trattenuto. Mi sembra di aver fatto un altro passo avanti grazie a te.

id: \bLook out! One day... I swear I'll catch up to you! That's a promise I intend to live up to!
en: \bLook out! One day... I swear I'll catch up to you!  That's a promise I intend to live up to!
it: \bStai attento! Un giorno... giuro che ti raggiungerò!  È una promessa che intendo mantenere!

id: \rMay: Heeeeeeey! How's it going? I'm May! Glad to meet you!
en: \rMay: Heeeeeeey! How's it going? I'm May! Glad to meet you!
it: \rVera: Eeeeeeehi! Come va? Sono Vera! Piacere di conoscerti!

id: \rMy dream is to become friends with Pokémon all over the world! I want to understand everything about you and your Pokémon!
en: \rMy dream is to become friends with Pokémon all over the world! I want to understand everything about you and your Pokémon!
it: \rIl mio sogno è diventare amica dei Pokémon di tutto il mondo! Voglio capire tutto di te e dei tuoi Pokémon!

id: \rWould you show me all your Pokémon in a battle with me? I'm so excited!
en: \rWould you show me all your Pokémon in a battle with me? I'm so excited!
it: \rMi mostreresti tutti i tuoi Pokémon in una lotta con me? Sono così emozionata!

id: \rMay: Ohoho, wow, you did it! You defeated me, but I have learnt so much from you!
en: \rMay: Ohoho, wow, you did it! You defeated me, but I have learnt so much from you!
it: \rVera: Ohoho, wow, ce l'hai fatta! Mi hai battuta, ma ho imparato tantissimo da te!

id: \rYou make me feel passionate about getting stronger, maybe next time I'll win!
en: \rYou make me feel passionate about getting stronger, maybe next time I'll win!
it: \rMi fai venire voglia di diventare più forte, magari la prossima volta vincerò io!

id: \bBrendan: Huh, hi. Name's Brendan. Nice to meet you!
en: \bBrendan: Huh, hi. Name's Brendan. Nice to meet you!
it: \bBrendan: Ehm, ciao. Mi chiamo Brendan. Piacere di conoscerti!

id: \bMy dream is to become a better Pokémon Trainer! I want to learn even more and become stronger than I am now!
en: \bMy dream is to become a better Pokémon Trainer! I want to learn even more and become stronger than I am now!
it: \bIl mio sogno è diventare un Allenatore di Pokémon migliore! Voglio imparare ancora di più e diventare più forte di adesso!

id: \bWith you being here, you may have faced and defeated my dad. But facing me is a different story! Here goes!
en: \bWith you being here, you may have faced and defeated my dad. But facing me is a different story! Here goes!
it: \bSe sei qui, forse hai affrontato e battuto mio padre. Ma affrontare me è un'altra storia! Si comincia!

id: \bBrendan: Hmmm... I didn't seem to have it together this time. Oh well!
en: \bBrendan: Hmmm... I didn't seem to have it together this time. Oh well!
it: \bBrendan: Mmm... Stavolta non ero proprio in forma. Pazienza!

id: \bI'll have to try harder next time! You can count on that!
en: \bI'll have to try harder next time! You can count on that!
it: \bLa prossima volta dovrò impegnarmi di più! Puoi contarci!

id: \rViola: That determined expression... That glint in your eye says you're up to the challenge.
en: \rViola: That determined expression... That glint in your eye says you're up to the challenge.
it: \rVioletta: Quell'espressione determinata... Quel luccichio nei tuoi occhi dice che sei all'altezza della sfida.

id: \rIt's fantastic! Whether it's the tears of frustration that follow a loss or the blossoming of joy that comes with victory.
en: \rIt's fantastic! Whether it's the tears of frustration that follow a loss or the blossoming of joy that comes with victory.
it: \rÈ fantastico! Che siano le lacrime di frustrazione dopo una sconfitta o la gioia che sboccia con la vittoria.

id: \rBoth are great subjects for my camera! Now come at me! I, Viola, will take you on!
en: \rBoth are great subjects for my camera! Now come at me! I, Viola, will take you on!
it: \rSono entrambi soggetti perfetti per la mia macchina fotografica! Ora fatti sotto! Io, Violetta, accetto la sfida!

id: \rViola: The world you see through a lens, and the world you see with a Pokémon by your side, can look entirely different.
en: \rViola: The world you see through a lens, and the world you see with a Pokémon by your side, can look entirely different.
it: \rVioletta: Il mondo visto attraverso un obiettivo e il mondo visto con un Pokémon al proprio fianco possono sembrare del tutto diversi.

id: \rYou and your Pokémon have shown me a whole new depth of field! Just fantastic!
en: \rYou and your Pokémon have shown me a whole new depth of field! Just fantastic!
it: \rTu e i tuoi Pokémon mi avete mostrato una profondità di campo tutta nuova! Semplicemente fantastico!

id: \bGrant: I've been waiting in eager anticipation for a worthy challenger! It's quite an achievement to participate here.
en: \bGrant: I've been waiting in eager anticipation for a worthy challenger! It's quite an achievement to participate here.
it: \bLino: Aspettavo con ansia uno sfidante degno! Partecipare qui è già un bel traguardo.

id: \bVery impressive, actually. I have a feeling that our battle will turn out to be worth the wait!
en: \bVery impressive, actually. I have a feeling that our battle will turn out to be worth the wait!
it: \bDavvero notevole. Ho la sensazione che la nostra lotta varrà l'attesa!

id: \bI hope you'll show me that your skill as a trainer surpasses even mine.
en: \bI hope you'll show me that your skill as a trainer surpasses even mine.
it: \bSpero che mi mostrerai che la tua abilità di Allenatore supera persino la mia.

id: \bGrant: There are some things that seem out of reach no matter how hard you try.
en: \bGrant: There are some things that seem out of reach no matter how hard you try.
it: \bLino: Ci sono cose che sembrano irraggiungibili, per quanto ci si impegni.

id: \bHowever, it's important that you never give up, no matter the opponent or the odds!
en: \bHowever, it's important that you never give up, no matter the opponent or the odds!
it: \bTuttavia, è importante non arrendersi mai, qualunque sia l'avversario o le probabilità!

id: \rKorrina: Haha! Time for Lady Korrina's grand appearance! Just kidding! Nice to meet you!
en: \rKorrina: Haha! Time for Lady Korrina's grand appearance! Just kidding! Nice to meet you!
it: \rOrnella: Ahah! È il momento della grande entrata in scena di Lady Ornella! Scherzo! Piacere di conoscerti!

id: \rI was doing some special training with my Lucario when all of a sudden, it was drawn in by your aura and dashed off here.
en: \rI was doing some special training with my Lucario when all of a sudden, it was drawn in by your aura and dashed off here.
it: \rStavo facendo un allenamento speciale con il mio Lucario quando all'improvviso è stato attratto dalla tua aura ed è corso fin qui.

id: \rI think Lucario wants to battle with you. Would you accept our challenge?
en: \rI think Lucario wants to battle with you. Would you accept our challenge?
it: \rCredo che Lucario voglia lottare con te. Accetteresti la nostra sfida?

id: \rKorrina: Oh! I have been defeated! Alack, alay! Lady Korrina gave a terrible display.
en: \rKorrina: Oh! I have been defeated! Alack, alay! Lady Korrina gave a terrible display.
it: \rOrnella: Oh! Sono stata sconfitta! Ahimè, che sventura! Lady Ornella ha fatto una pessima figura.

id: \rWhat an explosive display of strength, far exceeding mine!
en: \rWhat an explosive display of strength, far exceeding mine!
it: \rChe esplosiva dimostrazione di forza, ben superiore alla mia!

id: \bRamos: Ho ho! I may not look it, but I'm the best green fingers yer could meet. If yeh want to know about plants, I'm yer man.
en: \bRamos: Ho ho! I may not look it, but I'm the best green fingers yer could meet. If yeh want to know about plants, I'm yer man.
it: \bAmur: Oh oh! Non sembra, ma sono il miglior pollice verde che potresti incontrare. Se vuoi sapere qualcosa sulle piante, sono l'uomo giusto.

id: \bSo what'd yer think, whippersnapper? Did yeh enjoy the greenery along your path to being a Champion?
en: \bSo what'd yer think, whippersnapper? Did yeh enjoy the greenery along your path to being a Champion?
it: \bAllora, che ne pensi, giovanotto? Ti è piaciuto il verde lungo la strada per diventare Campione?

id: \bTheir survival is a sign of their strength. Yer sure yer up to facing all that?
en: \bTheir survival is a sign of their strength. Yer sure yer up to facing all that?
it: \bLa loro sopravvivenza è segno della loro forza. Sei sicuro di poter affrontare tutto questo?

id: \bRamos: Yer believe in yer Pokémon... And they believe in yer, too... Strength like mighty oaks.
en: \bRamos: Yer believe in yer Pokémon... And they believe in yer, too... Strength like mighty oaks.
it: \bAmur: Credi nei tuoi Pokémon... E anche loro credono in te... Una forza robusta come una quercia.

id: \bIt was a fine battle, young sprout. Yeh sure can't force a true friendship.
en: \bIt was a fine battle, young sprout. Yeh sure can't force a true friendship.
it: \bÈ stata una bella lotta, giovane germoglio. Una vera amicizia non si può certo forzare.

id: \bClemont: Hi! I like my Pokémon battles how I like my inventions. HIGH-VOLTAGE!
en: \bClemont: Hi! I like my Pokémon battles how I like my inventions. HIGH-VOLTAGE!
it: \bLem: Ciao! Mi piacciono le lotte Pokémon come le mie invenzioni. AD ALTA TENSIONE!

id: \bAnd Pokémon sure are mysterious... Even as far as science has come, there's still so much we don't know about them.
en: \bAnd Pokémon sure are mysterious... Even as far as science has come, there's still so much we don't know about them.
it: \bE i Pokémon sono proprio misteriosi... Nonostante i progressi della scienza, ci sono ancora tante cose che non sappiamo su di loro.

id: \bNonetheless, let's both do our best in battle. The future is now, thanks to science!
en: \bNonetheless, let's both do our best in battle. The future is now, thanks to science!
it: \bComunque, diamo entrambi il massimo in questa lotta. Il futuro è adesso, grazie alla scienza!

id: \bClemont: There's no shame in losing. I'm glad I get to learn something new thanks to strong challengers.
en: \bClemont: There's no shame in losing. I'm glad I get to learn something new thanks to strong challengers.
it: \bLem: Non c'è da vergognarsi a perdere. Sono contento di imparare qualcosa di nuovo grazie a sfidanti forti.

id: \bBut what I'm trying to do is just to enjoy everyday to the fullest with my Pokémon, while exploring the science that I love with my inventing.
en: \bBut what I'm trying to do is just to enjoy everyday to the fullest with my Pokémon, while exploring the science that I love with my inventing.
it: \bMa quello che cerco di fare è godermi ogni giorno al massimo con i miei Pokémon, esplorando la scienza che amo con le mie invenzioni.

id: \rValerie: Oh, if it isn't a young trainer. You've come fluttering down to me on a fortunate wind.
en: \rValerie: Oh, if it isn't a young trainer. You've come fluttering down to me on a fortunate wind.
it: \rValérie: Oh, ma guarda, un giovane Allenatore. Sei giunto svolazzando fino a me su un vento propizio.

id: \rThen I suppose you have earned yourself the right to battle me. I hope it proves entertaining to you.
en: \rThen I suppose you have earned yourself the right to battle me. I hope it proves entertaining to you.
it: \rAllora suppongo che tu ti sia guadagnato il diritto di sfidarmi. Spero che lo troverai divertente.

id: \rThe elusive Fairies may appear frail as a breeze and delicate as a bloom, but watch out.
en: \rThe elusive Fairies may appear frail as a breeze and delicate as a bloom, but watch out.
it: \rGli sfuggenti Pokémon Folletto possono sembrare fragili come una brezza e delicati come un fiore, ma fai attenzione.

id: \rValerie: Yes. A fine battle. Victory is captivating, is it not?
en: \rValerie: Yes. A fine battle. Victory is captivating, is it not?
it: \rValérie: Sì. Una bella lotta. La vittoria è affascinante, non trovi?

id: \r... ... ... Ah... Forgive me. I was so captivated, I forgot for a moment that it is yours.
en: \r... ... ... Ah... Forgive me. I was so captivated, I forgot for a moment that it is yours.
it: \r... ... ... Ah... Perdonami. Ero così affascinata che per un attimo ho dimenticato che è tua.

id: \rOlympia: The time has arrived for us to be standing here. I am Olympia.
en: \rOlympia: The time has arrived for us to be standing here. I am Olympia.
it: \rAstra: È giunto il momento per noi di trovarci qui. Io sono Astra.

id: \rNow our paths have intertwined and crossed. Our Pokémon as well.
en: \rNow our paths have intertwined and crossed.  Our Pokémon as well.
it: \rOra i nostri cammini si sono intrecciati e incrociati.  Anche quelli dei nostri Pokémon.

id: \rThis is a ritual to decide your fate and future. The battle begins!
en: \rThis is a ritual to decide your fate and future. The battle begins!
it: \rQuesto è un rituale che deciderà il tuo destino e il tuo futuro. Che la lotta abbia inizio!

id: \rOlympia: A testament of your skill. Proof of your power. A symbol of trust. Your Pokémon obey you.
en: \rOlympia: A testament of your skill. Proof of your power. A symbol of trust. Your Pokémon obey you.
it: \rAstra: Una testimonianza della tua abilità. Una prova del tuo potere. Un simbolo di fiducia. I tuoi Pokémon ti obbediscono.

id: \rCountless stars light your way forth. Have no limits.
en: \rCountless stars light your way forth. Have no limits.
it: \rInnumerevoli stelle illuminano il tuo cammino. Non porti limiti.

id: \bWulfric: Y'know what? Ice is both extremely hard and terribly fragile at the same time. You know what that means?
en: \bWulfric: Y'know what? Ice is both extremely hard and terribly fragile at the same time. You know what that means?
it: \bEdel: Sai una cosa? Il ghiaccio è al tempo stesso durissimo e fragilissimo. Sai cosa significa?

id: \bDepending on which Pokémon you choose, I could be your most challenging opponent yet or I could be a total pushover.
en: \bDepending on which Pokémon you choose, I could be your most challenging opponent yet or I could be a total pushover.
it: \bA seconda dei Pokémon che scegli, potrei essere il tuo avversario più impegnativo o una vera passeggiata.

id: \bBut that's all right. That's how it should be! Anyway, enough of my rambling! Let's get this show on the road!
en: \bBut that's all right. That's how it should be! Anyway, enough of my rambling! Let's get this show on the road!
it: \bMa va bene così. È così che dev'essere! Comunque, basta chiacchiere! Diamo inizio allo spettacolo!

id: \bWulfric: Impressive! Your Pokémon fought with great courage. I can tell that you've trained your Pokémon well.
en: \bWulfric: Impressive! Your Pokémon fought with great courage. I can tell that you've trained your Pokémon well.
it: \bEdel: Notevole! I tuoi Pokémon hanno lottato con grande coraggio. Si vede che li hai allenati bene.

id: \bYour Pokémon really threw everything they had into that battle just now. You truly are something, you know?
en: \bYour Pokémon really threw everything they had into that battle just now. You truly are something, you know?
it: \bI tuoi Pokémon hanno davvero dato tutto in questa lotta. Sei proprio forte, sai?

id: \rMalva: You're the illustrious one, are you? People know me as the Fire Pokémon user, Malva.
en: \rMalva: You're the illustrious one, are you? People know me as the Fire Pokémon user, Malva.
it: \rMalva: Sei tu quello illustre, eh? La gente mi conosce come Malva, l'esperta di Pokémon di tipo Fuoco.

id: \rDo your best, because if you can't impress me with your real strength, you'll never get far here.
en: \rDo your best, because if you can't impress me with your real strength, you'll never get far here.
it: \rDai il massimo, perché se non riesci a impressionarmi con la tua vera forza, qui non andrai lontano.

id: \rBut it should be a walk in the park for you, right? I'm burning up with my hatred for you, runt!
en: \rBut it should be a walk in the park for you, right? I'm burning up with my hatred for you, runt!
it: \rMa per te dovrebbe essere una passeggiata, giusto? Brucio dall'odio per te, moccioso!

id: \rMalva: Oooh, you wicked little Trainer! You're just too much, you know? You're so amusing that I just want to burn you up where you stand!
en: \rMalva: Oooh, you wicked little Trainer! You're just too much, you know? You're so amusing that I just want to burn you up where you stand!
it: \rMalva: Ooh, che Allenatore perfido! Sei davvero troppo, sai? Sei così divertente che vorrei incenerirti qui dove sei!

id: \rBut I'll let you live... I will definitely remember this battle!
en: \rBut I'll let you live... I will definitely remember this battle!
it: \rMa ti lascerò vivere... Mi ricorderò di sicuro di questa lotta!

id: \bSiebold: You there! Young lad! I have a question I must pose to you. Do you think Pokémon battling can ever be worthy of being called an art?
en: \bSiebold: You there! Young lad! I have a question I must pose to you. Do you think Pokémon battling can ever be worthy of being called an art?
it: \bNarciso: Tu! Giovanotto! Ho una domanda da porti. Pensi che le lotte Pokémon possano mai essere degne di essere chiamate arte?

id: \bYou see, cooking is the type of art that disappears as soon as it is completed. Pokémon battles are the same.
en: \bYou see, cooking is the type of art that disappears as soon as it is completed. Pokémon battles are the same.
it: \bVedi, la cucina è un tipo di arte che svanisce non appena è completata. Le lotte Pokémon sono uguali.

id: \bTo devote yourself entirely to such a life, made up of fleeting experiences, that is truly artful.
en: \bTo devote yourself entirely to such a life, made up of fleeting experiences, that is truly artful.
it: \bDedicarsi interamente a una vita simile, fatta di esperienze fugaci, è vera arte.

id: \bSiebold: Devote yourself entirely, so even that which will fade and disappear is ingrained forever upon your heart and mind!
en: \bSiebold: Devote yourself entirely, so even that which will fade and disappear is ingrained forever upon your heart and mind!
it: \bNarciso: Dedicati interamente, così che persino ciò che svanirà resti impresso per sempre nel tuo cuore e nella tua mente!

id: \bIt is the duty of both Trainers and Chefs to find the good in any raw materials they have to work with. There lies the answer to reaching ever higher.
en: \bIt is the duty of both Trainers and Chefs to find the good in any raw materials they have to work with.  There lies the answer to reaching ever higher.
it: \bÈ dovere sia degli Allenatori che degli Chef trovare il buono in qualsiasi materia prima abbiano a disposizione.  Lì sta la risposta per arrivare sempre più in alto.

id: \bWikstrom: Well met, young challenger! Verily am I the famed blade of hardened steel, Wikstrom!
en: \bWikstrom: Well met, young challenger! Verily am I the famed blade of hardened steel, Wikstrom!
it: \bTimeos: Ben trovato, giovane sfidante! In verità io sono la celebre lama d'acciaio temprato, Timeos!

id: \bWith my magnificent Pokémon at my side, I will reveal the scope of Trainer achievement!
en: \bWith my magnificent Pokémon at my side, I will reveal the scope of Trainer achievement!
it: \bCon i miei magnifici Pokémon al mio fianco, rivelerò la vera portata delle imprese di un Allenatore!

id: \bLet us both give our word that our contest shall be fair and honorable. Ready? En garde!
en: \bLet us both give our word that our contest shall be fair and honorable. Ready? En garde!
it: \bDiamoci entrambi la nostra parola che questa sfida sarà leale e onorevole. Pronto? En garde!

id: \bWikstrom: What sweet, glorious pain and joy now rock my mighty heart? My will, which even shakes spears, trembles at so fine a battle as this!
en: \bWikstrom: What sweet, glorious pain and joy now rock my mighty heart? My will, which even shakes spears, trembles at so fine a battle as this!
it: \bTimeos: Quale dolce e gloriosa pena e gioia scuotono ora il mio possente cuore? La mia volontà, che fa tremare persino le lance, vacilla davanti a una lotta sì splendida!

id: \bWhat now? I am undone! Good knight, you are indeed my equal, and worthy to proceed this lofty hall!
en: \bWhat now? I am undone! Good knight, you are indeed my equal, and worthy to proceed this lofty hall!
it: \bE ora? Sono sconfitto! Prode cavaliere, sei davvero mio pari, e degno di proseguire in questa nobile sala!

id: \rDrasna: Oh goodness, hello to you! Welcome, welcome. You must be a strong Trainer. That's just wonderful news!
en: \rDrasna: Oh goodness, hello to you! Welcome, welcome. You must be a strong Trainer. That's just wonderful news!
it: \rLila: Oh, santo cielo, ciao! Benvenuto, benvenuto. Devi essere un Allenatore forte. È una notizia meravigliosa!

id: \rWhen I was growing up, my grandparents raised me on tales of the Pokémon of time and space.
en: \rWhen I was growing up, my grandparents raised me on tales of the Pokémon of time and space.
it: \rDa piccola, i miei nonni mi hanno cresciuta con le leggende dei Pokémon del tempo e dello spazio.

id: \rIt's really thanks to those stories that I decided to become a Dragon type Trainer. Facing you will make my Pokémon grow like weeds!
en: \rIt's really thanks to those stories that I decided to become a Dragon type Trainer. Facing you will make my Pokémon grow like weeds!
it: \rÈ proprio grazie a quelle storie che ho deciso di diventare un'Allenatrice di Pokémon di tipo Drago. Affrontarti farà crescere i miei Pokémon come funghi!

id: \rDrasna: Oh, you! You're too much! You and your Pokémon are simply charming!
en: \rDrasna: Oh, you! You're too much! You and your Pokémon are simply charming!
it: \rLila: Oh, ma tu! Sei troppo! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon siete semplicemente adorabili!

id: \rWith your Pokémon, I'm sure you can beat every last one of us.
en: \rWith your Pokémon, I'm sure you can beat every last one of us.
it: \rCon i tuoi Pokémon, sono sicura che puoi battere ognuno di noi.

id: \rDiantha: Welcome trainer. Since I'm an actress, sometimes people will talk to me because they're fans of mine!
en: \rDiantha: Welcome trainer. Since I'm an actress, sometimes people will talk to me because they're fans of mine!
it: \rDiantha: Benvenuto, Allenatore. Dato che sono un'attrice, a volte la gente mi parla perché è una mia fan!

id: \rOften, they'll say that watching me act gave them courage or cheered them up! But I also get a lot of energy from my fans when I meet them!
en: \rOften, they'll say that watching me act gave them courage or cheered them up! But I also get a lot of energy from my fans when I meet them!
it: \rSpesso mi dicono che vedermi recitare ha dato loro coraggio o li ha tirati su di morale! Ma anche io ricevo tantissima energia dai miei fan quando li incontro!

id: \rYou know, I'd really love to learn more about how a strong Trainer like you raises your Pokémon, brimming with hope for the future.
en: \rYou know, I'd really love to learn more about how a strong Trainer like you raises your Pokémon, brimming with hope for the future.
it: \rSai, mi piacerebbe davvero scoprire di più su come un Allenatore forte come te cresce i suoi Pokémon, pieno di speranza per il futuro.

id: \rDiantha: I-I'm so choked up that it's hard to know what I should say, but I... I... I'm just so glad at this moment.
en: \rDiantha: I-I'm so choked up that it's hard to know what I should say, but I... I... I'm just so glad at this moment.
it: \rDiantha: S-sono così commossa che non so bene cosa dire, ma io... io... sono semplicemente felicissima in questo momento.

id: \rAfter all, it gave me the chance to meet and battle with you and your wonderful Pokémon!
en: \rAfter all, it gave me the chance to meet and battle with you and your wonderful Pokémon!
it: \rDopotutto, mi ha dato l'occasione di conoscere te e i tuoi meravigliosi Pokémon e di lottare con voi!

id: \rShauna: Hey hey! Nice to meet you! Did you have fun here?
en: \rShauna: Hey hey! Nice to meet you! Did you have fun here?
it: \rShana: Ehi ehi! Piacere di conoscerti! Ti sei divertito qui?

id: \rHey, do you know what's about to happen? That's right! We're going to battle! We ARE Pokémon Trainers, after all!
en: \rHey, do you know what's about to happen? That's right! We're going to battle! We ARE Pokémon Trainers, after all!
it: \rEhi, lo sai cosa sta per succedere? Esatto! Stiamo per lottare! Dopotutto SIAMO Allenatori di Pokémon!

id: \rI'm sure we're gonna be great friends. Hey! Can we see the Pokémon now? I want to meet them too!
en: \rI'm sure we're gonna be great friends. Hey! Can we see the Pokémon now? I want to meet them too!
it: \rSono sicura che diventeremo grandi amici. Ehi! Possiamo vedere i Pokémon adesso? Voglio conoscerli anch'io!

id: \rShauna: I'm so glad I went on a journey. I made some great friends.
en: \rShauna: I'm so glad I went on a journey. I made some great friends.
it: \rShana: Sono così contenta di essere partita per il mio viaggio. Mi sono fatta dei grandi amici.

id: \rI was able to visit many places, meet a lot of nice people, and make many wonderful memories! I bet you are the same too!
en: \rI was able to visit many places, meet a lot of nice people, and make many wonderful memories! I bet you are the same too!
it: \rHo potuto visitare tanti posti, conoscere un sacco di persone simpatiche e creare tantissimi bei ricordi! Scommetto che vale anche per te!

id: \bTierno: All right! Nice to meetcha! Y'know, it'd feel like we were closer if we called each other by nicknames.
en: \bTierno: All right! Nice to meetcha! Y'know, it'd feel like we were closer if we called each other by nicknames.
it: \bTierno: Grande! Piacere di conoscerti! Sai, ci sentiremmo più vicini se ci chiamassimo con dei soprannomi.

id: \bCan I call you Jammy? Hahaha! Alright, lighten up!
en: \bCan I call you Jammy? Hahaha! Alright, lighten up!
it: \bPosso chiamarti Jammy? Ahahah! Dai, rilassati!

id: \bAnyway, can we have a Pokémon battle? Oh, uh... sorry to just throw that at you. But that's why we're here, right?
en: \bAnyway, can we have a Pokémon battle? Oh, uh... sorry to just throw that at you. But that's why we're here, right?
it: \bComunque, possiamo fare una lotta Pokémon? Oh, ehm... scusa se te lo chiedo così di punto in bianco. Ma è per questo che siamo qui, no?

id: \bTierno: That's awesome, it makes me wanna dance right now!
en: \bTierno: That's awesome, it makes me wanna dance right now!
it: \bTierno: Fantastico, mi fa venire voglia di ballare subito!

id: \bThat display of strength makes me wanna groove and spin in excitement!
en: \bThat display of strength makes me wanna groove and spin in excitement!
it: \bUna tale dimostrazione di forza mi fa venire voglia di scatenarmi e girare su me stesso dall'emozione!

id: \bTrevor: Um, hi. I'm Trevor. My dream is to see all kinds of Pokemon the world has to offer!
en: \bTrevor: Um, hi. I'm Trevor. My dream is to see all kinds of Pokemon the world has to offer!
it: \bTrovato: Ehm, ciao. Sono Trovato. Il mio sogno è vedere tutti i tipi di Pokémon che il mondo ha da offrire!

id: \bTherefore I'm on the journey with my Pokedex to travel high mountains and wide seas.
en: \bTherefore I'm on the journey with my Pokedex to travel high mountains and wide seas.
it: \bPer questo sono in viaggio con il mio Pokédex, tra alte montagne e vasti mari.

id: \bThat doesn't mean I can't battle though. Let's go!
en: \bThat doesn't mean I can't battle though. Let's go!
it: \bMa questo non significa che non sappia lottare. Andiamo!

id: \bTrevor: There is still so much I don't know. Do I just not have what it takes?
en: \bTrevor: There is still so much I don't know. Do I just not have what it takes?
it: \bTrovato: Ci sono ancora così tante cose che non so. Forse non ho la stoffa?

id: \bOh, so you can't learn everything just from the Pokédex... I see!
en: \bOh, so you can't learn everything just from the Pokédex... I see!
it: \bOh, quindi non si può imparare tutto solo dal Pokédex... Capisco!

id: \rSerena: Hi there! My name's Serena. I turn my friendship with my Pokémon into pure strength!
en: \rSerena: Hi there! My name's Serena. I turn my friendship with my Pokémon into pure strength!
it: \rSerena: Ciao! Mi chiamo Serena. Trasformo l'amicizia con i miei Pokémon in pura forza!

id: \rYou are special. I feel like the friendship we have with our Pokémon connects us.
en: \rYou are special. I feel like the friendship we have with our Pokémon connects us.
it: \rTu sei speciale. Sento che l'amicizia che abbiamo con i nostri Pokémon ci unisce.

id: \rWoohoo! Can't wait to see what we can do! Eeheehee, we're going to get started!
en: \rWoohoo! Can't wait to see what we can do!  Eeheehee, we're going to get started!
it: \rEvviva! Non vedo l'ora di vedere cosa sappiamo fare! Ihihih, cominciamo!

id: \rSerena: Everyone has their own good points. That's true of people and Pokémon alike!
en: \rSerena: Everyone has their own good points. That's true of people and Pokémon alike!
it: \rSerena: Ognuno ha i suoi pregi. Vale sia per le persone che per i Pokémon!

id: \rI've definitely noticed what your good points are! I'll bet you anything your Pokémon have noticed, too.
en: \rI've definitely noticed what your good points are! I'll bet you anything your Pokémon have noticed, too.
it: \rIo ho notato eccome quali sono i tuoi pregi! Scommetto qualsiasi cosa che se ne sono accorti anche i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bCalem: Hi, I'm Calem. I'm gonna keep pushing forward till I'm the strongest I can be!
en: \bCalem: Hi, I'm Calem. I'm gonna keep pushing forward till I'm the strongest I can be!
it: \bCalem: Ciao, sono Calem. Continuerò ad andare avanti finché non sarò il più forte possibile!

id: \bI think it would be fun to compete to see who's stronger. But we can't call it a competition unless I beat you at least once!
en: \bI think it would be fun to compete to see who's stronger. But we can't call it a competition unless I beat you at least once!
it: \bCredo che sarebbe divertente sfidarci per vedere chi è il più forte. Ma non si può parlare di sfida finché non ti batto almeno una volta!

id: \bAll right, let's do this. Come on, everyone!
en: \bAll right, let's do this. Come on, everyone!
it: \bBene, facciamolo. Forza, ragazzi!

id: \bCalem: You're one of my best opponents! You might come up with new strategies that'll help battles go a lot smoother.
en: \bCalem: You're one of my best opponents! You might come up with new strategies that'll help battles go a lot smoother.
it: \bCalem: Sei uno dei miei avversari migliori! Potresti inventare nuove strategie che rendano le lotte molto più fluide.

id: \bBefore you ask, no, I'm not going to tell you what strategies I use next time!
en: \bBefore you ask, no, I'm not going to tell you what strategies I use next time!
it: \bE prima che tu me lo chieda: no, non ti dirò quali strategie userò la prossima volta!

id: \bIlima: Greetings! I couldn't help but observe your battles. You looked so very delightful in battle that I had no choice but to summon you here.
en: \bIlima: Greetings! I couldn't help but observe your battles. You looked so very delightful in battle that I had no choice but to summon you here.
it: \bIlima: Salve! Non ho potuto fare a meno di osservare le tue lotte. Eri così incantevole in battaglia che non ho avuto altra scelta che convocarti qui.

id: \bI must admit, I've been wondering about you. I look forward to seeing the brilliance of your moves in my trial.
en: \bI must admit, I've been wondering about you. I look forward to seeing the brilliance of your moves in my trial.
it: \bDevo ammetterlo, mi sono chiesto molte cose su di te. Non vedo l'ora di ammirare lo splendore delle tue mosse nella mia prova.

id: \bVery well then! Behold the magnificent Pokémon of the one and only Ilima!
en: \bVery well then! Behold the magnificent Pokémon of the one and only Ilima!
it: \bE sia, dunque! Ammira i magnifici Pokémon dell'unico e inimitabile Ilima!

id: \bIlima: You, or should I say you and your Pokémon, make quite the interesting team!
en: \bIlima: You, or should I say you and your Pokémon, make quite the interesting team!
it: \bIlima: Tu, o dovrei dire tu e i tuoi Pokémon, formate una squadra davvero interessante!

id: \bI'll be feeling the aftershocks from that battle for a long time to come.
en: \bI'll be feeling the aftershocks from that battle for a long time to come.
it: \bSentirò gli strascichi di questa lotta ancora per molto tempo.

id: \rLana: Hello. I'm Lana. I used to go fishing a lot with my twin sisters, so you could also say it's one of my talents!
en: \rLana: Hello. I'm Lana. I used to go fishing a lot with my twin sisters, so you could also say it's one of my talents!
it: \rSuiren: Ciao. Sono Suiren. Andavo spesso a pescare con le mie sorelline gemelle, quindi si può dire che sia uno dei miei talenti!

id: \rYou look like an able-bodied Trainer. We could go fishing for wild Pokémon together then!
en: \rYou look like an able-bodied Trainer. We could go fishing for wild Pokémon together then!
it: \rSembri un Allenatore in gamba. Allora potremmo andare a pescare Pokémon selvatici insieme!

id: \rBut more important than that… I will show you what a serious Lana can do!
en: \rBut more important than that… I will show you what a serious Lana can do!
it: \rMa prima di tutto... ti mostrerò cosa sa fare Suiren quando fa sul serio!

id: \rLana: Phew... that was fantastic! You and your Pokémon were perfectly in sync!
en: \rLana: Phew... that was fantastic! You and your Pokémon were perfectly in sync!
it: \rSuiren: Uff... è stato fantastico! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon eravate in perfetta sintonia!

id: \rIt seems I was too early to think that my full power would be enough to defeat you.
en: \rIt seems I was too early to think that my full power would be enough to defeat you.
it: \rA quanto pare ho pensato troppo presto che la mia piena potenza sarebbe bastata a sconfiggerti.

id: \bKiawe: The name's Kiawe. My Marowak and I are students of the ancient dances that have been passed down in Alola for generations.
en: \bKiawe: The name's Kiawe. My Marowak and I are students of the ancient dances that have been passed down in Alola for generations.
it: \bKiawe: Mi chiamo Kiawe. Io e il mio Marowak studiamo le antiche danze tramandate ad Alola da generazioni.

id: \bI'll fully display the vaunted dancing of my Pokémon! Win or lose, there's never enough dancing!
en: \bI'll fully display the vaunted dancing of my Pokémon!  Win or lose, there's never enough dancing!
it: \bMostrerò in tutto il suo splendore la celebre danza dei miei Pokémon! Che si vinca o si perda, non si balla mai abbastanza!

id: \bKiawe: Astounding! Being thrilled by an opponent's excitement... Nothing else makes me want to battle more!
en: \bKiawe: Astounding! Being thrilled by an opponent's excitement... Nothing else makes me want to battle more!
it: \bKiawe: Sbalorditivo! Farmi trascinare dall'entusiasmo dell'avversario... Niente mi fa venire più voglia di lottare!

id: \bYes... That's exactly the sort of intense training that made me who I am today.
en: \bYes... That's exactly the sort of intense training that made me who I am today.
it: \bSì... È proprio questo genere di allenamento intenso che mi ha reso ciò che sono oggi.

id: \rMallow: Hey! Thanks for coming! Have you had breakfast yet? I've got a Super Mallow Special for you, if you're hungry!
en: \rMallow: Hey! Thanks for coming! Have you had breakfast yet? I've got a Super Mallow Special for you, if you're hungry!
it: \rIbis: Ehi! Grazie di essere venuto! Hai già fatto colazione? Se hai fame, ho per te uno Speciale Super Ibis!

id: \rYou aren't? OK. But remember to take a break here and there. A Pokémon master doesn't always go hustling.
en: \rYou aren't? OK. But remember to take a break here and there. A Pokémon master doesn't always go hustling.
it: \rNo? Va bene. Ma ricordati di fare una pausa ogni tanto. Un Maestro di Pokémon non corre sempre a perdifiato.

id: \rI use my chef's intuition to pick out the cream of the crop! Let's get cooking into the heat of battle then!
en: \rI use my chef's intuition to pick out the cream of the crop! Let's get cooking into the heat of battle then!
it: \rUso il mio intuito da chef per scegliere il meglio del meglio! Allora mettiamoci ai fornelli e scaldiamo la lotta!

id: \rMallow: Awwww, I lost. Guess now I'll have to get my Grass-type Pokémon to make me feel all better again...
en: \rMallow: Awwww, I lost. Guess now I'll have to get my Grass-type Pokémon to make me feel all better again...
it: \rIbis: Ooooh, ho perso. Mi sa che adesso dovrò farmi tirare su di morale dai miei Pokémon di tipo Erba...

id: \rAnd if you're hungry next time, don't be shy! Step on up and have a bite!
en: \rAnd if you're hungry next time, don't be shy! Step on up and have a bite!
it: \rE se la prossima volta hai fame, non fare il timido! Fatti avanti e assaggia qualcosa!

id: \bSophocles: Hi, I'm not really the greatest around other people. When people stare at me, I...
en: \bSophocles: Hi, I'm not really the greatest around other people. When people stare at me, I...
it: \bChrys: Ciao, non me la cavo granché con le altre persone. Quando la gente mi fissa, io...

id: \bYou may not have noticed, but I just fainted, like, three times... I'm trying really hard to get used to other people looking at me.
en: \bYou may not have noticed, but I just fainted, like, three times... I'm trying really hard to get used to other people looking at me.
it: \bForse non te ne sei accorto, ma sono appena svenuto tipo tre volte... Mi sto impegnando tantissimo per abituarmi agli sguardi degli altri.

id: \bUm! If you have some time, could you teach me some tips on confidence while battling me?
en: \bUm! If you have some time, could you teach me some tips on confidence while battling me?
it: \bEhm! Se hai un po' di tempo, potresti darmi qualche consiglio per avere più sicurezza mentre lotti con me?

id: \bSophocles: I'm shy... and I've certainly felt lonely before, but I'm great with robotics.
en: \bSophocles: I'm shy... and I've certainly felt lonely before, but I'm great with robotics.
it: \bChrys: Sono timido... e di sicuro mi sono sentito solo, a volte, ma sono bravissimo con la robotica.

id: \bWhat? You're interested in how machines are constructed? Why didn't you say so sooner?
en: \bWhat? You're interested in how machines are constructed? Why didn't you say so sooner?
it: \bCosa? Ti interessa sapere come si costruiscono le macchine? Perché non me l'hai detto prima?

id: \rMina: Oh! Please pose over there. Yes! Fantastic! Now that's a great composition! I could paint a picture of you!
en: \rMina: Oh! Please pose over there. Yes! Fantastic!  Now that's a great composition! I could paint a picture of you!
it: \rMina: Oh! Mettiti in posa lì, per favore. Sì! Fantastico! Questa sì che è una bella composizione! Potrei dipingerti un ritratto!

id: \rGuess I didn't introduce myself though. I'm Mina, a painter. I mean, I sort of am, actually just wander around doing my art.
en: \rGuess I didn't introduce myself though. I'm Mina, a painter.  I mean, I sort of am, actually just wander around doing my art.
it: \rMa non mi sono presentata. Sono Mina, una pittrice. Cioè, più o meno: in realtà vado in giro a fare la mia arte.

id: \rMaybe your battling skills will be a masterpiece! Let's get going!
en: \rMaybe your battling skills will be a masterpiece! Let's get going!
it: \rMagari le tue doti in lotta saranno un capolavoro! Cominciamo!

id: \rMina: Hrmmm! Well, this is frustrating. I failed to really use my full power...
en: \rMina: Hrmmm! Well, this is frustrating. I failed to really use my full power...
it: \rMina: Mmmh! Beh, che frustrazione. Non sono riuscita a usare davvero tutta la mia forza...

id: \rI'd like to draw a picture of the way you look when you're battling! Let's have another full-power Pokémon battle again sometime, yeah?
en: \rI'd like to draw a picture of the way you look when you're battling! Let's have another full-power Pokémon battle again sometime, yeah?
it: \rMi piacerebbe disegnarti mentre lotti! Facciamo di nuovo una lotta Pokémon al massimo delle forze, prima o poi, ok?

id: \rLillie: Nice to meet you! My name's Lillie. Starting the day off with a warm smile and a greeting always puts me in a great mood!
en: \rLillie: Nice to meet you! My name's Lillie. Starting the day off with a warm smile and a greeting always puts me in a great mood!
it: \rLylia: Piacere di conoscerti! Mi chiamo Lylia. Iniziare la giornata con un sorriso caloroso e un saluto mi mette sempre di ottimo umore!
