id: \rThere are trainers here who come to challenge you to battles, so you can't let your guard down!
en: \rThere are trainers here who come to challenge you to battles, so you can't let your guard down!
it: \rQui ci sono Allenatori che vengono a sfidarti, quindi non puoi abbassare la guardia!

id: \rI'll do my best so that no Pokémon have to end up getting hurt!
en: \rI'll do my best so that no Pokémon have to end up getting hurt!
it: \rFarò del mio meglio perché nessun Pokémon finisca per farsi male!

id: \rLillie: Ugh, you got us. I wish we'd had a little more time to prepare. That's all.
en: \rLillie: Ugh, you got us. I wish we'd had a little more time to prepare. That's all.
it: \rLylia: Uffa, ci hai battuti. Avrei voluto avere un po' più di tempo per prepararci. Tutto qui.

id: \rWell, moping around won't fix anything, will it? Come on, let's try to cheer up!
en: \rWell, moping around won't fix anything, will it?  Come on, let's try to cheer up!
it: \rBeh, piangersi addosso non risolve niente, no? Dai, cerchiamo di tirarci su!

id: \bNanu: You there, if do you wanna take this spot? I'd like to go home. I just wanna take it easy, y'know.
en: \bNanu: You there, if do you wanna take this spot?  I'd like to go home. I just wanna take it easy, y'know.
it: \bNanu: Ehi, tu, vuoi prendere il mio posto? Io vorrei tornarmene a casa. Voglio solo starmene tranquillo, sai.

id: \bYou're here to challenge me? What a hassle, crud. This is bad news. Well, I can't just ignore something like this.
en: \bYou're here to challenge me? What a hassle, crud. This is bad news. Well, I can't just ignore something like this.
it: \bSei qui per sfidarmi? Che seccatura, accidenti. Brutta storia. Beh, non posso far finta di niente.

id: \bDon't take it too serious now. You'll tire yourself out if you're always in a rush.
en: \bDon't take it too serious now. You'll tire yourself out if you're always in a rush.
it: \bNon prenderla troppo sul serio. Ti stancherai, se vai sempre di fretta.

id: \bNanu: I'm an old man. I try not to have dreams anymore. As long as young kids like you enjoy yourselves, that's all I can ask for.
en: \bNanu: I'm an old man. I try not to have dreams anymore. As long as young kids like you enjoy yourselves, that's all I can ask for.
it: \bNanu: Sono un vecchio. Cerco di non avere più sogni. Finché i ragazzi come te si divertono, non chiedo altro.

id: \bTrying to get even stronger is fine, too... But that's a really long path.
en: \bTrying to get even stronger is fine, too... But that's a really long path.
it: \bAnche cercare di diventare ancora più forte va bene... Ma è una strada davvero lunga.

id: \rHapu: Alola! This is how we greet people in my hometown every morning.
en: \rHapu: Alola! This is how we greet people in my hometown every morning.
it: \rHapu: Alola! È così che ci salutiamo ogni mattina nel mio paese natale.

id: \rIt is good to wake up early! You should make the most of the time you have! Having to tend to the fields every morning has made me an early riser.
en: \rIt is good to wake up early! You should make the most of the time you have! Having to tend to the fields every morning has made me an early riser.
it: \rÈ bello svegliarsi presto! Devi sfruttare al massimo il tempo che hai! Dover curare i campi ogni mattina mi ha reso una persona mattiniera.

id: \rLooks like you are going to make a fine tale for yourself. Time to get serious.
en: \rLooks like you are going to make a fine tale for yourself. Time to get serious.
it: \rSembra che ti stia scrivendo una bella storia. È ora di fare sul serio.

id: \rHapu: Yes. It's unfortunate that we lost, but I guess we'll just have to cheer for you now.
en: \rHapu: Yes. It's unfortunate that we lost, but I guess we'll just have to cheer for you now.
it: \rHapu: Sì. Peccato aver perso, ma ora non ci resta che fare il tifo per te.

id: \rYou are undoubtedly a prodigious Trainer. You did an admirable job.
en: \rYou are undoubtedly a prodigious Trainer. You did an admirable job.
it: \rSei senza dubbio un Allenatore prodigioso. Hai fatto un lavoro ammirevole.

id: \rOlivia: Why hello there. Nice to meet you all, I'm Olivia. My partners are adorable, rugged little Rock-types. We'll grind you to dust.
en: \rOlivia: Why hello there. Nice to meet you all, I'm Olivia. My partners are adorable, rugged little Rock-types. We'll grind you to dust.
it: \rOlivia: Oh, ciao. Piacere di conoscervi, sono Olivia. I miei compagni sono adorabili e robusti tipi Roccia. Vi ridurremo in polvere.

id: \rOur skills are so polished, they're sparkling. I'm starting to feel like a polished diamond.
en: \rOur skills are so polished, they're sparkling. I'm starting to feel like a polished diamond.
it: \rLe nostre doti sono così levigate che brillano. Comincio a sentirmi un diamante lucidato.

id: \rYou can count on me, kid. Get ready for your hardest Pokémon battle yet!
en: \rYou can count on me, kid. Get ready for your hardest Pokémon battle yet!
it: \rPuoi contare su di me, ragazzo. Preparati alla lotta Pokémon più dura che tu abbia mai affrontato!

id: \rOlivia: Diamonds only sparkle after the coal is pushed to its absolute limit.
en: \rOlivia: Diamonds only sparkle after the coal is pushed to its absolute limit.
it: \rOlivia: I diamanti brillano solo dopo che il carbone è stato spinto al suo limite assoluto.

id: \rI think your journey will hold many surprises. I hope it holds many joys too.
en: \rI think your journey will hold many surprises. I hope it holds many joys too.
it: \rCredo che il tuo viaggio ti riserverà molte sorprese. Spero che ti riservi anche tante gioie.

id: \rKahili: Hi, I am a professional golfer and a trainer. I aim to perfect my skills as both.
en: \rKahili: Hi, I am a professional golfer and a trainer.  I aim to perfect my skills as both.
it: \rKahili: Ciao, sono una golfista professionista e un'Allenatrice. Il mio obiettivo è perfezionare le mie doti in entrambi i campi.

id: \rI aim to make my matches entertaining for the spectators. Besides, I enjoy playing the games that the audience enjoys watching.
en: \rI aim to make my matches entertaining for the spectators. Besides, I enjoy playing the games that the audience enjoys watching.
it: \rCerco di rendere i miei incontri divertenti per gli spettatori. E poi mi piace giocare le partite che il pubblico si diverte a guardare.

id: \rLet's see how far we can fly. The winds of victory will blow for me and my Pokémon!
en: \rLet's see how far we can fly. The winds of victory will blow for me and my Pokémon!
it: \rVediamo fin dove riusciamo a volare. I venti della vittoria soffieranno per me e i miei Pokémon!

id: \rKahili: Whew! Battling with you was like a refreshing breeze! Thank you.
en: \rKahili: Whew! Battling with you was like a refreshing breeze! Thank you.
it: \rKahili: Uff! Lottare con te è stato come una brezza rinfrescante! Grazie.

id: \rOh, are you interested in golf too? You could be talented. I'd be happy to teach you.
en: \rOh, are you interested in golf too? You could be talented. I'd be happy to teach you.
it: \rOh, ti interessa anche il golf? Potresti avere talento. Sarei felice di insegnarti.

id: \bMolayne: Hi, I was observing the stars until you came up... yawn... I'm still super sleepy.
en: \bMolayne: Hi, I was observing the stars until you came up... yawn... I'm still super sleepy.
it: \bMolayne: Ciao, stavo osservando le stelle finché non sei arrivato... uaaah... ho ancora un sonno tremendo.

id: \bIt's been a while since I've walked around in a new place and met so many new people. It's a nice feeling.
en: \bIt's been a while since I've walked around in a new place and met so many new people. It's a nice feeling.
it: \bEra da un po' che non giravo per un posto nuovo conoscendo così tante persone nuove. È una bella sensazione.

id: \bNow I've got to do what I can to keep up with the others. Let's battle!
en: \bNow I've got to do what I can to keep up with the others. Let's battle!
it: \bOra devo fare il possibile per stare al passo con gli altri. Lottiamo!

id: \bMolayne: In every situation, you pick the best moves and items. So I too have to rack my brain in battle...
en: \bMolayne: In every situation, you pick the best moves and items. So I too have to rack my brain in battle...
it: \bMolayne: In ogni situazione scegli le mosse e gli strumenti migliori. Quindi anch'io devo spremermi le meningi in lotta...

id: \bBut you outsmarted me in the end. You're second to none!
en: \bBut you outsmarted me in the end. You're second to none!
it: \bMa alla fine sei stato più astuto di me. Non sei secondo a nessuno!

id: \rAcerola: Hiya, I'm Acerola! I know I don't look it, but my family used to pretty much be royalty.
en: \rAcerola: Hiya, I'm Acerola! I know I don't look it, but my family used to pretty much be royalty.
it: \rAcerola: Ciao, sono Acerola! Lo so che non si direbbe, ma la mia famiglia un tempo era praticamente di sangue reale.

id: \rI love reading! Books can take us on journeys to fantastical worlds and tell the stories of people far away from us.
en: \rI love reading! Books can take us on journeys to fantastical worlds and tell the stories of people far away from us.
it: \rAdoro leggere! I libri ci portano in viaggio verso mondi fantastici e raccontano le storie di persone lontane da noi.

id: \rMaybe our battle will be one to be told in books for centuries too!
en: \rMaybe our battle will be one to be told in books for centuries too!
it: \rMagari anche la nostra lotta verrà raccontata nei libri per secoli!

id: \rAcerola: Phew! Well, there goes my hope of beating you to smithereens.
en: \rAcerola: Phew! Well, there goes my hope of beating you to smithereens.
it: \rAcerola: Uff! Beh, addio alla mia speranza di farti a pezzettini.

id: \rI hope we can keep doing fun things together! There's a whole world of exciting things for us to do out there!
en: \rI hope we can keep doing fun things together!  There's a whole world of exciting things for us to do out there!
it: \rSpero che continueremo a fare cose divertenti insieme! Là fuori c'è un mondo intero di cose emozionanti da fare!

id: \bHala: Dooot doo doo, just a kahuna on a stroll. Oh, a rare visitor! Hi, I'm Hala.
en: \bHala: Dooot doo doo, just a kahuna on a stroll. Oh, a rare visitor! Hi, I'm Hala.
it: \bHala: Tu-tu-tu, solo un kahuna a passeggio. Oh, un visitatore raro! Ciao, sono Hala.

id: \bYou'll meet people and Pokémon... and may sometimes encounter some things that can't be seen.
en: \bYou'll meet people and Pokémon... and may sometimes encounter some things that can't be seen.
it: \bIncontrerai persone e Pokémon... e a volte potresti imbatterti in cose che non si possono vedere.

id: \bThe more you think about these things, the stronger your mind and body will become! Let's clash!
en: \bThe more you think about these things, the stronger your mind and body will become! Let's clash!
it: \bPiù rifletti su queste cose, più la tua mente e il tuo corpo diventeranno forti! Scontriamoci!

id: \bHala: ...Hmmph! This result comes as no surprise to me. What a fine Trainer... and what fine Pokémon, too!
en: \bHala: ...Hmmph! This result comes as no surprise to me. What a fine Trainer... and what fine Pokémon, too!
it: \bHala: ...Mmh! Questo risultato non mi sorprende affatto. Che ottimo Allenatore... e che ottimi Pokémon!

id: \bA heart-pounding battle like that always sends a shiver through my whole body! I'm sure my Pokémon felt it, too!
en: \bA heart-pounding battle like that always sends a shiver through my whole body! I'm sure my Pokémon felt it, too!
it: \bUna lotta così emozionante mi fa sempre venire i brividi in tutto il corpo! Sono sicuro che anche i miei Pokémon li hanno sentiti!

id: \bHau: Hey, I'm Hau. Nice to meet you! I don't know anything about this place, so everything is so cool and fresh!
en: \bHau: Hey, I'm Hau. Nice to meet you! I don't know anything about this place, so everything is so cool and fresh!
it: \bHau: Ehi, sono Hau. Piacere di conoscerti! Non so niente di questo posto, quindi è tutto così forte e nuovo!

id: \bBattles aren't about whether you win or lose. They're about whether you have the will to win!
en: \bBattles aren't about whether you win or lose.  They're about whether you have the will to win!
it: \bNelle lotte non conta vincere o perdere. Conta avere la volontà di vincere!

id: \bI wanna do all the fun stuff! Let's battle!
en: \bI wanna do all the fun stuff! Let's battle!
it: \bVoglio fare tutte le cose divertenti! Lottiamo!

id: \bHau: We managed to pull off something pretty amazing, when my partners and I were all in sync and wanting the same thing.
en: \bHau: We managed to pull off something pretty amazing, when my partners and I were all in sync and wanting the same thing.
it: \bHau: Siamo riusciti a fare qualcosa di davvero incredibile, quando io e i miei compagni eravamo in sintonia e volevamo la stessa cosa.

id: \bBut looks like we're still one step away from being the strongest Trainer and team!
en: \bBut looks like we're still one step away from being the strongest Trainer and team!
it: \bMa sembra che ci manchi ancora un passo per diventare l'Allenatore e la squadra più forti!

id: \bGladion: What does a Pokémon Trainer really need to be successful?
en: \bGladion: What does a Pokémon Trainer really need to be successful?
it: \bIridio: Di cosa ha davvero bisogno un Allenatore di Pokémon per avere successo?

id: \bI trained for a long time trying to figure that out. I guess everyone might have their own answer.
en: \bI trained for a long time trying to figure that out. I guess everyone might have their own answer.
it: \bMi sono allenato a lungo cercando di capirlo. Immagino che ognuno possa avere la sua risposta.

id: \bBut at least for me... I want the strongest rival for myself.
en: \bBut at least for me... I want the strongest rival for myself.
it: \bMa almeno per quanto mi riguarda... voglio il rivale più forte di tutti.

id: \bGladion: I didn't beat you, but it was still worth it...
en: \bGladion: I didn't beat you, but it was still worth it...
it: \bIridio: Non ti ho battuto, ma ne è valsa comunque la pena...

id: \bAt the very least, I can appreciate your strength a lot more now than I could've before. Thanks. You've helped make us stronger.
en: \bAt the very least, I can appreciate your strength a lot more now than I could've before. Thanks. You've helped make us stronger.
it: \bPerlomeno ora so apprezzare la tua forza molto più di prima. Grazie. Ci hai aiutato a diventare più forti.

id: \rSelene: Alola! I'm Selene, there's been nonstop excitement ever since I arrived here!
en: \rSelene: Alola! I'm Selene, there's been nonstop excitement ever since I arrived here!
it: \rSelene: Alola! Sono Selene, da quando sono arrivata qui è stato un continuo di emozioni!

id: \rLet's be so energized today that we shine even brighter than the sun and the moon!
en: \rLet's be so energized today that we shine even brighter than the sun and the moon!
it: \rOggi diamoci così tanta carica da brillare più del sole e della luna!

id: \rI'm fired up to the max! Bring it on!
en: \rI'm fired up to the max! Bring it on!
it: \rSono carichissima! Fatti sotto!

id: \rSelene: Aww, that's a shame. But I'm lucky to be able to experience this excitement!
en: \rSelene: Aww, that's a shame. But I'm lucky to be able to experience this excitement!
it: \rSelene: Ooh, peccato. Ma sono fortunata a poter vivere un'emozione simile!

id: \rJust thinking about it makes me want to challenge you again!
en: \rJust thinking about it makes me want to challenge you again!
it: \rSolo a pensarci mi viene voglia di sfidarti di nuovo!

id: \bElio: Alola! My name's Elio. Isn't it amazing that someone was able to make something this huge?
en: \bElio: Alola! My name's Elio. Isn't it amazing that someone was able to make something this huge?
it: \bElio: Alola! Mi chiamo Elio. Non è incredibile che qualcuno sia riuscito a costruire una cosa così enorme?

id: \bThis club is pretty tough, but we make lots of lifelong memories by going through it.
en: \bThis club is pretty tough, but we make lots of lifelong memories by going through it.
it: \bQuesto club è piuttosto impegnativo, ma affrontandolo ci creiamo un sacco di ricordi che dureranno per sempre.

id: \bI'd be happy to show you what I'm capable of.
en: \bI'd be happy to show you what I'm capable of.
it: \bSarei felice di mostrarti di cosa sono capace.

id: \bElio: Whoa! You're strong. Looking great, buddy!
en: \bElio: Whoa! You're strong. Looking great, buddy!
it: \bElio: Wow! Sei forte. Grande, amico!

id: \bThe strength of friendship, being kind, having fun... Maybe I should say... we all got stronger together, huh?
en: \bThe strength of friendship, being kind, having fun...  Maybe I should say... we all got stronger together, huh?
it: \bLa forza dell'amicizia, la gentilezza, il divertimento... Forse dovrei dire... che siamo diventati tutti più forti insieme, eh?

id: \rMisty: Aiyeee! That makes me so angry!
en: \rMisty: Aiyeee! That makes me so angry!
it: \rMisty: Aaah! Mi fa arrabbiare da morire!

id: \bBack to brushin' up. You keep goin' like lightning!
en: \bBack to brushin' up. You keep goin' like lightning!
it: \bTorno ad allenarmi. E tu continua così, veloce come un fulmine!

id: \bBlaine: Impressive! You have shown your wits and knowledge to overcome me.
en: \bBlaine: Impressive! You have shown your wits and knowledge to overcome me.
it: \bBlaine: Notevole! Hai dimostrato l'astuzia e la conoscenza necessarie per superarmi.

id: \bMakes me all fired up for more! Be passionate! Feel the burning curiosity!
en: \bMakes me all fired up for more! Be passionate!  Feel the burning curiosity!
it: \bMi fa ardere dalla voglia di continuare! Sii appassionato! Senti bruciare la curiosità!

id: \bFalkner: People say wings can be clipped with a jolt... I won't allow such insults to my birds!
en: \bFalkner: People say wings can be clipped with a jolt... I won't allow such insults to my birds!
it: \bValerio: Si dice che una scossa possa tarpare le ali... Non permetterò simili insulti ai miei uccelli!

id: \bThey have not faced my magnificent wings that have taken me to greatest heights!
en: \bThey have not faced my magnificent wings that have taken me to greatest heights!
it: \bNon hanno mai affrontato le mie magnifiche ali, che mi hanno portato alle vette più alte!

id: \bI'll show you the real power of the glorious flying Pokémon! Winds, stay with me!
en: \bI'll show you the real power of the glorious flying Pokémon! Winds, stay with me!
it: \bTi mostrerò il vero potere dei gloriosi Pokémon volanti! Venti, siate con me!

id: \bFalkner: A defeat is a defeat. You are strong indeed.
en: \bFalkner: A defeat is a defeat. You are strong indeed.
it: \bValerio: Una sconfitta è una sconfitta. Sei davvero forte.

id: \bAs long as I have lofty ambitions, I can fly as far as I want. Just like you!
en: \bAs long as I have lofty ambitions, I can fly as far as I want. Just like you!
it: \bFinché avrò grandi ambizioni, potrò volare lontano quanto voglio. Proprio come te!

id: \bBugsy: You seems like a trainer with great knowledge in Pokémon.
en: \bBugsy: You seems like a trainer with great knowledge in Pokémon.
it: \bRaffaello: Sembri un Allenatore con una grande conoscenza dei Pokémon.

id: \bBut I never lose when it comes to Bug-type Pokémon. My research is going to make me an expert authority of them!
en: \bBut I never lose when it comes to Bug-type Pokémon. My research is going to make me an expert authority of them!
it: \bMa quando si tratta di Pokémon di tipo Coleottero non perdo mai. Le mie ricerche faranno di me la massima autorità in materia!

id: \bLet me demonstrate what I've learned from my studies.
en: \bLet me demonstrate what I've learned from my studies.
it: \bLascia che ti dimostri cosa ho imparato dai miei studi.

id: \bBugsy: Bug-type Pokémon are deep. There are many mysteries to explore.
en: \bBugsy: Bug-type Pokémon are deep. There are many mysteries to explore.
it: \bRaffaello: I Pokémon di tipo Coleottero sono profondi. Ci sono tanti misteri da esplorare.

id: \bBut I should start my studies of other Pokémon too. I'm grateful that you made me realize that.
en: \bBut I should start my studies of other Pokémon too.  I'm grateful that you made me realize that.
it: \bMa dovrei iniziare a studiare anche altri Pokémon. Ti sono grato per avermelo fatto capire.

id: \rWhitney: Hi! I'm Whitney. Pokémon are super-cute! Don't you think so?
en: \rWhitney: Hi! I'm Whitney. Pokémon are super-cute!  Don't you think so?
it: \rChiara: Ciao! Sono Chiara. I Pokémon sono super carini! Non trovi?

id: \rAnd since I am super-cute too, I am definitely good at this!
en: \rAnd since I am super-cute too, I am definitely good at this!
it: \rE visto che anch'io sono super carina, di sicuro sono bravissima in questo!

id: \rYou want a battle with me, the talented super-cute me? That's a warning hint!
en: \rYou want a battle with me, the talented super-cute me? That's a warning hint!
it: \rVuoi lottare con me, la talentuosa e super carina me? Ti ho avvisato!

id: \rWhitney: Waaaaaaahhhhhhh! You meanie!
en: \rWhitney: Waaaaaaahhhhhhh! You meanie!
it: \rChiara: Uaaaaaaahhhhhhh! Sei cattivo!

id: \rSniff... Don't think that this is over. I will get stronger next time!
en: \rSniff... Don't think that this is over. I will get stronger next time!
it: \rSniff... Non pensare che sia finita qui. La prossima volta sarò più forte!

id: \bMorty: Good of you to have come; I can see what others cannot.
en: \bMorty: Good of you to have come; I can see what others cannot.
it: \bAngelo: Bene, sei venuto. Io riesco a vedere ciò che gli altri non vedono.

id: \bAnd just a bit more... I would be a truly powerful trainer, worthy of meeting Ho-oh.
en: \bAnd just a bit more... I would be a truly powerful trainer, worthy of meeting Ho-oh.
it: \bE ancora un pochino... e sarò un Allenatore davvero potente, degno di incontrare Ho-Oh.

id: \bShow me the power you possess. You're going to help me reach that level!
en: \bShow me the power you possess. You're going to help me reach that level!
it: \bMostrami il potere che possiedi. Mi aiuterai a raggiungere quel livello!

id: \bMorty: I don't think our potentials are so different. But you seem to have something I don't...
en: \bMorty: I don't think our potentials are so different.  But you seem to have something I don't...
it: \bAngelo: Non credo che le nostre potenzialità siano così diverse. Ma tu sembri avere qualcosa che a me manca...

id: \bIf I battle with you next time, I will be able to see something new again... I look forward to it.
en: \bIf I battle with you next time, I will be able to see something new again... I look forward to it.
it: \bSe lotterò di nuovo con te, potrò vedere ancora qualcosa di nuovo... Non vedo l'ora.

id: \bChuck: WAHAHAH! So you've come to train under my wing? No? Then you just spoiled my training!
en: \bChuck: WAHAHAH! So you've come to train under my wing? No? Then you just spoiled my training!
it: \bFurio: UAHAHAH! Sei venuto ad allenarti sotto la mia guida? No? Allora mi hai rovinato l'allenamento!

id: \bLet me tell you, I'm tough enough to crush stones and shatter bones! Urggh! Oooarrgh!
en: \bLet me tell you, I'm tough enough to crush stones and shatter bones! Urggh! Oooarrgh!
it: \bLascia che te lo dica: sono abbastanza forte da frantumare pietre e spezzare ossa! Urgh! Uooargh!

id: \bWhat? It has nothing to do with Pokémon? That's true! Come on, we shall do battle!
en: \bWhat? It has nothing to do with Pokémon? That's true! Come on, we shall do battle!
it: \bCosa? Non c'entra niente con i Pokémon? È vero! Forza, lottiamo!

id: \bChuck: Losing to a kid. The next generation is doing great.
en: \bChuck: Losing to a kid. The next generation is doing great.
it: \bFurio: Battuto da un ragazzino. La nuova generazione se la cava alla grande.

id: \bBut a loss is a loss! From now on, I'm going to train 24 hours every day!
en: \bBut a loss is a loss! From now on, I'm going to train 24 hours every day!
it: \bMa una sconfitta è una sconfitta! D'ora in poi mi allenerò 24 ore al giorno, tutti i giorni!

id: \rJasmine: Oh... uh, hello. Do you love your Pokémon? Regardless of their appearance?
en: \rJasmine: Oh... uh, hello. Do you love your Pokémon? Regardless of their appearance?
it: \rJasmine: Oh... ehm, ciao. Vuoi bene ai tuoi Pokémon? A prescindere dal loro aspetto?

id: \rS-steel type Pokémon are hard, cold, sharp and really strong... but they yearn for gentle love and care too...
en: \rS-steel type Pokémon are hard, cold, sharp and really strong... but they yearn for gentle love and care too...
it: \rI P-Pokémon di tipo Acciaio sono duri, freddi, affilati e fortissimi... ma anche loro desiderano amore e cure gentili...

id: \rUm... I'm not lying. May I prove it to you...?
en: \rUm... I'm not lying. May I prove it to you...?
it: \rEhm... Non sto mentendo. Posso dimostrartelo...?

id: \rJasmine: Y-you are well-polished, in both skill and kindness...
en: \rJasmine: Y-you are well-polished, in both skill and kindness...
it: \rJasmine: S-sei ben temprato, sia nell'abilità che nella gentilezza...

id: \rUm... I don't know how to say this, but thank you for loving your Pokemon.
en: \rUm... I don't know how to say this, but thank you for loving your Pokemon.
it: \rEhm... Non so bene come dirlo, ma grazie per voler bene ai tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bPryce: I have been training since before you were even born. Pokemon, alike humans, have seen many experiences and suffering in our lives.
en: \bPryce: I have been training since before you were even born. Pokemon, alike humans, have seen many experiences and suffering in our lives.
it: \bAlfredo: Mi alleno da prima che tu nascessi. I Pokémon, come gli esseri umani, vivono molte esperienze e sofferenze nel corso della vita.

id: \bSince I am your elder, let me teach you what I mean by that.
en: \bSince I am your elder, let me teach you what I mean by that.
it: \bDato che sono più anziano di te, lascia che ti insegni cosa intendo.

id: \bPryce: Impressive prowess. It's rare to find a Trainer as good as you.
en: \bPryce: Impressive prowess. It's rare to find a Trainer as good as you.
it: \bAlfredo: Notevole bravura. È raro trovare un Allenatore bravo come te.

id: \bWhen snow melts, spring arrives. Cherish your time together with your Pokemon.
en: \bWhen snow melts, spring arrives. Cherish your time together with your Pokemon.
it: \bQuando la neve si scioglie, arriva la primavera. Fa' tesoro del tempo che passi con i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rClair: The audacity to look me in the eye. You are looking at the world's best Dragon-type Master here.
en: \rClair: The audacity to look me in the eye. You are looking at the world's best Dragon-type Master here.
it: \rSandra: Che sfacciataggine guardarmi negli occhi. Hai davanti la miglior Maestra di Pokémon di tipo Drago del mondo.

id: \rI can hold my own even against Elite Four members. To think you have the guts to challenge me.
en: \rI can hold my own even against Elite Four members.  To think you have the guts to challenge me.
it: \rRiesco a tenere testa persino ai membri dei Superquattro. E pensare che hai il fegato di sfidarmi.

id: \rI will use my full power against you. Let's do this!
en: \rI will use my full power against you. Let's do this!
it: \rUserò tutta la mia potenza contro di te. Facciamolo!

id: \rClair: What?! Here to brag about your victory? Fine. Congratuations! Happy now?
en: \rClair: What?! Here to brag about your victory? Fine.  Congratuations! Happy now?
it: \rSandra: Cosa?! Sei qui per vantarti della tua vittoria? E va bene. Congratulazioni! Contento ora?

id: \rGeez. You are a mysterious trainer, but you made me realise what is it that I lack of.
en: \rGeez. You are a mysterious trainer, but you made me realise what is it that I lack of.
it: \rUffa. Sei un Allenatore misterioso, ma mi hai fatto capire cosa mi manca.

id: \bWill: Welcome, you and Fate have chosen me. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Will.
en: \bWill: Welcome, you and Fate have chosen me. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Will.
it: \bPino: Benvenuto, tu e il Fato avete scelto me. Permettimi di presentarmi. Io sono Pino.

id: \bI have trained all around the world, to reach where people have acknowledged my might.
en: \bI have trained all around the world, to reach where people have acknowledged my might.
it: \bMi sono allenato in tutto il mondo, fino a far riconoscere a tutti la mia potenza.

id: \bLet me put on this show to convince you as well. Behold!
en: \bLet me put on this show to convince you as well.  Behold!
it: \bLascia che metta in scena questo spettacolo per convincere anche te. Ammira!

id: \bWill: I have observed your techniques - you're the best without a doubt. I have no regrets.
en: \bWill: I have observed your techniques - you're the best without a doubt. I have no regrets.
it: \bPino: Ho osservato le tue tecniche: sei il migliore, senza alcun dubbio. Non ho rimpianti.

id: \bThis battle will go down in history. I'm sure of it.
en: \bThis battle will go down in history. I'm sure of it.
it: \bQuesta lotta passerà alla storia. Ne sono certo.

id: \bKoga: Fwahahaha! So you found me, the one who lives in shadow. It makes me shiver with mirth.
en: \bKoga: Fwahahaha! So you found me, the one who lives in shadow. It makes me shiver with mirth.
it: \bKoga: Fuahahaha! Così hai trovato me, colui che vive nell'ombra. Mi fa fremere di divertimento.

id: \bMy intricate style will confound and destroy you. The true terrors are not merely about brute force.
en: \bMy intricate style will confound and destroy you.  The true terrors are not merely about brute force.
it: \bIl mio stile intricato ti confonderà e ti distruggerà. Il vero terrore non è solo questione di forza bruta.

id: \bPrepare to be the victim of my techniques... You shall see soon...
en: \bPrepare to be the victim of my techniques... You shall see soon...
it: \bPreparati a cadere vittima delle mie tecniche... Lo vedrai presto...

id: \bKoga: I have subjected you to everything I could muster. But my efforts failed. I must hone my skills.
en: \bKoga: I have subjected you to everything I could muster. But my efforts failed. I must hone my skills.
it: \bKoga: Ti ho sottoposto a tutto ciò che potevo. Ma i miei sforzi sono stati vani. Devo affinare le mie abilità.

id: \bI am looking forward to see you put your abilities to the test again.
en: \bI am looking forward to see you put your abilities to the test again.
it: \bNon vedo l'ora di vederti mettere di nuovo alla prova le tue capacità.

id: \bBruno: Extreme training results in unleashing untapped potential.
en: \bBruno: Extreme training results in unleashing untapped potential.
it: \bBruno: L'allenamento estremo libera un potenziale inespresso.

id: \bI see no fear in you. You're determined. So are you one of the strongest trainers around here?
en: \bI see no fear in you. You're determined. So are you one of the strongest trainers around here?
it: \bNon vedo paura in te. Sei determinato. Quindi sei uno degli Allenatori più forti da queste parti?

id: \bNevermind, I am challenging you! Bow down to our overwhelming power. Hoo hah!
en: \bNevermind, I am challenging you! Bow down to our overwhelming power. Hoo hah!
it: \bNon importa, ti sfido io! Inchinati alla nostra forza schiacciante. Hoo hah!

id: \bBruno: You are still standing firm. My challenge's satisfied.
en: \bBruno: You are still standing firm. My challenge's satisfied.
it: \bBruno: Sei ancora in piedi, saldo. La mia sfida è soddisfatta.

id: \bI have no other words. Do not trouble yourself on my behalf. Move forward!
en: \bI have no other words. Do not trouble yourself on my behalf. Move forward!
it: \bNon ho altre parole. Non preoccuparti per me. Va' avanti!

id: \rKaren: What now? You wanna challenge me? How amusing.
en: \rKaren: What now? You wanna challenge me? How amusing.
it: \rKaren: E adesso? Vuoi sfidarmi? Che divertente.

id: \rIf you have not heard of them, I'm known for my overpowering tactics. Think you can handle me?
en: \rIf you have not heard of them, I'm known for my overpowering tactics. Think you can handle me?
it: \rSe non ne hai sentito parlare, sono famosa per le mie tattiche schiaccianti. Pensi di potermi tenere testa?

id: \rTry me. Entertain me. Let's go.
en: \rTry me. Entertain me. Let's go.
it: \rProvaci. Divertimi. Andiamo.

id: \rKaren: There are no such thing as weak Pokemon. Truly skilled trainers would win with their loved ones.
en: \rKaren: There are no such thing as weak Pokemon.  Truly skilled trainers would win with their loved ones.
it: \rKaren: Non esistono Pokémon deboli. Gli Allenatori davvero abili vincerebbero con i loro preferiti.

id: \rI like your style. You know what's important. Hit me up whenever you are free again.
en: \rI like your style. You know what's important. Hit me up whenever you are free again.
it: \rMi piace il tuo stile. Sai cosa conta davvero. Fatti sentire quando sei di nuovo libero.

id: \bRoark: I'm but one Trainer who decided to walk proudly with Rock-type Pokémon. Everyday, we toughened ourselves by digging up Fossils.
en: \bRoark: I'm but one Trainer who decided to walk proudly with Rock-type Pokémon. Everyday, we toughened ourselves by digging up Fossils.
it: \bPedro: Sono solo un Allenatore che ha deciso di camminare a testa alta con i Pokémon di tipo Roccia. Ogni giorno ci tempriamo scavando Fossili.

id: \bCould I show you how tough we are? I need to see the toughness of the Pokémon that battle with you too!
en: \bCould I show you how tough we are? I need to see the toughness of the Pokémon that battle with you too!
it: \bPosso mostrarti quanto siamo tosti? Devo vedere anche quanto sono tosti i Pokémon che lottano con te!

id: \bThis'll be rocking!
en: \bThis'll be rocking!
it: \bSarà una lotta da spaccare le rocce!

id: \bRoark: We lost control there. With skill like yours, it's natural for you to win.
en: \bRoark: We lost control there. With skill like yours, it's natural for you to win.
it: \bPedro: Abbiamo perso il controllo. Con un'abilità come la tua, è naturale che tu abbia vinto.

id: \bNext time, I'd like to challenge you to a Fossil-digging race underground in the Sinnoh region!
en: \bNext time, I'd like to challenge you to a Fossil-digging race underground in the Sinnoh region!
it: \bLa prossima volta vorrei sfidarti a una gara di scavo di Fossili nel sottosuolo della regione di Sinnoh!

id: \rGardenia: I can't deny that Grass-types have many weak points, but that's not the only factor in deciding who wins!
en: \rGardenia: I can't deny that Grass-types have many weak points, but that's not the only factor in deciding who wins!
it: \rGardenia: Non posso negare che i tipi Erba abbiano molti punti deboli, ma non è l'unico fattore che decide chi vince!

id: \rMy Pokémon are growing good and strong. You can't go wrong with me! Come on, let's cut to the good stuff!
en: \rMy Pokémon are growing good and strong. You can't go wrong with me! Come on, let's cut to the good stuff!
it: \rI miei Pokémon stanno crescendo belli forti. Con me vai sul sicuro! Dai, passiamo alla parte migliore!

id: \rLet's get down to battle! A real quick one, OK?
en: \rLet's get down to battle! A real quick one, OK?
it: \rVeniamo alla lotta! Una cosa veloce, ok?

id: \rGardenia: How are you feeling? I wanted to win and brag about my Pokémon.
en: \rGardenia: How are you feeling? I wanted to win and brag about my Pokémon.
it: \rGardenia: Come ti senti? Io volevo vincere e vantarmi dei miei Pokémon.

id: \rI try to be as tough as I can, but you are the victor today. Amazing!
en: \rI try to be as tough as I can, but you are the victor today. Amazing!
it: \rCerco di essere più tosta che posso, ma oggi il vincitore sei tu. Incredibile!

id: \rMaylene: Nice to see you. I don't really know what it means to be strong, but I will do the best I can as a Trainer.
en: \rMaylene: Nice to see you. I don't really know what it means to be strong, but I will do the best I can as a Trainer.
it: \rMaylene: Piacere di vederti. Non so bene cosa significhi essere forti, ma farò del mio meglio come Allenatrice.

id: \rThanks to my training, I'm slowly gaining more confidence.
en: \rThanks to my training, I'm slowly gaining more confidence.
it: \rGrazie all'allenamento, sto lentamente acquistando più fiducia in me stessa.

id: \rI also take battling very seriously. Whenever you're ready!
en: \rI also take battling very seriously. Whenever you're ready!
it: \rAnche le lotte le prendo molto sul serio. Quando vuoi!

id: \rMaylene: Learn from your foe by wininng, and learn from your foe by losing too.
en: \rMaylene: Learn from your foe by wininng, and learn from your foe by losing too.
it: \rMaylene: Si impara dall'avversario vincendo, e si impara dall'avversario anche perdendo.

id: \rYes, everything is an experience. I've still got some room to grow!
en: \rYes, everything is an experience. I've still got some room to grow!
it: \rSì, ogni cosa è un'esperienza. Ho ancora margine per crescere!

id: \bCrasher Wake: The ring is my rolling sea~ The towering waves shaped me~ Crash! Crash! Crasher Wake~!
en: \bCrasher Wake: The ring is my rolling sea~ The towering waves shaped me~ Crash! Crash! Crasher Wake~!
it: \bOmar: Il ring è il mio mare in tempesta~ Le onde altissime mi hanno forgiato~ Crash! Crash! Ecco a voi Omar~!

id: \bMy Pokémon were toughened up by stormy white waters! They'll take everything you throw at them and then pull you under!
en: \bMy Pokémon were toughened up by stormy white waters! They'll take everything you throw at them and then pull you under!
it: \bI miei Pokémon sono stati temprati da acque bianche e tempestose! Incasseranno tutto ciò che gli lanci e poi ti trascineranno a fondo!

id: \bVictory will be ours! Come on, let's get it done!
en: \bVictory will be ours! Come on, let's get it done!
it: \bLa vittoria sarà nostra! Forza, facciamola finita!

id: \bCrasher Wake: Hwah! It's come and gone! How do I say this... I want more!
en: \bCrasher Wake: Hwah! It's come and gone! How do I say this... I want more!
it: \bOmar: Uah! È già finita! Come posso dirlo... Ne voglio ancora!

id: \bI have fun battling, regardless if I win or lose! I hope your victories will put more smiles on people's faces!
en: \bI have fun battling, regardless if I win or lose! I hope your victories will put more smiles on people's faces!
it: \bMi diverto a lottare, che vinca o che perda! Spero che le tue vittorie facciano sorridere ancora più persone!

id: \rFantina: Ah, oui, are you here for a challenge? I hope very much you enjoy them, you seem to be très strong.
en: \rFantina: Ah, oui, are you here for a challenge? I hope very much you enjoy them, you seem to be très strong.
it: \rFannie: Ah, oui, sei qui per una sfida? Spero tanto che ti divertirai, sembri très forte.

id: \rBut win I shall, non? Because moi is of course très fantastique!
en: \rBut win I shall, non? Because moi is of course très fantastique!
it: \rMa vincerò io, non? Perché moi è naturalmente très fantastique!

id: \rEnfin, so it shall be. I wish to show you battling à la danse classique.
en: \rEnfin, so it shall be. I wish to show you battling à la danse classique.
it: \rEnfin, così sia. Desidero mostrarti la lotta à la danse classique.

id: \rFantina: Excusè moi! Dumbfounded! Très très strong! Your power so admirable!
en: \rFantina: Excusè moi! Dumbfounded! Très très strong! Your power so admirable!
it: \rFannie: Excusez-moi! Sbalordita! Très très forte! Il tuo potere è così ammirevole!

id: \rMerci beacoup, for having this dance with moi! If ever you have time, see moi again, ok? Au revoir!
en: \rMerci beacoup, for having this dance with moi! If ever you have time, see moi again, ok? Au revoir!
it: \rMerci beaucoup per aver ballato con moi! Se mai hai tempo, torna a trovare moi, ok? Au revoir!

id: \bBryon: Trainer! You're young, just like my son Roark, on the quest to challenge the world.
en: \bBryon: Trainer! You're young, just like my son Roark, on the quest to challenge the world.
it: \bFerruccio: Allenatore! Sei giovane, proprio come mio figlio Pedro, in viaggio per sfidare il mondo.

id: \bWith more Trainers like you taking charge, the future of the Pokémon world is bright! But as a wall to you youngsters, I'm not stepping aside just yet!
en: \bWith more Trainers like you taking charge, the future of the Pokémon world is bright! But as a wall to you youngsters, I'm not stepping aside just yet!
it: \bCon tanti Allenatori come te a prendere in mano le cose, il futuro del mondo Pokémon è luminoso! Ma come muro per voi giovani, non ho ancora intenzione di farmi da parte!

id: \bI'll take your challenge. I have the confidence to withstand all your attacks!
en: \bI'll take your challenge. I have the confidence to withstand all your attacks!
it: \bAccetto la tua sfida. Sono sicuro di poter resistere a tutti i tuoi attacchi!

id: \bByron: Gwahahaha! You were strong enough to take down my prized team. I recognize your power.
en: \bByron: Gwahahaha! You were strong enough to take down my prized team. I recognize your power.
it: \bFerruccio: Gwahahaha! Sei stato abbastanza forte da abbattere la mia squadra migliore. Riconosco il tuo valore.

id: \bI saw something great in you. Do show your power to other Trainers too!
en: \bI saw something great in you. Do show your power to other Trainers too!
it: \bHo visto qualcosa di grande in te. Mostra la tua forza anche agli altri Allenatori!

id: \rCandice: You're going to be my opponent? Sure thing! I was waiting for someone tough!
en: \rCandice: You're going to be my opponent? Sure thing! I was waiting for someone tough!
it: \rBianca: Sarai tu il mio avversario? Ma certo! Aspettavo proprio qualcuno di tosto!

id: \rBut I should tell you, I'm tough because I know how to focus.
en: \rBut I should tell you, I'm tough because I know how to focus.
it: \rPerò ti avverto: sono forte perché so come concentrarmi.

id: \rI'll show you just what I mean. Get ready to lose!
en: \rI'll show you just what I mean. Get ready to lose!
it: \rTi faccio vedere cosa intendo. Preparati a perdere!

id: \rCandice: Wow! You're great! You've earned my respect! I think your focus and will bowled us over totally!
en: \rCandice: Wow! You're great! You've earned my respect! I think your focus and will bowled us over totally!
it: \rBianca: Wow! Sei grande! Ti sei guadagnato il mio rispetto! Credo che la tua concentrazione e la tua volontà ci abbiano travolti del tutto!

id: \rBut next time I'll focus even more and won't lose!
en: \rBut next time I'll focus even more and won't lose!
it: \rMa la prossima volta mi concentrerò ancora di più e non perderò!

id: \bVolkner: Sigh... Alright. It's not often that I get challengers. But they've all been boring.
en: \bVolkner: Sigh... Alright. It's not often that I get challengers. But they've all been boring.
it: \bCorrado: Sigh... E va bene. Non capita spesso che arrivino sfidanti. E comunque sono stati tutti noiosi.

id: \bI didn't break a sweat beating them all. But anyway, I guess we'd better get this done.
en: \bI didn't break a sweat beating them all. But anyway, I guess we'd better get this done.
it: \bLi ho battuti tutti senza nemmeno sudare. Ma vabbè, direi che è meglio togliersi il pensiero.

id: \bI hope you're the one who'll make me remember how fun it is to battle.
en: \bI hope you're the one who'll make me remember how fun it is to battle.
it: \bSpero che sarai tu a farmi ricordare quanto è divertente lottare.

id: \bVolkner: ...Hehehe. Hahahah! ...That was the most fun I've had since... I don't know when!
en: \bVolkner: ...Hehehe. Hahahah! ...That was the most fun I've had since... I don't know when!
it: \bCorrado: ...Ehehe. Ahahah! ...Non mi divertivo così da... non so nemmeno da quando!

id: \bIt makes me excited to know you and your team will keep battling at greater heights!
en: \bIt makes me excited to know you and your team will keep battling at greater heights!
it: \bMi elettrizza sapere che tu e la tua squadra continuerete a lottare sempre più in alto!

id: \bAaron: Hello! It's good to meet you! I should explain that I'm a huge fan of bugs.
en: \bAaron: Hello! It's good to meet you! I should explain that I'm a huge fan of bugs.
it: \bAaron: Ciao! Piacere di conoscerti! Devo dirti che sono un grandissimo appassionato di insetti.

id: \bThey might be nasty and mean, but they're beautiful too. Would you like to take on my challenge?
en: \bThey might be nasty and mean, but they're beautiful too. Would you like to take on my challenge?
it: \bSaranno anche cattivi e scontrosi, ma sono anche bellissimi. Vuoi accettare la mia sfida?

id: \bI want to become perfect, just like my Bug Pokémon. Let me take you on!
en: \bI want to become perfect, just like my Bug Pokémon.  Let me take you on!
it: \bVoglio diventare perfetto, proprio come i miei Pokémon Coleottero.  Fatti sotto!

id: \bAaron: Being perfect sure is a deep and complex affair. I will concede defeat, but I think you came to see how great Bug-type Pokémon can be!
en: \bAaron: Being perfect sure is a deep and complex affair. I will concede defeat, but I think you came to see how great Bug-type Pokémon can be!
it: \bAaron: Essere perfetti è proprio una faccenda profonda e complessa. Ammetto la sconfitta, ma credo che tu abbia capito quanto possono essere fantastici i Pokémon di tipo Coleottero!

id: \rBertha: Well, well. You're quite the adorable one, but you've got a spine. Ahaha! I'm Bertha.
en: \rBertha: Well, well. You're quite the adorable one, but you've got a spine. Ahaha! I'm Bertha.
it: \rTerrie: Bene, bene. Sei davvero adorabile, ma hai anche fegato. Ahaha! Io sono Terrie.

id: \rI have a preference for Ground-type Pokémon. Vast, wide and ever-embracing.
en: \rI have a preference for Ground-type Pokémon.  Vast, wide and ever-embracing.
it: \rHo un debole per i Pokémon di tipo Terra.  Vasti, ampi e sempre accoglienti.

id: \rWell, would you show this old lady how much you've learned?
en: \rWell, would you show this old lady how much you've learned?
it: \rAllora, vuoi mostrare a questa vecchietta quanto hai imparato?

id: \rBertha: You're quite something, youngster. I like how you and your Pokémon earned the win by working as one.
en: \rBertha: You're quite something, youngster. I like how you and your Pokémon earned the win by working as one.
it: \rTerrie: Sei davvero notevole, giovanotto. Mi piace come tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete conquistato la vittoria agendo come una cosa sola.

id: \rThat's what makes you so strong. Ahahaha! I think you can go as far as you want.
en: \rThat's what makes you so strong. Ahahaha! I think you can go as far as you want.
it: \rÈ questo che ti rende così forte. Ahahaha! Credo che potrai arrivare lontano quanto vorrai.

id: \bFlint: Yo! The name's Flint! Battles are clashes of the burning spirits of Pokémon, they ain't about appearances or what's weak or strong.
en: \bFlint: Yo! The name's Flint! Battles are clashes of the burning spirits of Pokémon, they ain't about appearances or what's weak or strong.
it: \bVulcano: Ehi! Mi chiamo Vulcano! Le lotte sono scontri tra gli spiriti ardenti dei Pokémon, non contano l'aspetto o chi è debole e chi è forte.

id: \bIt's about whether combatants can burn hot or not! I could feel your fiery spirits! Let me tell ya, my heart's always on fire!
en: \bIt's about whether combatants can burn hot or not! I could feel your fiery spirits! Let me tell ya, my heart's always on fire!
it: \bConta solo se i contendenti sanno bruciare o no! Ho sentito i vostri spiriti infuocati! Te lo dico io, il mio cuore è sempre in fiamme!

id: \bAll right, hotshot! Let's spice things up!
en: \bAll right, hotshot! Let's spice things up!
it: \bE va bene, fenomeno! Diamo un po' di pepe alla cosa!

id: \bFlint: Why I oughta...! I don't believe it! I lost! I didn't take you for granted... But I didnt expect you to win!
en: \bFlint: Why I oughta...! I don't believe it! I lost! I didn't take you for granted... But I didnt expect you to win!
it: \bVulcano: Ma come...! Non ci credo! Ho perso! Non ti ho sottovalutato... Ma non mi aspettavo che vincessi!

id: \bI'm blown away by this! You and your Pokémon are hot stuff!
en: \bI'm blown away by this! You and your Pokémon are hot stuff!
it: \bSono senza parole! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon siete roventi!

id: \bLucian: Ah, you timed your arrival well. I've just finished reading a book, you see.
en: \bLucian: Ah, you timed your arrival well. I've just finished reading a book, you see.
it: \bLuciano: Ah, sei arrivato al momento giusto. Ho appena finito di leggere un libro, sai.

id: \bAllow me to introduce myself. I am Lucian, a user of the Psychic-type. You've proven yourself to be outstanding getting here.
en: \bAllow me to introduce myself. I am Lucian, a user of the Psychic-type. You've proven yourself to be outstanding getting here.
it: \bPermettimi di presentarmi. Sono Luciano, esperto del tipo Psico. Arrivando fin qui hai dimostrato di essere eccezionale.

id: \bSo I'm afraid I will have to go all out against you to live up to my reputation.
en: \bSo I'm afraid I will have to go all out against you to live up to my reputation.
it: \bQuindi temo che dovrò dare il massimo contro di te, per essere all'altezza della mia reputazione.

id: \bLucian: The highs and lows. You are as remarkable as the book I just read.
en: \bLucian: The highs and lows. You are as remarkable as the book I just read.
it: \bLuciano: Alti e bassi. Sei notevole quanto il libro che ho appena letto.

id: \bPlease go through the exit to your right, while I'll be reading books to calm my nerves.
en: \bPlease go through the exit to your right, while I'll be reading books to calm my nerves.
it: \bProsegui pure dall'uscita alla tua destra, mentre io leggerò qualche libro per calmare i nervi.

id: \bCilan: Um. My name is Cilan. I like Grass-type Pokémon, they are always so deep and profound.
en: \bCilan: Um. My name is Cilan. I like Grass-type Pokémon, they are always so deep and profound.
it: \bSpighetto: Ehm. Mi chiamo Spighetto. Mi piacciono i Pokémon di tipo Erba, sono sempre così profondi e intensi.

id: \bWould you like to take part in a match against me? There's still much to learn for me.
en: \bWould you like to take part in a match against me? There's still much to learn for me.
it: \bTi andrebbe di affrontarmi in un incontro? Ho ancora molto da imparare.

id: \bNothing personal... No hard feelings... We're gonna battle, come what may.
en: \bNothing personal... No hard feelings... We're gonna battle, come what may.
it: \bNiente di personale... Senza rancore... Lotteremo, succeda quel che succeda.

id: \bCilan: What a surprise... You're very strong, aren't you? I guess my brothers wouldn't be able to defeat you either.
en: \bCilan: What a surprise... You're very strong, aren't you? I guess my brothers wouldn't be able to defeat you either.
it: \bSpighetto: Che sorpresa... Sei molto forte, vero? Credo che nemmeno i miei fratelli riuscirebbero a batterti.

id: \bI'm glad I was at least able to bring out the delectable charm of Grass-type Pokémon.
en: \bI'm glad I was at least able to bring out the delectable charm of Grass-type Pokémon.
it: \bSono contento di essere almeno riuscito a far emergere il delizioso fascino dei Pokémon di tipo Erba.

id: \bChili: Listen up! My name is Chili! I light things up with Fire-type Pokémon, like habanero tacos!
en: \bChili: Listen up! My name is Chili! I light things up with Fire-type Pokémon, like habanero tacos!
it: \bMaisello: Ascoltami bene! Mi chiamo Chicco! Accendo le cose con i Pokémon di tipo Fuoco, come dei tacos all'habanero!

id: \bThat's that, then! I'm going to show you what me and my blazing Pokémon can do!
en: \bThat's that, then! I'm going to show you what me and my blazing Pokémon can do!
it: \bE allora è deciso! Ti faccio vedere cosa sappiamo fare io e i miei Pokémon ardenti!

id: \bYou're fired up too, right? Get ready for the scorcher!
en: \bYou're fired up too, right? Get ready for the scorcher!
it: \bAnche tu sei carico, vero? Preparati a scottarti!

id: \bChili: Whoa ho! You're on fire! You scorched everyone, huh?
en: \bChili: Whoa ho! You're on fire! You scorched everyone, huh?
it: \bMaisello: Wow! Sei in fiamme! Li hai inceneriti tutti, eh?

id: \bBut you have to hand it to me for putting up a good fight, right?
en: \bBut you have to hand it to me for putting up a good fight, right?
it: \bMa devi ammettere che ti ho dato filo da torcere, no?

id: \bCress: Pleased to make your acquaintance, I'm Cress, a specialist in Water-type Pokémon. They're refreshing as I like it.
en: \bCress: Pleased to make your acquaintance, I'm Cress, a specialist in Water-type Pokémon.  They're refreshing as I like it.
it: \bChicco: Lieto di fare la tua conoscenza, sono Maisello, esperto di Pokémon di tipo Acqua.  Sono rinfrescanti, proprio come piace a me.

id: \bIt shall be my esteemed Pokémon and I that you must face in battle. Would you be so kind to oblige?
en: \bIt shall be my esteemed Pokémon and I that you must face in battle. Would you be so kind to oblige?
it: \bSaranno i miei stimati Pokémon e io che dovrai affrontare in battaglia. Saresti così gentile da accettare?

id: \bJust as water flowing from high places to low places is natural, so is my victory.
en: \bJust as water flowing from high places to low places is natural, so is my victory.
it: \bCosì come è naturale che l'acqua scorra dall'alto verso il basso, così lo è la mia vittoria.

id: \bCress: How amazing! Even if there were a lot of reasons, you managed to take on someone as impressive as me!
en: \bCress: How amazing! Even if there were a lot of reasons, you managed to take on someone as impressive as me!
it: \bChicco: Incredibile! Nonostante tutto, sei riuscito a tenere testa a qualcuno di straordinario come me!

id: \bI plan on retraining myself with the aim of defeating you after you've become even stronger!
en: \bI plan on retraining myself with the aim of defeating you after you've become even stronger!
it: \bHo intenzione di riallenarmi con l'obiettivo di sconfiggerti, quando sarai diventato ancora più forte!

id: \rLenora: Welcome! You came all the way out here now! Don't be shy! You're too young to be bashful!
en: \rLenora: Welcome! You came all the way out here now! Don't be shy! You're too young to be bashful!
it: \rAloé: Benvenuto! Sei arrivato fin qui! Non essere timido! Sei troppo giovane per vergognarti!

id: \rWhen I was little, my dad would always bring home bones he dug up. I was very captivated by what they were before!
en: \rWhen I was little, my dad would always bring home bones he dug up. I was very captivated by what they were before!
it: \rQuando ero piccola, mio padre portava sempre a casa le ossa che dissotterrava. Ero affascinata da ciò che erano state un tempo!

id: \rNow I'm also going to research how you battle with the Pokémon you've so lovingly raised. Curiosity is the spice of life!
en: \rNow I'm also going to research how you battle with the Pokémon you've so lovingly raised. Curiosity is the spice of life!
it: \rOra studierò anche il modo in cui lotti con i Pokémon che hai cresciuto con tanto amore. La curiosità è il sale della vita!

id: \rLenora: Your fighting style is so enchanting. It's charming. I'm glad I met you!
en: \rLenora: Your fighting style is so enchanting. It's charming. I'm glad I met you!
it: \rAloé: Il tuo stile di lotta è incantevole. Affascinante. Sono contenta di averti conosciuto!

id: \rBattling is second nature to you, isn't it? Your victory is the result of that, right?
en: \rBattling is second nature to you, isn't it? Your victory is the result of that, right?
it: \rLottare ti viene naturale, vero? La tua vittoria ne è la conseguenza, giusto?

id: \bBurgh: Ah ha! Lights on! My Bug-type Pokémon are scurrying with excitement about getting to battle you!
en: \bBurgh: Ah ha! Lights on! My Bug-type Pokémon are scurrying with excitement about getting to battle you!
it: \bArtemisio: Ah ah! Luci accese! I miei Pokémon di tipo Coleottero fremono all'idea di lottare contro di te!

id: \bIf the battle brings out the beauty in my mates, it will be a scene that makes my heart flutter, win or lose.
en: \bIf the battle brings out the beauty in my mates, it will be a scene that makes my heart flutter, win or lose.
it: \bSe la lotta farà emergere la bellezza dei miei compagni, sarà una scena che mi farà battere il cuore, che io vinca o perda.

id: \bMhm... I feel like I can paint a picture unlike any before. OK! I can hear my battle muse loud and clear. Let's get straight to it!
en: \bMhm... I feel like I can paint a picture unlike any before. OK! I can hear my battle muse loud and clear.  Let's get straight to it!
it: \bMmh... Sento che potrei dipingere un quadro come nessun altro. OK! Sento forte e chiara la mia musa della lotta.  Andiamo dritti al punto!

id: \bBurgh: Aww... I lost. Whatever! Losing to you doesn't bug me, because you are a-MAZ-ingly strong.
en: \bBurgh: Aww... I lost. Whatever! Losing to you doesn't bug me, because you are a-MAZ-ingly strong.
it: \bArtemisio: Ooh... Ho perso. Pazienza! Perdere contro di te non mi rode, perché sei for-MI-da-bil-men-te forte.

id: \bWin or lose, Bug-type Pokémon are still cool and beautiful.
en: \bWin or lose, Bug-type Pokémon are still cool and beautiful.
it: \bChe si vinca o si perda, i Pokémon di tipo Coleottero restano fighi e bellissimi.

id: \rElesa: Yes sweetie. I'm Elesa, the world famous model. Welcome to my stage! My beloved Pokémon and your Pokémon shall compete.
en: \rElesa: Yes sweetie. I'm Elesa, the world famous model. Welcome to my stage! My beloved Pokémon and your Pokémon shall compete.
it: \rCamelia: Sì, tesoro. Sono Camelia, la modella famosa in tutto il mondo. Benvenuto sul mio palco! I miei amati Pokémon sfideranno i tuoi.

id: \rC'est fini! When I'm certain of that, I feel an electric jolt run through my body!
en: \rC'est fini! When I'm certain of that, I feel an electric jolt run through my body!
it: \rC'est fini! Quando ne sono certa, sento una scossa elettrica attraversarmi il corpo!

id: \rI want to feel the sensation, so now my beloved Pokémon are going to make your head spin!
en: \rI want to feel the sensation, so now my beloved Pokémon are going to make your head spin!
it: \rVoglio provare quella sensazione, quindi ora i miei amati Pokémon ti faranno girare la testa!

id: \rElesa: My, oh my... You have a sweet fighting style. You shocked me through and through.
en: \rElesa: My, oh my... You have a sweet fighting style.  You shocked me through and through.
it: \rCamelia: Oh, mamma mia... Hai uno stile di lotta delizioso.  Mi hai fulminata da capo a piedi.

id: \rI want my Pokémon to bathe in the glamourous spotlight too. In that sense, your Pokémon were gleaming very brightly!
en: \rI want my Pokémon to bathe in the glamourous spotlight too. In that sense, your Pokémon were gleaming very brightly!
it: \rVoglio che anche i miei Pokémon si godano la luce dei riflettori. In questo senso, i tuoi Pokémon brillavano tantissimo!

id: \bClay: Harrumph! Kept me waitin', didn't ya, kid? So yer the Trainer they've been talkin' about, huh.
en: \bClay: Harrumph! Kept me waitin', didn't ya, kid? So yer the Trainer they've been talkin' about, huh.
it: \bRafan: Uff! M'hai fatto aspetta', eh, ragazzino? Allora sei tu l'Allenatore di cui tutti parlano.

id: \bHow much stronger ya get comes from how much ya want to win! If ya want ta win, don't make excuses! Got it?
en: \bHow much stronger ya get comes from how much ya want to win! If ya want ta win, don't make excuses! Got it?
it: \bQuanto diventi forte dipende da quanto vuoi vincere! Se vuoi vincere, niente scuse! Capito?

id: \bIf yer gotta bellyache, just forget 'bout fightin'! Well, I might be fussin' 'bout nothing when it comes to ya.
en: \bIf yer gotta bellyache, just forget 'bout fightin'!  Well, I might be fussin' 'bout nothing when it comes to ya.
it: \bSe devi lagnarti, scordati di lottare!  Be', forse con te mi sto preoccupando per niente.

id: \bClay: Fer such a young 'un, ya have an imposin' battle style. I wonder what kind a journey ya had that made ya so strong.
en: \bClay: Fer such a young 'un, ya have an imposin' battle style. I wonder what kind a journey ya had that made ya so strong.
it: \bRafan: Per essere così giovane, hai uno stile di lotta imponente. Chissà che razza di viaggio hai fatto per diventare così forte.

id: \bBut, I still don't like losin'! Come here again, alrite'?
en: \bBut, I still don't like losin'! Come here again, alrite'?
it: \bMa a me perdere non va giù lo stesso! Torna a trovarmi, intesi?

id: \rSkyla: Hee-hee! I've been waiting for you. You're a tough trainer who can face the wind and not get blown off your feet!
en: \rSkyla: Hee-hee! I've been waiting for you. You're a tough trainer who can face the wind and not get blown off your feet!
it: \rAnemone: Ih ih! Ti stavo aspettando. Sei un Allenatore tosto che sa affrontare il vento senza farsi spazzare via!

id: \rSo this is going to be a showdown that decides who's at the top, right? I love being at the summit!
en: \rSo this is going to be a showdown that decides who's at the top, right? I love being at the summit!
it: \rQuindi questa sarà la resa dei conti per decidere chi sta in cima, giusto? Adoro stare in vetta!

id: \rYou can see for miles and miles from high places! So how about you and I have some fun?
en: \rYou can see for miles and miles from high places! So how about you and I have some fun?
it: \rDall'alto si vede per chilometri e chilometri! Allora, che ne dici di divertirci un po' io e te?

id: \rSkyla: You're a pretty amazing trainer, aren't you?
en: \rSkyla: You're a pretty amazing trainer, aren't you?
it: \rAnemone: Sei proprio un Allenatore fantastico, eh?

id: \rMy Pokémon and I are happy, because for the first time in a while, we fought with our full strength.
en: \rMy Pokémon and I are happy, because for the first time in a while, we fought with our full strength.
it: \rI miei Pokémon e io siamo felici, perché per la prima volta dopo tanto tempo abbiamo lottato con tutte le nostre forze.

id: \bBrycen: Pleased to meet you. I'm Brycen. In the past, I was hurt and depressed.
en: \bBrycen: Pleased to meet you. I'm Brycen. In the past, I was hurt and depressed.
it: \bSilvestro: Piacere di conoscerti. Sono Silvestro. In passato sono stato ferito e depresso.

id: \bThen someone shared this with me... There is strength in being with other people and Pokémon.
en: \bThen someone shared this with me... There is strength in being with other people and Pokémon.
it: \bPoi qualcuno mi ha insegnato questo... Si diventa forti stando insieme alle persone e ai Pokémon.

id: \bReceiving their support makes you stronger. I'll show you this power I learned about, which is now etched in my heart.
en: \bReceiving their support makes you stronger. I'll show you this power I learned about, which is now etched in my heart.
it: \bRicevere il loro sostegno ti rende più forte. Ti mostrerò questo potere che ho scoperto, e che ora è inciso nel mio cuore.

id: \bBrycen: You are strong! No, both you and your Pokémon are.
en: \bBrycen: You are strong! No, both you and your Pokémon are.
it: \bSilvestro: Sei forte! Anzi, siete forti, tu e i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bThe stars of this show, this story, were you and your Pokémon. You did well.
en: \bThe stars of this show, this story, were you and your Pokémon. You did well.
it: \bI protagonisti di questo spettacolo, di questa storia, siete stati tu e i tuoi Pokémon. Ottimo lavoro.

id: \rRoxie: You don't do anything! What do you know~?! You don't do anything! How're you gonna change~?!
en: \rRoxie: You don't do anything! What do you know~?!  You don't do anything! How're you gonna change~?!
it: \rVelia: Tu non fai niente! Che ne sai tu~?!  Tu non fai niente! Come pensi di cambiare~?!

id: \rI've got you covered~! I'm gonna give you a toxic shock and open up your mind~!!!!
en: \rI've got you covered~! I'm gonna give you a toxic shock and open up your mind~!!!!
it: \rCi penso io a te~! Ti darò una scossa tossica e ti aprirò la mente~!!!!

id: \rI'm Roxie~! Listen up~! I'm gonna rock the audience right outta their seats~!
en: \rI'm Roxie~! Listen up~! I'm gonna rock the audience right outta their seats~!
it: \rSono Velia~! Ascoltatemi~! Farò saltare il pubblico giù dalle sedie~!

id: \rRoxie: You didn't win! I just lost! I was weak and make my Pokémon feel how much losing stinks!
en: \rRoxie: You didn't win! I just lost! I was weak and make my Pokémon feel how much losing stinks!
it: \rVelia: Non hai vinto tu! Ho perso io! Ero debole e ho fatto provare ai miei Pokémon quanto fa schifo perdere!

id: \rWatch out~! Next time we meet, I'm going to give you a toxic shock as promised~!
en: \rWatch out~! Next time we meet, I'm going to give you a toxic shock as promised~!
it: \rAttento~! La prossima volta che ci incontriamo, ti darò la scossa tossica che ti ho promesso~!

id: \bCheren: Do you want to show how strong you are by winning, or do you want to learn what battling really means?
en: \bCheren: Do you want to show how strong you are by winning, or do you want to learn what battling really means?
it: \bKomor: Vuoi dimostrare quanto sei forte vincendo, o vuoi capire cosa significa davvero lottare?

id: \bEven if hurt, my Pokémon will fight for me with just one command. I think you'll value and trust your Pokémon more if you keep that fact close to your heart.
en: \bEven if hurt, my Pokémon will fight for me with just one command. I think you'll value and trust your Pokémon more if you keep that fact close to your heart.
it: \bAnche se feriti, i miei Pokémon lotteranno per me a un solo comando. Credo che darai più valore ai tuoi Pokémon e ti fiderai di più di loro se terrai a mente questo fatto.

id: \bThat's right! I battle with everything to find the ideal realtionship between Pokémon and people!
en: \bThat's right! I battle with everything to find the ideal realtionship between Pokémon and people!
it: \bProprio così! Lotto con tutto me stesso per trovare il rapporto ideale tra Pokémon e persone!

id: \bCheren: I'll keep battling many trainers and Pokémon like this, and if I can learn what kind of person I am, it'll open up my path.
en: \bCheren: I'll keep battling many trainers and Pokémon like this, and if I can learn what kind of person I am, it'll open up my path.
it: \bKomor: Continuerò a lottare contro tanti Allenatori e Pokémon come te, e se riuscirò a capire che tipo di persona sono, mi si aprirà la strada.

id: \bI'm sure this path will lead me to become the person I'm meant to be. Pokémon will always be with you and me as our path goes.
en: \bI'm sure this path will lead me to become the person I'm meant to be. Pokémon will always be with you and me as our path goes.
it: \bSono certo che questa strada mi porterà a diventare la persona che sono destinato a essere. I Pokémon saranno sempre con te e con me lungo il cammino.

id: \bDrayden: As a trainer, I've simply been pursing greater strength. But now I am aging, thinking about the time I have left...
en: \bDrayden: As a trainer, I've simply been pursing greater strength. But now I am aging, thinking about the time I have left...
it: \bAristide: Come Allenatore, ho sempre inseguito una forza sempre maggiore. Ma ora sto invecchiando e penso al tempo che mi resta...

id: \bWhat I'm searching for now is a young trainer who can show me a bright future.
en: \bWhat I'm searching for now is a young trainer who can show me a bright future.
it: \bQuello che cerco adesso è un giovane Allenatore che sappia mostrarmi un futuro luminoso.

id: \bLet's battle with everything we have: your skill, my experience, and the love we've raised our Pokémon with.
en: \bLet's battle with everything we have: your skill, my experience, and the love we've raised our Pokémon with.
it: \bLottiamo con tutto ciò che abbiamo: la tua abilità, la mia esperienza e l'amore con cui abbiamo cresciuto i nostri Pokémon.

id: \bDrayden: Wonderful. I'm grateful we had a chance to meet and battle.
en: \bDrayden: Wonderful. I'm grateful we had a chance to meet and battle.
it: \bAristide: Meraviglioso. Sono grato di aver avuto l'occasione di incontrarti e lottare con te.

id: \bMake a bright future, not just for yourself, but for others as well.
en: \bMake a bright future, not just for yourself, but for others as well.
it: \bCostruisci un futuro luminoso, non solo per te stesso, ma anche per gli altri.

id: \bMarlon: Uihaa~ Sup! So I'm facing you! That's a good catch right off the wall.
en: \bMarlon: Uihaa~ Sup! So I'm facing you! That's a good catch right off the wall.
it: \bCiprian: Uihaa~ Come va! Allora affronto te! Proprio un bel colpo fuori dal comune.

id: \bI'm strong like the ocean's wide. You're gonna get swept away, fo' sho'. Eh, that's enough talk.
en: \bI'm strong like the ocean's wide. You're gonna get swept away, fo' sho'. Eh, that's enough talk.
it: \bSono forte quanto è vasto l'oceano. Verrai travolto di sicuro, fratello. Va be', basta chiacchiere.

id: \bHow 'bout you and I make some waves and sweep the audience away?
en: \bHow 'bout you and I make some waves and sweep the audience away?
it: \bChe ne dici se io e te facciamo un po' d'onde e travolgiamo il pubblico?

id: \bMarlon: You don't just look strong, you're a deep threat fo' reals!
en: \bMarlon: You don't just look strong, you're a deep threat fo' reals!
it: \bCiprian: Non sembri solo forte, sei davvero una minaccia abissale!

id: \bJust like a ragin' sea that washes everythin' away! Uihaa~ I was swept away by your might and passion!
en: \bJust like a ragin' sea that washes everythin' away!  Uihaa~ I was swept away by your might and passion!
it: \bProprio come un mare in tempesta che spazza via tutto!  Uihaa~ Sono stato travolto dalla tua forza e dalla tua passione!

id: \bGrimsley: Man oh man... Challengers coming one by one. Well, no matter, life is a serious battle anyway.
en: \bGrimsley: Man oh man... Challengers coming one by one. Well, no matter, life is a serious battle anyway.
it: \bMirton: Uff, che pazienza... Sfidanti che arrivano uno dopo l'altro. Be', non importa, la vita è comunque una lotta seria.

id: \bIt's more important to master the cards you're holding than to complain about the ones your opponents were dealt.
en: \bIt's more important to master the cards you're holding than to complain about the ones your opponents were dealt.
it: \bÈ più importante saper giocare le carte che hai in mano che lamentarsi di quelle toccate agli avversari.

id: \bWhat will be determined here is which of us can absorb the light and shine of this match. Let our fates begin.
en: \bWhat will be determined here is which of us can absorb the light and shine of this match. Let our fates begin.
it: \bQui si deciderà chi di noi saprà assorbire la luce e lo splendore di questo incontro. Che il destino abbia inizio.

id: \bGrimsley: Whether you get to fight at full strength, or whether Lady Luck is smiling on you. Where there's a winner, there's also a loser.
en: \bGrimsley: Whether you get to fight at full strength, or whether Lady Luck is smiling on you. Where there's a winner, there's also a loser.
it: \bMirton: Che tu riesca a lottare al massimo delle forze, o che la Dea Bendata ti sorrida. Dove c'è un vincitore, c'è anche un perdente.

id: \bA loss is a loss. Right now, you and your Pokémon are shining brilliantly.
en: \bA loss is a loss. Right now, you and your Pokémon are shining brilliantly.
it: \bUna sconfitta è una sconfitta. In questo momento, tu e i tuoi Pokémon state brillando intensamente.

id: \rShauntal: The trainer's thoughts with the Pokémon's mind... That's part of a novel I wrote. I absolutely love writing about Pokémon!
en: \rShauntal: The trainer's thoughts with the Pokémon's mind... That's part of a novel I wrote. I absolutely love writing about Pokémon!
it: \rAntemia: I pensieri dell'Allenatore uniti all'animo del Pokémon... Fa parte di un romanzo che ho scritto. Adoro scrivere di Pokémon!

id: \rBeginnings are important, whether in a good novel or a good battle. Oh, excuse me. You're a challenger, right?
en: \rBeginnings are important, whether in a good novel or a good battle. Oh, excuse me. You're a challenger, right?
it: \rL'inizio è importante, che si tratti di un buon romanzo o di una bella lotta. Oh, scusami. Sei uno sfidante, vero?

id: \rWould you like to be the subject of my new novel?
en: \rWould you like to be the subject of my new novel?
it: \rTi piacerebbe essere il protagonista del mio nuovo romanzo?

id: \rShauntal: Do you ever feel like you're lost for words when something greatly moves you?
en: \rShauntal: Do you ever feel like you're lost for words when something greatly moves you?
it: \rAntemia: Ti capita mai di restare senza parole quando qualcosa ti commuove profondamente?

id: \rI'm a writer, but right now I'm having trouble putting my feelings into words. You were just that impressive!
en: \rI'm a writer, but right now I'm having trouble putting my feelings into words. You were just that impressive!
it: \rSono una scrittrice, ma adesso faccio fatica a tradurre in parole ciò che provo. Sei stato davvero straordinario!

id: \bMarshal: My name is Marshal, the No. 1 pupil of my mentor, Alder.
en: \bMarshal: My name is Marshal, the No. 1 pupil of my mentor, Alder.
it: \bMarzio: Mi chiamo Marzio, sono l'allievo numero uno del mio maestro, Nardo.

id: \bIn order to master the art of fighting, I've kept training. You're also walking a similar path with your Pokémon.
en: \bIn order to master the art of fighting, I've kept training. You're also walking a similar path with your Pokémon.
it: \bPer padroneggiare l'arte del combattimento ho continuato ad allenarmi. Anche tu stai percorrendo una strada simile insieme ai tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bIt is my intention to test you to take you to your limits of your strength. Kiai!
en: \bIt is my intention to test you to take you to your limits of your strength. Kiai!
it: \bHo intenzione di metterti alla prova per portarti al limite delle tue forze. Kiai!

id: \bMarshal: There is no single strongest Pokémon or best combination. That's why it is difficult to keep winning.
en: \bMarshal: There is no single strongest Pokémon or best combination. That's why it is difficult to keep winning.
it: \bMarzio: Non esiste un unico Pokémon più forte o una combinazione migliore. Ecco perché è difficile continuare a vincere.

id: \bHowever, I think a heart that desires strength is a precious ideal. I respect you, because you have it. Whew!
en: \bHowever, I think a heart that desires strength is a precious ideal. I respect you, because you have it. Whew!
it: \bTuttavia, credo che un cuore che desidera la forza sia un ideale prezioso. Ti rispetto, perché tu ce l'hai. Uff!

id: \rCaitlin: Who are you? How uncouth you are to disturb my sleep. Hmf...
en: \rCaitlin: Who are you? How uncouth you are to disturb my sleep. Hmf...
it: \rCatlina: Chi sei? Che maleducazione disturbare il mio sonno. Hmf...

id: \rYou appear to possess a combination of strength and kindness. What I look for in my opponent is superb strength...
en: \rYou appear to possess a combination of strength and kindness. What I look for in my opponent is superb strength...
it: \rSembri possedere un misto di forza e gentilezza. Ciò che cerco in un avversario è una forza superba...

id: \rVery well. Make your best effort not to bore me with a yawn-inducing battle. We clear?
en: \rVery well. Make your best effort not to bore me with a yawn-inducing battle. We clear?
it: \rMolto bene. Fai del tuo meglio per non annoiarmi con una lotta che fa sbadigliare. Intesi?

id: \rCaitlin: Winning is important, but what's more important is whether I've done better this time.
en: \rCaitlin: Winning is important, but what's more important is whether I've done better this time.
it: \rCatlina: Vincere è importante, ma ciò che conta di più è se stavolta ho fatto meglio.

id: \rI want to improve and win more elegantly, so I invite you to be my opponent again in the future, if you wish.
en: \rI want to improve and win more elegantly, so I invite you to be my opponent again in the future, if you wish.
it: \rVoglio migliorare e vincere con più eleganza, quindi ti invito a essere di nuovo il mio avversario in futuro, se lo desideri.

id: \bBenga: You! Yeah! I knew it, you smell tough! But do you know how strong I am?
en: \bBenga: You! Yeah! I knew it, you smell tough! But do you know how strong I am?
it: \bBenga: Tu! Sì! Lo sapevo, hai l'odore di uno tosto! Ma lo sai quanto sono forte io?

id: \bHey, hey! Look at me! I want to battle with you! My Pokémon haven't been through enough!
en: \bHey, hey! Look at me! I want to battle with you! My Pokémon haven't been through enough!
it: \bEhi, ehi! Guardami! Voglio lottare con te! I miei Pokémon non si sono ancora sfogati abbastanza!

id: \bWe'll see who's stronger! Let's try hard to be the best!
en: \bWe'll see who's stronger! Let's try hard to be the best!
it: \bVediamo chi è più forte! Mettiamocela tutta per essere i migliori!

id: \bBenga: So exciting! You and your Pokémon's combination! What amazing teamwork! You can go anywhere with that!
en: \bBenga: So exciting! You and your Pokémon's combination! What amazing teamwork! You can go anywhere with that!
it: \bBenga: Che emozione! Che combinazione, tu e i tuoi Pokémon! Che lavoro di squadra incredibile! Con quello puoi arrivare ovunque!

id: \bHey! Hey!! You better keep aiming higher and promise to come back and challenge me! Else I will get to the top in no time!
en: \bHey! Hey!! You better keep aiming higher and promise to come back and challenge me! Else I will get to the top in no time!
it: \bEhi! Ehi!! Vedi di puntare sempre più in alto e promettimi che tornerai a sfidarmi! Altrimenti arriverò in cima in un attimo!

id: \rLana: Phew...that was fantastic! You and your Pokémon were perfectly in sync!
en: \rLana: Phew...that was fantastic! You and your Pokémon were perfectly in sync!
it: \rSuiren: Uff... è stato fantastico! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon eravate in perfetta sintonia!

id: \bKiawe: Astounding! Being thrilled by an opponent's excitement... Nothing makes me want to battle more!
en: \bKiawe: Astounding! Being thrilled by an opponent's excitement... Nothing makes me want to battle more!
it: \bKiawe: Sbalorditivo! Farsi travolgere dall'entusiasmo dell'avversario... Niente mi fa venire più voglia di lottare!

id: \rI use my chef's intuition to pick out the cream of the crop! And let's get cooking into the heat of battle then!
en: \rI use my chef's intuition to pick out the cream of the crop! And let's get cooking into the heat of battle then!
it: \rUso il mio intuito da chef per scegliere il meglio del meglio! E allora mettiamoci ai fornelli nel fuoco della lotta!

id: \rAnd next time if you are hungry, don't be shy! Step on up and have a bite!
en: \rAnd next time if you are hungry, don't be shy! Step on up and have a bite!
it: \rE la prossima volta, se hai fame, non essere timido! Fatti avanti e assaggia qualcosa!

id: \rOlivia: Why hello there. Nice to meet you all, I'm Olivia. My partners are adorable, rugged little Rock- type. We'll grind you to dust.
en: \rOlivia: Why hello there. Nice to meet you all, I'm Olivia. My partners are adorable, rugged little Rock- type. We'll grind you to dust.
it: \rOlivia: Ma salve. Piacere di conoscervi, sono Olivia. I miei compagni sono adorabili e robusti piccoli Pokémon di tipo Roccia. Vi ridurremo in polvere.

id: \rBianca: Ahhh, did I reach here a little late again? So-oooo-orry!
en: \rBianca: Ahhh, did I reach here a little late again?  So-oooo-orry!
it: \rBelle: Ahhh, sono arrivata di nuovo un po' in ritardo?  Scu-uuuu-usa!

id: \rKnow what? When I traveled to various regions, so many things happened to me, but I'm so glad I went on that journey!
en: \rKnow what? When I traveled to various regions, so many things happened to me, but I'm so glad I went on that journey!
