it: \rSai una cosa? Quando ho viaggiato per varie regioni me ne sono successe di tutti i colori, ma sono così contenta di aver fatto quel viaggio!

id: \rIt's hard to put into words, but I want to express this feeling through my Pokémon. Let's battle!
en: \rIt's hard to put into words, but I want to express this feeling through my Pokémon. Let's battle!
it: \rÈ difficile da spiegare a parole, ma voglio esprimere questa sensazione attraverso i miei Pokémon. Lottiamo!

id: \rBianca: Thank you for being my opponent! Yep! I learned a lot on how to bring out the best from everyone!
en: \rBianca: Thank you for being my opponent! Yep! I learned a lot on how to bring out the best from everyone!
it: \rBelle: Grazie per essere stato il mio avversario! Già! Ho imparato un sacco su come tirare fuori il meglio da tutti!

id: \rOh, I almost forgot! Congratulations on your victory!
en: \rOh, I almost forgot! Congratulations on your victory!
it: \rOh, quasi dimenticavo! Congratulazioni per la vittoria!

id: Unlucky! You still get some Grandeur Club Credits for trying.
en: Unlucky! You still get some Grandeur Club Credits for trying.
it: Che sfortuna! Ricevi comunque qualche Credito del Grandeur Club per averci provato.

id: You got \v[61] credits.
en: You got \v[61] credits.
it: Hai ricevuto \v[61] crediti.

id: Ding dong!
en: Ding dong!
it: Din don!

id: \bLuc-ker: I made a severe and continuous lapse in my judgement, and I don't expect to be forgiven. I'm simply here to apologize.
en: \bLuc-ker: I made a severe and continuous lapse in my judgement, and I don't expect to be forgiven. I'm simply here to apologize.
it: \bLuc-ker: Ho commesso un grave e continuo errore di giudizio, e non mi aspetto di essere perdonato. Sono qui solo per scusarmi.

id: \bI recognise how difficult the Titan Challenge is, so I'm going to help you out a little. Pay attention to what's to my left next time in the Titan Challenge.
en: \bI recognise how difficult the Titan Challenge is, so I'm going to help you out a little. Pay attention to what's to my left next time in the Titan Challenge.
it: \bSo quanto è difficile la Sfida dei Titani, quindi ti darò una mano. La prossima volta che affronterai la Sfida dei Titani, fai attenzione a ciò che c'è alla mia sinistra.

id: \bFalkner: People say wings can be clipped with a jolt of electricity... I won't allow such insults to my birds!
en: \bFalkner: People say wings can be clipped with a jolt of electricity... I won't allow such insults to my birds!
it: \bValerio: Si dice che le ali possano essere tarpate da una scarica elettrica... Non permetterò simili insulti ai miei uccelli!

id: \bBut I should start studying other Pokémon too. I'm grateful that you made me realize that.
en: \bBut I should start studying other Pokémon too.  I'm grateful that you made me realize that.
it: \bMa dovrei iniziare a studiare anche altri Pokémon.  Ti ringrazio per avermelo fatto capire.

id: \bMorty: Good of you to have come, I can see what others cannot.
en: \bMorty: Good of you to have come, I can see what others cannot.
it: \bAngelo: Grazie di essere venuto, io vedo ciò che gli altri non vedono.

id: \bWhat? That has nothing to do with Pokémon? That's true! Come on, we shall do battle!
en: \bWhat? That has nothing to do with Pokémon? That's true! Come on, we shall do battle!
it: \bCosa? Non c'entra niente con i Pokémon? È vero! Forza, lottiamo!

id: \rUm... I don't know how to say this, but thank you for loving your Pokémon.
en: \rUm... I don't know how to say this, but thank you for loving your Pokémon.
it: \rEhm... Non so come dirlo, ma grazie per amare i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bPryce: I have been training since before you were even born. Pokémon, alike humans, have had many experiences and suffering in our lives.
en: \bPryce: I have been training since before you were even born. Pokémon, alike humans, have had many experiences and suffering in our lives.
it: \bAlfredo: Mi alleno da prima che tu nascessi. I Pokémon, come gli umani, hanno vissuto molte esperienze e sofferenze nelle loro vite.

id: \bWhen the snow melts, spring arrives. Cherish your time together with your Pokémon.
en: \bWhen the snow melts, spring arrives. Cherish your time together with your Pokémon.
it: \bQuando la neve si scioglie, arriva la primavera. Fa' tesoro del tempo che passi con i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rGeez. You are a mysterious trainer, but you made me realise what is is that I lack.
en: \rGeez. You are a mysterious trainer, but you made me realise what is is that I lack.
it: \rAccidenti. Sei un Allenatore misterioso, ma mi hai fatto capire cosa mi manca.

id: \bWill: Welcome, you and fate have chosen me. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Will.
en: \bWill: Welcome, you and fate have chosen me. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Will.
it: \bPino: Benvenuto, tu e il destino avete scelto me. Permettimi di presentarmi. Sono Pino.

id: \bKoga: I have subjected you to everything I could muster. But my efforts failed. I must hone my skills further.
en: \bKoga: I have subjected you to everything I could muster. But my efforts failed. I must hone my skills further.
it: \bKoga: Ti ho messo contro tutto ciò che avevo. Ma i miei sforzi sono stati vani. Devo affinare ancora le mie abilità.

id: \bI see no fear in you. You're determined. So, you're one of the strongest trainers around here?
en: \bI see no fear in you. You're determined. So, you're one of the strongest trainers around here?
it: \bNon vedo paura in te. Sei determinato. Quindi sei uno degli Allenatori più forti da queste parti?

id: \bBruno: You're still standing firm. My challenge's satisfied.
en: \bBruno: You're still standing firm. My challenge's satisfied.
it: \bBruno: Sei ancora in piedi. La mia sfida è soddisfatta.

id: \rKaren: Strong Pokémon. Weak Pokémon. That is only the selfish perception of people. Truly skilled trainers would win with their loved ones.
en: \rKaren: Strong Pokémon. Weak Pokémon. That is only the selfish perception of people.  Truly skilled trainers would win with their loved ones.
it: \rKaren: Pokémon forti. Pokémon deboli. È solo la percezione egoista delle persone.  Gli Allenatori davvero abili vincerebbero con i Pokémon che amano.

id: \bLance: I am the leader of Elite Four. You can call me Lance, the Dragon Trainer.
en: \bLance: I am the leader of Elite Four. You can call me Lance, the Dragon Trainer.
it: \bLance: Sono il capo dei Superquattro. Puoi chiamarmi Lance, l'Allenatore di Draghi.

id: \bDragons are mythical, sacred creatures. They're hard to catch and raise, but their powers are superior!
en: \bDragons are mythical, sacred creatures. They're hard to catch and raise, but their powers are superior!
it: \bI draghi sono creature mitiche e sacre. Sono difficili da catturare e allevare, ma i loro poteri sono superiori!

id: \bLance: No more words. It's time I tested you in battle. Are you ready?
en: \bLance: No more words. It's time I tested you in battle. Are you ready?
it: \bLance: Basta parole. È ora di metterti alla prova in battaglia. Sei pronto?

id: \bLance: I can't believe it. I am witnessing the rise of a great Trainer.
en: \bLance: I can't believe it. I am witnessing the rise of a great Trainer.
it: \bLance: Non ci posso credere. Sto assistendo all'ascesa di un grande Allenatore.

id: \bYour Pokémon have responded to your strong and upstanding nature. You will continue to grow stronger, won't you?
en: \bYour Pokémon have responded to your strong and upstanding nature. You will continue to grow stronger, won't you?
it: \bI tuoi Pokémon hanno risposto alla tua natura forte e retta. Continuerai a diventare sempre più forte, vero?

id: \bSilver: Pesky one. You do not seem to be strong. Stop bothering me and scram.
en: \bSilver: Pesky one. You do not seem to be strong.  Stop bothering me and scram.
it: \bSilver: Che seccatura. Non sembri per niente forte.  Smettila di darmi fastidio e sparisci.

id: \bI said stop noseying around. What's your purpose here?
en: \bI said stop noseying around. What's your purpose here?
it: \bTi ho detto di smetterla di ficcanasare. Cosa ci fai qui?

id: \bThat's it. I will use my full power against you. Then scram!
en: \bThat's it. I will use my full power against you. Then scram!
it: \bE va bene. Userò tutta la mia forza contro di te. E poi sparisci!

id: \bSilver: I still can't win after all that training. I need to believe in my Pokémon.
en: \bSilver: I still can't win after all that training. I need to believe in my Pokémon.
it: \bSilver: Ancora non riesco a vincere dopo tutto quell'allenamento. Devo credere nei miei Pokémon.

id: \bAnyway, I am not giving up. I'll beat you next time when you come back. Move on.
en: \bAnyway, I am not giving up. I'll beat you next time when you come back. Move on.
it: \bComunque, non mi arrendo. Ti batterò la prossima volta che tornerai. Vattene.

id: \rLyra: Wooo, you have keen eyes. You look sharp compared to others.
en: \rLyra: Wooo, you have keen eyes. You look sharp compared to others.
it: \rCetra: Wooo, hai un occhio attento. Sembri più sveglio degli altri.

id: \rYou are here looking for a challenge, am I right? Me too!
en: \rYou are here looking for a challenge, am I right? Me too!
it: \rSei qui in cerca di una sfida, dico bene? Anch'io!

id: \rAnd that's good. Let's have a battle!
en: \rAnd that's good. Let's have a battle!
it: \rE va benissimo. Facciamo una lotta!

id: \rLyra: Awww. Guess I took the loss this time. Tough luck.
en: \rLyra: Awww. Guess I took the loss this time. Tough luck.
it: \rCetra: Uffa. Stavolta ho perso io, a quanto pare. Che sfortuna.

id: \rAnd you are really strong. You must have travelled long and far.
en: \rAnd you are really strong. You must have travelled long and far.
it: \rE sei davvero forte. Devi aver viaggiato a lungo e lontano.

id: \bEthan: Oh, hey? I'm Ethan. What'cha doing here? On an adventure?
en: \bEthan: Oh, hey? I'm Ethan. What'cha doing here?  On an adventure?
it: \bEthan: Oh, ehi! Sono Ethan. Che ci fai qui?  Sei in viaggio all'avventura?

id: \bI'm also on a fun adventure. I can handle any obstacles, as long I have my Pokémon with me.
en: \bI'm also on a fun adventure. I can handle any obstacles, as long I have my Pokémon with me.
it: \bAnch'io sto vivendo un'avventura divertente. Posso superare qualsiasi ostacolo, finché ho i miei Pokémon con me.

id: \bI'm feeling good today, how 'bout a match? Right here, right now!
en: \bI'm feeling good today, how 'bout a match? Right here, right now!
it: \bOggi mi sento in forma, che ne dici di una lotta? Qui e ora!

id: \bEthan: Aite. You got me. That was an impressive battle!
en: \bEthan: Aite. You got me. That was an impressive battle!
it: \bEthan: Ok. Mi hai battuto. È stata una lotta impressionante!

id: \bHope we get to meet up again after we finish our individual adventures!
en: \bHope we get to meet up again after we finish our individual adventures!
it: \bSpero che ci rincontreremo dopo aver concluso le nostre avventure!

id: \bRoark: I'm but one Trainer who decided to walk proudly with Rock-type Pokémon. Everyday, we toughen ourselves by digging up Fossils.
en: \bRoark: I'm but one Trainer who decided to walk proudly with Rock-type Pokémon. Everyday, we toughen ourselves by digging up Fossils.
it: \bPedro: Sono solo un Allenatore che ha deciso di camminare a testa alta con i Pokémon di tipo Roccia. Ogni giorno ci tempriamo scavando Fossili.

id: \bThey might be nasty and mean, but yet they're beautiful too. Would you like to take on my challenge?
en: \bThey might be nasty and mean, but yet they're beautiful too. Would you like to take on my challenge?
it: \bSaranno anche cattivi e scontrosi, eppure sono anche bellissimi. Vuoi accettare la mia sfida?

id: \rCynthia: When you are facing a Trainer in battle, you can learn everything about them. One look at you tells me many things.
en: \rCynthia: When you are facing a Trainer in battle, you can learn everything about them. One look at you tells me many things.
it: \rCamilla: Quando affronti un Allenatore in battaglia, puoi scoprire tutto di lui. Uno sguardo a te mi dice molte cose.

id: \rWhat Pokemon they have, what moves they've taught. What items they make their Pokémon hold.
en: \rWhat Pokemon they have, what moves they've taught. What items they make their Pokémon hold.
it: \rChe Pokémon ha, quali mosse ha insegnato loro. Quali strumenti fa tenere ai suoi Pokémon.

id: \rThere's no need for words then. I, Cynthia, accept your challenge!
en: \rThere's no need for words then. I, Cynthia, accept your challenge!
it: \rAllora non servono parole. Io, Camilla, accetto la tua sfida!

id: \rCynthia: That was excellent. Truly, an outstanding battle. You gave the support your Pokémon needed to maximize their power.
en: \rCynthia: That was excellent. Truly, an outstanding battle. You gave the support your Pokémon needed to maximize their power.
it: \rCamilla: È stato eccellente. Davvero una lotta straordinaria. Hai dato ai tuoi Pokémon il sostegno di cui avevano bisogno per esprimere al massimo il loro potere.

id: \rI sincerely applaud your victory in this challenge. But the road before you is still very long.
en: \rI sincerely applaud your victory in this challenge. But the road before you is still very long.
it: \rApplaudo sinceramente la tua vittoria in questa sfida. Ma la strada che hai davanti è ancora molto lunga.

id: \bBarry: Hey, you there! Yeah, you'd better watch me! Because I'm going to be the strongest Trainer ever!
en: \bBarry: Hey, you there! Yeah, you'd better watch me!  Because I'm going to be the strongest Trainer ever!
it: \bBarry: Ehi, tu! Sì, faresti meglio a guardarmi!  Perché diventerò l'Allenatore più forte di sempre!

id: \bAnd you will be challenging me! You will be impressed by me!
en: \bAnd you will be challenging me! You will be impressed by me!
it: \bE tu mi sfiderai! E resterai colpito da me!

id: \bSend out your Pokémon now! Or I'm fining you 10 million!
en: \bSend out your Pokémon now! Or I'm fining you 10 million!
it: \bManda subito in campo i tuoi Pokémon! O ti faccio una multa da 10 milioni!

id: \bBarry: ...! It's alright, though. Keep getting stronger. That's what I'm saying.
en: \bBarry: ...! It's alright, though. Keep getting stronger.  That's what I'm saying.
it: \bBarry: ...! Va bene lo stesso, però. Continua a diventare più forte.  È questo che dico.

id: \bThe more you do, the tougher my Pokémon and I get too, y'know.
en: \bThe more you do, the tougher my Pokémon and I get too, y'know.
it: \bPiù migliori tu, più diventiamo forti anche io e i miei Pokémon, sai.

id: \rDawn: Hey there. You and your Pokemon look close-bonded. I've always thought that people and Pokemon aren't meant to go alone.
en: \rDawn: Hey there. You and your Pokemon look close-bonded. I've always thought that people and Pokemon aren't meant to go alone.
it: \rLucinda: Ciao. Tu e i tuoi Pokémon sembrate molto legati. Ho sempre pensato che persone e Pokémon non siano fatti per stare da soli.

id: \rThat's why I make it a point to help others when they're in trouble!
en: \rThat's why I make it a point to help others when they're in trouble!
it: \rEcco perché mi impegno sempre ad aiutare gli altri quando sono in difficoltà!

id: \rLet me give you a hand to see if you can beat me and move on!
en: \rLet me give you a hand to see if you can beat me and move on!
it: \rLascia che ti dia una mano: vediamo se riesci a battermi e ad andare avanti!

id: \rDawn: Looks my Pokémon got injured a little. But no need to worry, we'll get better very soon!
en: \rDawn: Looks my Pokémon got injured a little. But no need to worry, we'll get better very soon!
it: \rLucinda: Sembra che i miei Pokémon si siano feriti un po'. Ma niente paura, ci riprenderemo prestissimo!

id: \rIf you ever need a helping hand for training, I'm your gal! Look for me!
en: \rIf you ever need a helping hand for training, I'm your gal! Look for me!
it: \rSe mai ti servisse una mano per allenarti, sono la persona giusta! Cercami!

id: \bLucas: Heyo! How's your time here? At first it was a bit discouraging for me...
en: \bLucas: Heyo! How's your time here? At first it was a bit discouraging for me...
it: \bLucas: Ehilà! Come ti trovi qui? All'inizio per me è stato un po' scoraggiante...

id: \bBut having so many strong Trainers to face, it's also exciting isn't it?
en: \bBut having so many strong Trainers to face, it's also exciting isn't it?
it: \bMa avere così tanti Allenatori forti da affrontare è anche emozionante, non trovi?

id: \bNow with that said... Ready or not, let's have a go too!
en: \bNow with that said... Ready or not, let's have a go too!
it: \bDetto questo... Pronto o no, facciamo una lotta anche noi!

id: \bLucas: Turns out that you're the stronger one! That's surprising!
en: \bLucas: Turns out that you're the stronger one! That's surprising!
it: \bLucas: Alla fine sei tu il più forte! Che sorpresa!

id: \bHaving this battle pushed my senses to their limits. I need to take a nap from this...
en: \bHaving this battle pushed my senses to their limits. I need to take a nap from this...
it: \bQuesta lotta ha spinto i miei sensi al limite. Ho bisogno di un pisolino dopo questa...

id: \bThat's right! I battle with everything to find the ideal relationship between Pokémon and people!
en: \bThat's right! I battle with everything to find the ideal relationship between Pokémon and people!
it: \bProprio così! Lotto con tutto me stesso per trovare il rapporto ideale tra Pokémon e persone!

id: \bAlder: Hello, my name's Alder. I'm a trainer with a keen interest in the world.
en: \bAlder: Hello, my name's Alder. I'm a trainer with a keen interest in the world.
it: \bNardo: Ciao, mi chiamo Nardo. Sono un Allenatore con un grande interesse per il mondo.

id: \bOne of my goals is to tell people about how wonderful it is to walk toward the future together with Pokémon.
en: \bOne of my goals is to tell people about how wonderful it is to walk toward the future together with Pokémon.
it: \bUno dei miei obiettivi è far conoscere alla gente quanto è meraviglioso camminare verso il futuro insieme ai Pokémon.

id: \bI feel fired up when I see another trainer, and I wonder which one of us is stronger. The excitement builds to a fever pitch!
en: \bI feel fired up when I see another trainer, and I wonder which one of us is stronger. The excitement builds to a fever pitch!
it: \bQuando vedo un altro Allenatore mi sento carico e mi chiedo chi dei due sia più forte. L'emozione sale alle stelle!

id: \bAlder: Well done! The ones who change the world are always the ones who pursued their dreams.
en: \bAlder: Well done! The ones who change the world are always the ones who pursued their dreams.
it: \bNardo: Ben fatto! Chi cambia il mondo è sempre chi ha inseguito i propri sogni.

id: \bWhen things don't go as you thought, silently continue to train! Someday, you will be able to battle in the way you envisioned!
en: \bWhen things don't go as you thought, silently continue to train! Someday, you will be able to battle in the way you envisioned!
it: \bQuando le cose non vanno come pensavi, continua ad allenarti in silenzio! Un giorno riuscirai a lottare proprio come hai sempre immaginato!

id: \rIris: Hi! I'm Iris! People call me the girl who knows the hearts of dragons!
en: \rIris: Hi! I'm Iris! People call me the girl who knows the hearts of dragons!
it: \rIris: Ciao! Sono Iris! Mi chiamano la ragazza che conosce il cuore dei draghi!

id: \rYou know what? I really look forward to having serious battles with strong trainers! They desire victory with every fiber of their being!
en: \rYou know what? I really look forward to having serious battles with strong trainers! They desire victory with every fiber of their being!
it: \rSai una cosa? Non vedo l'ora di fare lotte serie con Allenatori forti! Desiderano la vittoria con ogni fibra del loro essere!

id: \rOK! Brace yourself! I'm going to defeat you!
en: \rOK! Brace yourself! I'm going to defeat you!
it: \rOK! Preparati! Ti sconfiggerò!

id: \rIris: I'm upset I couldn't win! But you know what? More than that, I'm happy!
en: \rIris: I'm upset I couldn't win! But you know what?  More than that, I'm happy!
it: \rIris: Mi scoccia non aver vinto! Ma sai una cosa?  Più di tutto, sono felice!

id: \rI mean, come on. After this serious battle, you and I got to know one another better than before! Yep! We sure did!
en: \rI mean, come on. After this serious battle, you and I got to know one another better than before! Yep! We sure did!
it: \rCioè, dai. Dopo questa lotta seria, io e te ci conosciamo meglio di prima! Sì! Proprio così!

id: \bHugh: Hugh's here to gauge your capabilities as a Pokémon trainer. I ain't no simpleton for your info.
en: \bHugh: Hugh's here to gauge your capabilities as a Pokémon trainer. I ain't no simpleton for your info.
it: \bHugh: Hugh è qui per valutare le tue capacità di Allenatore di Pokémon. E sappi che non sono uno sprovveduto.

id: \bBring up your A-game now, otherwise it is back to the drawing board for you.
en: \bBring up your A-game now, otherwise it is back to the drawing board for you.
it: \bTira fuori il meglio di te, altrimenti dovrai ricominciare da capo.

id: \bNow come at me with everything you got!
en: \bNow come at me with everything you got!
it: \bE ora vieni avanti con tutto quello che hai!

id: \bHugh: Thanks to you, I accomplished what i set out to do. I wish I could've show you more.
en: \bHugh: Thanks to you, I accomplished what i set out to do. I wish I could've show you more.
it: \bHugh: Grazie a te ho raggiunto il mio obiettivo. Avrei voluto mostrarti di più.

id: \bYou're amazing. Get the proof that you're a trainer your Pokémon can be proud of! See you!
en: \bYou're amazing. Get the proof that you're a trainer your Pokémon can be proud of! See you!
it: \bSei fantastico. Dimostra di essere un Allenatore di cui i tuoi Pokémon possano andare fieri! Ci vediamo!

id: \rHilda: Hilda's me! When it comes to Pokémon battles, you can count on me!
en: \rHilda: Hilda's me! When it comes to Pokémon battles, you can count on me!
it: \rHilda: Io sono Hilda! Quando si tratta di lotte Pokémon, puoi contare su di me!

id: \rTrust me, I'm really good at this. If you don't believe me, let's get it going then!
en: \rTrust me, I'm really good at this. If you don't believe me, let's get it going then!
it: \rFidati, sono davvero brava. Se non mi credi, allora cominciamo!

id: \rThis battle is mine to win! I won't go down easily!
en: \rThis battle is mine to win! I won't go down easily!
it: \rQuesta lotta la vinco io! Non mi arrenderò facilmente!

id: \rHilda: Awwww, I gave it my all, and I still lost...
en: \rHilda: Awwww, I gave it my all, and I still lost...
it: \rHilda: Uffaaa, ce l'ho messa tutta e ho perso lo stesso...

id: \rBut that was really fun! Is it that late already? Time sure does fly by!
en: \rBut that was really fun! Is it that late already?  Time sure does fly by!
it: \rPerò è stato davvero divertente! È già così tardi?  Il tempo vola proprio!

id: \bHilbert: Hey. I'm Hilbert. Guess I'm one step closer to being one of the strongest trainers now.
en: \bHilbert: Hey. I'm Hilbert. Guess I'm one step closer to being one of the strongest trainers now.
it: \bHilbert: Ehi. Sono Hilbert. Direi che ora sono un passo più vicino a essere uno degli Allenatori più forti.

id: \bI'm sure we've come a such a long way to get to who we are today. Mmm-hmm.
en: \bI'm sure we've come a such a long way to get to who we are today. Mmm-hmm.
it: \bSono sicuro che abbiamo fatto tanta strada per diventare quello che siamo oggi. Mm-mh.

id: \bI'm looking forward to battling against you, but let's be friends after this, ok?
en: \bI'm looking forward to battling against you, but let's be friends after this, ok?
it: \bNon vedo l'ora di lottare contro di te, ma dopo restiamo amici, ok?

id: \bHilbert: Looks like you've got victory in your grasp, buddy!
en: \bHilbert: Looks like you've got victory in your grasp, buddy!
it: \bHilbert: Sembra che tu abbia la vittoria in pugno, amico!

id: \bBut next time, I will give you a match worth making your jaw drop!
en: \bBut next time, I will give you a match worth making your jaw drop!
it: \bMa la prossima volta ti darò una lotta da lasciarti a bocca aperta!

id: \rRosa: I'm Rosa! My goal is to train hard, get stronger, and battle my heart out against all kinds of trainers!
en: \rRosa: I'm Rosa! My goal is to train hard, get stronger, and battle my heart out against all kinds of trainers!
it: \rRosa: Sono Rosa! Il mio obiettivo è allenarmi sodo, diventare più forte e lottare col cuore contro ogni tipo di Allenatore!

id: \rYou've gotta do your best, so that I won't be wiping you out in one sweep!
en: \rYou've gotta do your best, so that I won't be wiping you out in one sweep!
it: \rDevi dare il massimo, così non ti spazzerò via in un colpo solo!

id: \rNow, would you please battle with me already? Yay hay!
en: \rNow, would you please battle with me already? Yay hay!
it: \rE ora, vuoi lottare con me una buona volta? Evvai!

id: \rRosa: Hehe. That was very satisfying. You went all out and gave me a run for my effort.
en: \rRosa: Hehe. That was very satisfying. You went all out and gave me a run for my effort.
it: \rRosa: Ehehe. È stato molto soddisfacente. Hai dato tutto e mi hai fatto sudare.

id: \rBut it's important to stay positive, you see? Taking that first little step will really propel you forward!
en: \rBut it's important to stay positive, you see? Taking that first little step will really propel you forward!
it: \rMa è importante restare positivi, capisci? Fare quel primo piccolo passo ti darà una gran spinta in avanti!

id: \bNate: Hey there! I'm Nate. It's great to be here, facing against you now.
en: \bNate: Hey there! I'm Nate. It's great to be here, facing against you now.
it: \bNate: Ciao! Sono Nate. È bello essere qui ad affrontarti.

id: \bMy opponents are getting more and more challenging. There's tons of amazing people to look up to.
en: \bMy opponents are getting more and more challenging. There's tons of amazing people to look up to.
it: \bI miei avversari sono sempre più impegnativi. Ci sono tantissime persone fantastiche da prendere come esempio.

id: \bIf it's okay with you, let's begin now!
en: \bIf it's okay with you, let's begin now!
it: \bSe per te va bene, cominciamo!

id: \bNate: This means no breaks for me! I will be training every day to better myself!
en: \bNate: This means no breaks for me! I will be training every day to better myself!
it: \bNate: Questo vuol dire niente pause per me! Mi allenerò ogni giorno per migliorare!

id: \bIt's been a blast battling against you. You'd better be on your toes next time!
en: \bIt's been a blast battling against you. You'd better be on your toes next time!
it: \bÈ stato uno spasso lottare contro di te. La prossima volta stai all'erta!

id: \bAllister: H-here... I go...
en: \bAllister: H-here... I go...
it: \bOnion: E-ecco... arrivo...

id: \rOpal: Show me what you can do when you go all out, child.
en: \rOpal: Show me what you can do when you go all out, child.
it: \rPoppy: Mostrami cosa sai fare quando dai il massimo, ragazzino.

id: \rMelony: You won't be able to escape when I freeze you solid!
en: \rMelony: You won't be able to escape when I freeze you solid!
it: \rMelony: Non potrai scappare quando ti avrò congelato da capo a piedi!

id: \bPeony: Brace yourself, I'm pretty ferocious in battle!
en: \bPeony: Brace yourself, I'm pretty ferocious in battle!
it: \bPeony: Preparati, in lotta sono parecchio feroce!

id: \bLeon: I can feel my partners itching with anticipation... We're gonna have an absolute Champion Time!
en: \bLeon: I can feel my partners itching with anticipation... We're gonna have an absolute Champion Time!
it: \bDandel: Sento i miei compagni fremere d'attesa... Sarà una lotta da veri Campioni!

id: \bHop: Let's show everyone the greatest battle ever!
en: \bHop: Let's show everyone the greatest battle ever!
it: \bHop: Mostriamo a tutti la lotta più grande di sempre!

id: \bVictor: My Pokémon are prepped and ready! Wanna have a taste test?
en: \bVictor: My Pokémon are prepped and ready! Wanna have a taste test?
it: \bVictor: I miei Pokémon sono pronti e carichi! Vuoi un assaggio?

id: \rGloria: Ok, I'm all pumped up and ready to go!
en: \rGloria: Ok, I'm all pumped up and ready to go!
it: \rGloria: Ok, sono carichissima e pronta a partire!

id: \rOleana: Once I beat you to pieces, Chairman Rose will be one step closer to his goal!
en: \rOleana: Once I beat you to pieces, Chairman Rose will be one step closer to his goal!
it: \rOleana: Una volta che ti avrò fatto a pezzi, il Presidente Rose sarà un passo più vicino al suo obiettivo!

id: \bRose: Show me your energy, required to keep this brilliant, glittering world alive!
en: \bRose: Show me your energy, required to keep this brilliant, glittering world alive!
it: \bRose: Mostrami la tua energia, quella che serve a mantenere vivo questo mondo splendido e scintillante!

id: \rMai: Let's have a fun and intense battle that both of our teams can really enjoy!
en: \rMai: Let's have a fun and intense battle that both of our teams can really enjoy!
it: \rMai: Facciamo una lotta divertente e intensa che entrambe le nostre squadre possano godersi!

id: \rPalina: Without further ado, show me your team.
en: \rPalina: Without further ado, show me your team.
it: \rPalina: Senza ulteriori indugi, mostrami la tua squadra.

id: \bIngo: Perhaps a Pokémon battle with you would jog this memory... Would you honor me with a battle?
en: \bIngo: Perhaps a Pokémon battle with you would jog this memory... Would you honor me with a battle?
it: \bIngo: Forse una lotta Pokémon con te potrebbe risvegliare questo ricordo... Mi faresti l'onore di lottare?

id: \rSabi: Well, you'll get your rewards... if you can win against me first!
en: \rSabi: Well, you'll get your rewards... if you can win against me first!
it: \rSabi: Beh, avrai la tua ricompensa... se prima riesci a battermi!

id: \bGaeric: If you hope to accomplish victory, we must judge whether are you up to the task!
en: \bGaeric: If you hope to accomplish victory, we must judge whether are you up to the task!
it: \bGaeric: Se speri di ottenere la vittoria, dobbiamo giudicare se sei all'altezza del compito!

id: \bBeni: You are the opponent worthy of my great ninja techniques that have been left to smolder all these long years!
en: \bBeni: You are the opponent worthy of my great ninja techniques that have been left to smolder all these long years!
it: \bBeni: Sei l'avversario degno delle mie grandi tecniche ninja, rimaste a covare sotto la cenere per tutti questi lunghi anni!

id: \rZisu: Show me what you can do. I will carefully observe your every move!
en: \rZisu: Show me what you can do. I will carefully observe your every move!
it: \rZisu: Mostrami cosa sai fare. Osserverò attentamente ogni tua mossa!

id: \bKamado: Which of us is stronger will prevail!
en: \bKamado: Which of us is stronger will prevail!
it: \bKamado: Prevarrà chi di noi è più forte!

id: \bAdaman: Oh, I'll cut the greetings! We don't have any more time to waste! Let's begin!
en: \bAdaman: Oh, I'll cut the greetings! We don't have any more time to waste! Let's begin!
it: \bAdaman: Oh, salto i convenevoli! Non abbiamo più tempo da perdere! Cominciamo!

id: \rIrida: Let's compare what we know to see whose world is vaster.
en: \rIrida: Let's compare what we know to see whose world is vaster.
it: \rIrida: Confrontiamo ciò che sappiamo per vedere quale dei nostri mondi è più vasto.

id: \rCogita: This is the only time I will have to pardon myself, to further strengthen your resolve. Let's battle.
en: \rCogita: This is the only time I will have to pardon myself, to further strengthen your resolve. Let's battle.
it: \rCogita: Questa è l'unica volta in cui mi concederò un'eccezione, per rafforzare ancora di più la tua determinazione. Lottiamo.

id: \bVolo: IT'S TIME TO CREATE A BRAND NEW WORLD! Everyone will vanish, for the forging of a NEW BETTER WORLD!
en: \bVolo: IT'S TIME TO CREATE A BRAND NEW WORLD!  Everyone will vanish, for the forging of a NEW BETTER WORLD!
it: \bVolo: È ORA DI CREARE UN MONDO COMPLETAMENTE NUOVO!  Tutti svaniranno, per forgiare un NUOVO MONDO MIGLIORE!

id: \bBut having so many strong Trainers to face, it's also exciting, isn't it?
en: \bBut having so many strong Trainers to face, it's also exciting, isn't it?
it: \bMa avere così tanti Allenatori forti da affrontare è anche emozionante, non trovi?

id: \rNurse Joy: Good day, \PN. Your Pokemon looks really roughed up.
en: \rNurse Joy: Good day, \PN. Your Pokemon looks really roughed up.
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Buongiorno, \PN. I tuoi Pokémon sembrano proprio malconci.

id: \rWould you like me to heal your Pokémon?
en: \rWould you like me to heal your Pokémon?
it: \rVuoi che curi i tuoi Pokémon?

id: \rLet me help you.
en: \rLet me help you.
it: \rLascia che ti aiuti.

id: \rAll's great now! Take care!
en: \rAll's great now! Take care!
it: \rOra è tutto a posto! Abbi cura di te!

id: \rNo worries then.
en: \rNo worries then.
it: \rNessun problema, allora.

id: \rNurse Joy: Sorry \PN, that's all the items I had on hand.
en: \rNurse Joy: Sorry \PN, that's all the items I had on hand.
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Mi dispiace \PN, non avevo altri strumenti a disposizione.

id: \bOak: Hello there! My name is Oak! People call me the Pokémon Professor! I study Pokémon as a profession.
en: \bOak: Hello there! My name is Oak! People call me the Pokémon Professor! I study Pokémon as a profession.
it: \bOak: Ciao! Mi chiamo Oak! Tutti mi chiamano il Professore di Pokémon! Studio i Pokémon per professione.

id: \bFor some people, Pokémon are pets. Other use them for fights. You need your own Pokémon for your protection, especially here.
en: \bFor some people, Pokémon are pets. Other use them for fights. You need your own Pokémon for your protection, especially here.
it: \bPer alcuni i Pokémon sono animali domestici. Altri li usano per lottare. Ti serve un Pokémon tutto tuo per proteggerti, specialmente qui.

id: \bBut rather than talking about it, you'll learn more from experience. Here, come battle with me!
en: \bBut rather than talking about it, you'll learn more from experience. Here, come battle with me!
it: \bMa invece di parlarne, imparerai di più con l'esperienza. Su, vieni a lottare con me!

id: \bOak: So, you've won! You understand that your victory was not just your own doing. The bond you share with your Pokémon is marvelous.
en: \bOak: So, you've won! You understand that your victory was not just your own doing. The bond you share with your Pokémon is marvelous.
it: \bOak: Allora hai vinto! Capisci che la tua vittoria non è solo merito tuo. Il legame che condividi con i tuoi Pokémon è meraviglioso.

id: \bI hope you do not neglect your Pokédex too! When it's completed, your views about Pokémon will likely have changed!
en: \bI hope you do not neglect your Pokédex too! When it's completed, your views about Pokémon will likely have changed!
it: \bSpero che non trascurerai nemmeno il tuo Pokédex! Quando sarà completo, probabilmente la tua visione dei Pokémon sarà cambiata!

id: \bGiovanni: Why... impressive of you to be here... with a dangerous figure such as me.
en: \bGiovanni: Why... impressive of you to be here... with a dangerous figure such as me.
it: \bGiovanni: Ma guarda... notevole da parte tua venire qui... al cospetto di una figura pericolosa come me.

id: \bI have to warn you that this is not a place for kids like you. But since you have seen me here...
en: \bI have to warn you that this is not a place for kids like you. But since you have seen me here...
it: \bDevo avvertirti che questo non è posto per ragazzini come te. Ma visto che mi hai visto qui...

id: \bFor your insolence, you will feel a world of pain!
en: \bFor your insolence, you will feel a world of pain!
it: \bPer la tua insolenza, conoscerai un dolore immenso!

id: \bGiovanni: You have a certain look... It reminds me of... someone.
en: \bGiovanni: You have a certain look... It reminds me of... someone.
it: \bGiovanni: Hai uno sguardo particolare... Mi ricorda... qualcuno.

id: \bI will tell you this now... No matter how strong you are, you'll lose someday.
en: \bI will tell you this now... No matter how strong you are, you'll lose someday.
it: \bTe lo dico subito... Non importa quanto tu sia forte, un giorno perderai.

id: \bElm: I've been waiting for you! Do you know anything about my research? As you know, Pokémon are carried in Poké Balls these days.
en: \bElm: I've been waiting for you! Do you know anything about my research? As you know, Pokémon are carried in Poké Balls these days.
it: \bElm: Ti stavo aspettando! Sai qualcosa delle mie ricerche? Come sai, oggigiorno i Pokémon vengono portati nelle Poké Ball.

id: \bBut before the Poké Ball was invented, people used to walk with Pokémon. It could have something to do with how Pokémon grow or evolve...
en: \bBut before the Poké Ball was invented, people used to walk with Pokémon. It could have something to do with how Pokémon grow or evolve...
it: \bMa prima che la Poké Ball venisse inventata, le persone camminavano insieme ai Pokémon. Potrebbe avere a che fare con il modo in cui i Pokémon crescono o si evolvono...

id: \bTell me, how do you raise your Pokemon? I will be expecting a great battle!
en: \bTell me, how do you raise your Pokemon? I will be expecting a great battle!
it: \bDimmi, come alleni i tuoi Pokémon? Mi aspetto una gran bella lotta!

id: \bElm: I knew you were a little different - you never cease to amaze me! Thanks to you, my research is going great!
en: \bElm: I knew you were a little different - you never cease to amaze me! Thanks to you, my research is going great!
it: \bElm: Lo sapevo che eri un po' diverso: non smetti mai di stupirmi! Grazie a te le mie ricerche procedono alla grande!

id: \bYou're looking for tougher opponents? Then keep going straight. And don't forget to thank all those who battled against you!
en: \bYou're looking for tougher opponents? Then keep going straight. And don't forget to thank all those who battled against you!
it: \bCerchi avversari più tosti? Allora prosegui dritto. E non dimenticare di ringraziare tutti quelli che hanno lottato contro di te!

id: \bBirch: My name is Birch. We humans live alongside Pokémon. Friendly playmates at times, cooperative workmates at others.
en: \bBirch: My name is Birch. We humans live alongside Pokémon. Friendly playmates at times, cooperative workmates at others.
it: \bBirch: Mi chiamo Birch. Noi umani viviamo insieme ai Pokémon. A volte sono amici di gioco, altre volte compagni di lavoro.

id: \bAnd sometimes, we band together and battle others like us. But despite our closeness, we don't know everything about Pokémon.
en: \bAnd sometimes, we band together and battle others like us. But despite our closeness, we don't know everything about Pokémon.
it: \bE a volte ci uniamo per lottare contro altri come noi. Ma nonostante questa vicinanza, non sappiamo tutto sui Pokémon.

id: \bIn fact, there are still many, many mysteries surrounding Pokémon. What's your secret in raising Pokemon, then?
en: \bIn fact, there are still many, many mysteries surrounding Pokémon. What's your secret in raising Pokemon, then?
it: \bAnzi, ci sono ancora tantissimi misteri che circondano i Pokémon. Allora, qual è il tuo segreto per allenare i Pokémon?

id: \bBirch: Yup! That's the spirit! …Arghhh! I'm getting the itch to get out and see the world!
en: \bBirch: Yup! That's the spirit! …Arghhh! I'm getting the itch to get out and see the world!
it: \bBirch: Sì! Questo è lo spirito giusto! ...Argh! Mi è venuta voglia di uscire a vedere il mondo!

id: \bI'd love it if your world seemed wider than ever! Though I'd love it even more if you came back from time to time to show me what progress you've made.
en: \bI'd love it if your world seemed wider than ever!  Though I'd love it even more if you came back from time to time to show me what progress you've made.
it: \bMi piacerebbe che il tuo mondo ti sembrasse più vasto che mai!  Anche se mi piacerebbe ancora di più se tornassi ogni tanto a mostrarmi i tuoi progressi.

id: \bMaxie: Now here I was wondering, though you are but a child, your eyes tell me of your fierce determination.
en: \bMaxie: Now here I was wondering, though you are but a child, your eyes tell me of your fierce determination.
it: \bMax: Mi stavo giusto chiedendo... Anche se sei solo un ragazzino, i tuoi occhi mi parlano di una feroce determinazione.

id: \bI am called Maxie. I stand as the head of Team Magma, and you are one of the younglings who may shape our society's future.
en: \bI am called Maxie. I stand as the head of Team Magma, and you are one of the younglings who may shape our society's future.
it: \bMi chiamo Max. Sono il capo del Team Magma, e tu sei uno dei giovani che potrebbero plasmare il futuro della nostra società.

id: \bThe land exists so we humans might continue onward and upward, explore, develop, exploit, stepping into the future...
en: \bThe land exists so we humans might continue onward and upward, explore, develop, exploit, stepping into the future...
it: \bLa terra esiste affinché noi umani possiamo continuare ad avanzare e progredire, esplorare, sviluppare, sfruttare, andando verso il futuro...

id: \bThat is why we, Team Magma, must increase the landmass of the world! Believe that this will lead to a future of eternal happiness for humanity!
en: \bThat is why we, Team Magma, must increase the landmass of the world! Believe that this will lead to a future of eternal happiness for humanity!
it: \bEcco perché noi del Team Magma dobbiamo espandere le terre emerse del mondo! Credici: questo porterà l'umanità verso un futuro di eterna felicità!

id: \bMaxie: Hah... Hah... Hahhh... You've really done it, child. You've shown a power that exceeds that of the great Maxie!
en: \bMaxie: Hah... Hah... Hahhh... You've really done it, child. You've shown a power that exceeds that of the great Maxie!
it: \bMax: Ah... Ah... Ahhh... Ce l'hai fatta davvero, ragazzino. Hai mostrato un potere superiore a quello del grande Max!

id: \bSplendid. Just splendid, my young Trainer. Rejecting my ideals without a second thought... And yet. I will not yield! I will not bend! My ideals will not be shaken!
en: \bSplendid. Just splendid, my young Trainer. Rejecting my ideals without a second thought... And yet. I will not yield! I will not bend! My ideals will not be shaken!
it: \bSplendido. Davvero splendido, mio giovane Allenatore. Rifiuti i miei ideali senza pensarci due volte... Eppure. Non cederò! Non mi piegherò! I miei ideali non vacilleranno!

id: \bArchie: What do we have here? That's quite a fierce expression for such a wee little scamp. Heh!
en: \bArchie: What do we have here? That's quite a fierce expression for such a wee little scamp. Heh!
it: \bIvan: Cosa abbiamo qui? Che espressione feroce per una piccola peste come te. Eh!

id: \bThat face tells me you're not just another mindless brat. The name's Archie, leading the Team Aqua at its top!
en: \bThat face tells me you're not just another mindless brat. The name's Archie, leading the Team Aqua at its top!
it: \bQuella faccia mi dice che non sei il solito moccioso senza cervello. Mi chiamo Ivan, e sono il capo del Team Idro!

id: \bDo you know that all life in this world depend on the sea for life? But day by day, we're all destroying our most precious resource!
en: \bDo you know that all life in this world depend on the sea for life? But day by day, we're all destroying our most precious resource!
it: \bLo sai che tutta la vita di questo mondo dipende dal mare? Eppure giorno dopo giorno stiamo distruggendo la nostra risorsa più preziosa!

id: \bPokémon suffer as a result of our action. That's why I came to a decision. We, Team Aqua, will return everything to its unspoiled beginnings!
en: \bPokémon suffer as a result of our action. That's why I came to a decision. We, Team Aqua, will return everything to its unspoiled beginnings!
it: \bI Pokémon soffrono a causa delle nostre azioni. Per questo ho preso una decisione. Noi del Team Idro riporteremo tutto alle sue origini incontaminate!

id: \bArchie: Bwahahahahahaha! Bwaha! Well, if it isn't my little adversary! I can't even find the words to praise you as you deserve.
en: \bArchie: Bwahahahahahaha! Bwaha! Well, if it isn't my little adversary! I can't even find the words to praise you as you deserve.
it: \bIvan: Muahahahahahah! Muaha! Ma guarda, il mio piccolo avversario! Non trovo nemmeno le parole per lodarti come meriti.

id: \bSometimes it's best to keep things simple. All I'll say is you met my expectations, scamp! But it changes nothing! I can't give up now! I can't!
en: \bSometimes it's best to keep things simple. All I'll say is you met my expectations, scamp! But it changes nothing! I can't give up now! I can't!
it: \bA volte è meglio essere semplici. Dirò solo che sei stato all'altezza delle mie aspettative, peste! Ma questo non cambia nulla! Non posso arrendermi ora! Non posso!

id: \bRowan: It's so very nice to meet you! Allow me to properly introduce myself first. My name, as you know, is Rowan. I study Pokémon.
en: \bRowan: It's so very nice to meet you! Allow me to properly introduce myself first. My name, as you know, is Rowan. I study Pokémon.
it: \bRowan: È un vero piacere conoscerti! Prima permettimi di presentarmi come si deve. Il mio nome, come sai, è Rowan. Studio i Pokémon.

id: \bAt times we play together, and at other times we work together. Some people use their Pokémon to battle and develop closer bonds with them.
en: \bAt times we play together, and at other times we work together. Some people use their Pokémon to battle and develop closer bonds with them.
it: \bA volte giochiamo insieme, altre volte lavoriamo insieme. Alcune persone usano i propri Pokémon per lottare e stringere con loro legami più profondi.

id: \bEven now, I get a thrill when I'm with Pokémon, so let's begin our test on the bonds with our Pokemon.
en: \bEven now, I get a thrill when I'm with Pokémon, so let's begin our test on the bonds with our Pokemon.
it: \bAncora oggi provo un brivido quando sono con i Pokémon, quindi cominciamo la nostra prova sul legame con i nostri Pokémon.

id: \bRowan: Your last battle was splendid! It's only natural that I come and witness the your crowning glory.
en: \bRowan: Your last battle was splendid! It's only natural that I come and witness the your crowning glory.
it: \bRowan: La tua ultima lotta è stata splendida! È naturale che io venga ad assistere al tuo momento di gloria.

id: \bBut the world is immense. There are many more Pokémon. That means there are many more thrills for you to seek and enjoy!
en: \bBut the world is immense. There are many more Pokémon. That means there are many more thrills for you to seek and enjoy!
it: \bMa il mondo è immenso. Ci sono molti altri Pokémon. Questo significa che ci sono molti altri brividi da cercare e da vivere!

id: \bCyrus: ...I see. You must be the Trainer I've been hearing about. Although I'd hardly expected to see that the foolhardy is a mere child.
en: \bCyrus: ...I see. You must be the Trainer I've been hearing about. Although I'd hardly expected to see that the foolhardy is a mere child.
it: \bCyrus: ...Capisco. Tu devi essere l'Allenatore di cui ho sentito parlare. Anche se non mi aspettavo che quello sconsiderato fosse solo un ragazzino.

id: \bBut, I must say... You are a remarkable specimen. Such pitifully useless emotions... Hear me! This world of ours is a crude one, it is incomplete!
en: \bBut, I must say... You are a remarkable specimen.  Such pitifully useless emotions... Hear me! This world of ours is a crude one, it is incomplete!
it: \bMa devo dire... Sei un esemplare notevole.  Emozioni così pietosamente inutili... Ascoltami! Questo nostro mondo è rozzo, è incompleto!

id: \bThe world must change. Then, who will change it? Me, Cyrus. And Team Galactic. I will make you regret paying heed to your heart!
en: \bThe world must change. Then, who will change it?  Me, Cyrus. And Team Galactic. I will make you regret paying heed to your heart!
it: \bIl mondo deve cambiare. E chi lo cambierà?  Io, Cyrus. E il Team Galassia. Ti farò pentire di aver dato retta al tuo cuore!

id: \bCyrus: I see... You are indeed strong. And the basis of your power is your compassion towards Pokémon.
en: \bCyrus: I see... You are indeed strong. And the basis of your power is your compassion towards Pokémon.
it: \bCyrus: Capisco... Sei davvero forte. E la base del tuo potere è la tua compassione verso i Pokémon.

id: \b...How wasteful... Such emotions are but mere illusions. ...But that doesn't matter. I doubt you will ever understand my position.
en: \b...How wasteful... Such emotions are but mere illusions. ...But that doesn't matter. I doubt you will ever understand my position.
it: \b...Che spreco... Emozioni simili non sono che semplici illusioni. ...Ma non importa. Dubito che capirai mai la mia posizione.

id: \rJuniper: Hi there! My name is Professor Juniper, and I am researching when and how the creatures called Pokémon came into existence.
en: \rJuniper: Hi there! My name is Professor Juniper, and I am researching when and how the creatures called Pokémon came into existence.
it: \rAralia: Ciao! Mi chiamo Professoressa Aralia e sto studiando quando e come sono nate le creature chiamate Pokémon.

id: \rThey come in many shapes and live in many different places. Living and working together, we complement each other.
en: \rThey come in many shapes and live in many different places. Living and working together, we complement each other.
it: \rHanno forme diverse e vivono in tanti luoghi differenti. Vivendo e lavorando insieme, ci completiamo a vicenda.

id: \rHaving Pokémon battles between one another deepens the bonds between people and Pokémon. So, are you ready?
en: \rHaving Pokémon battles between one another deepens the bonds between people and Pokémon. So, are you ready?
it: \rLe lotte Pokémon rafforzano i legami tra le persone e i Pokémon. Allora, sei pronto?

id: \rJuniper: I am astonished. Nice work! I bet I will hear the words from people about your blazing paths around the world!
en: \rJuniper: I am astonished. Nice work! I bet I will hear the words from people about your blazing paths around the world!
it: \rAralia: Sono sbalordita. Ottimo lavoro! Scommetto che sentirò parlare delle tue imprese sfolgoranti in giro per il mondo!

id: \rI really hope you learn what is important to you as a result, because Pokémon create chances to meet more wonderful people and Pokémon!
en: \rI really hope you learn what is important to you as a result, because Pokémon create chances to meet more wonderful people and Pokémon!
it: \rSpero davvero che grazie a questo tu capisca cosa è importante per te, perché i Pokémon creano occasioni per incontrare altre persone e Pokémon meravigliosi!

id: \bGhetsis: My name is Ghetsis. I am here representing Team Plasma. I would like to talk to you about Pokémon liberation.
en: \bGhetsis: My name is Ghetsis. I am here representing Team Plasma. I would like to talk to you about Pokémon liberation.
it: \bGhecis: Il mio nome è Ghecis. Sono qui in rappresentanza del Team Plasma. Vorrei parlarti della liberazione dei Pokémon.

id: \bPokémon are subject to the selfish commands of Trainers. They are different from humans, since they contain unknown potential.
en: \bPokémon are subject to the selfish commands of Trainers. They are different from humans, since they contain unknown potential.
it: \bI Pokémon sono soggetti agli ordini egoisti degli Allenatori. Sono diversi dagli umani, perché racchiudono un potenziale sconosciuto.

id: \bThat's right! We must liberate the Pokémon! Then, and only then, will humans and Pokémon truly be equals!!!
en: \bThat's right! We must liberate the Pokémon! Then, and only then, will humans and Pokémon truly be equals!!!
it: \bEsatto! Dobbiamo liberare i Pokémon! Allora, e solo allora, umani e Pokémon saranno davvero uguali!!!

id: \bGhetsis: My calculations... No! My careful schemes! This doesn't change my goal. My secret plans have not been disturbed!
en: \bGhetsis: My calculations... No! My careful schemes! This doesn't change my goal. My secret plans have not been disturbed!
it: \bGhecis: I miei calcoli... No! I miei piani accurati! Questo non cambia il mio obiettivo. I miei piani segreti non sono stati compromessi!

id: \bI'm absolutely perfect! I AM PERFECTION! I'm the absolute ruler who will change the world!
en: \bI'm absolutely perfect! I AM PERFECTION! I'm the absolute ruler who will change the world!
it: \bSono assolutamente perfetto! IO SONO LA PERFEZIONE! Sono il sovrano assoluto che cambierà il mondo!

id: \bN: Your Pokemon... Just now, it was saying... Oh, you can't hear it. How sad. My name is N.
en: \bN: Your Pokemon... Just now, it was saying... Oh, you can't hear it. How sad. My name is N.
it: \bN: Il tuo Pokémon... Proprio adesso, stava dicendo... Oh, tu non puoi sentirlo. Che tristezza. Mi chiamo N.

id: \bSo, you've confined most of your Pokémon in Poké Balls. I'm a Trainer, too, but I can't help wondering, are Pokémon really happy that way?
en: \bSo, you've confined most of your Pokémon in Poké Balls. I'm a Trainer, too, but I can't help wondering, are Pokémon really happy that way?
it: \bQuindi tieni rinchiusi quasi tutti i tuoi Pokémon nelle Poké Ball. Anch'io sono un Allenatore, ma non posso fare a meno di chiedermi: i Pokémon sono davvero felici così?

id: \bWell, let me hear your Pokémon's voice again! I wanna understand you. Show me!
en: \bWell, let me hear your Pokémon's voice again! I wanna understand you. Show me!
it: \bBene, fammi sentire di nuovo la voce dei tuoi Pokémon! Voglio capirti. Mostramela!

id: \bN: I never expected to hear Pokémon say such things... As long as Pokémon are confined in Poké Balls... Pokémon will never become perfect beings.
en: \bN: I never expected to hear Pokémon say such things... As long as Pokémon are confined in Poké Balls... Pokémon will never become perfect beings.
it: \bN: Non mi sarei mai aspettato di sentire i Pokémon dire cose simili... Finché i Pokémon resteranno rinchiusi nelle Poké Ball... non diventeranno mai esseri perfetti.

id: \bI have to change the world for Pokémon, because they're my friends. So, I need power... Power enough to make anyone agree with me.
en: \bI have to change the world for Pokémon, because they're my friends. So, I need power... Power enough to make anyone agree with me.
it: \bDevo cambiare il mondo per i Pokémon, perché sono miei amici. Per questo mi serve potere... Abbastanza potere da convincere chiunque.

id: \bSycamore: I am Augustine Sycamore. Hello! This world of ours is widely inhabited by creatures known as Pokémon!
en: \bSycamore: I am Augustine Sycamore. Hello! This world of ours is widely inhabited by creatures known as Pokémon!
it: \bPlatan: Sono Augustine Platan. Ciao! Questo nostro mondo è abitato ovunque da creature chiamate Pokémon!

id: \bSome run across the plains, others fly through the skies, and others yet swim in deep oceans...
en: \bSome run across the plains, others fly through the skies, and others yet swim in deep oceans...
it: \bAlcuni corrono nelle pianure, altri volano nei cieli, altri ancora nuotano negli oceani profondi...

id: \bNow, let's all have a Pokémon battle! Your opponent shall be me and my Pokémon, lending strength to one another to victory!
en: \bNow, let's all have a Pokémon battle! Your opponent shall be me and my Pokémon, lending strength to one another to victory!
it: \bE ora facciamo tutti una lotta Pokémon! Il tuo avversario sarò io con i miei Pokémon, che uniremo le forze per vincere!

id: \bSycamore: Well now, you DO have a certain je ne sais quoi! I have a good feeling about you!
en: \bSycamore: Well now, you DO have a certain je ne sais quoi! I have a good feeling about you!
it: \bPlatan: Ebbene, hai proprio un certo non so che! Ho un buon presentimento su di te!

id: \bThe strength you've found is simply marvelous! You truly love and trust your Pokémon! Treasure these moments with your partner Pokémon.
en: \bThe strength you've found is simply marvelous! You truly love and trust your Pokémon! Treasure these moments with your partner Pokémon.
it: \bLa forza che hai trovato è semplicemente meravigliosa! Ami e ti fidi davvero dei tuoi Pokémon! Custodisci questi momenti con i tuoi compagni Pokémon.

id: \bLysandre: You have a Pokédex; you are one of the chosen ones. I am Lysandre. I've tried to learn as much about Pokémon as I can to help build a brighter future.
en: \bLysandre: You have a Pokédex; you are one of the chosen ones. I am Lysandre. I've tried to learn as much about Pokémon as I can to help build a brighter future.
it: \bElisio: Hai un Pokédex: sei uno dei prescelti. Io sono Elisio. Ho cercato di imparare il più possibile sui Pokémon per contribuire a costruire un futuro più luminoso.

id: \bAnd to conclude, unproductive fools are consuming our future. Team Flare needs to wipe the slate clean.
en: \bAnd to conclude, unproductive fools are consuming our future. Team Flare needs to wipe the slate clean.
it: \bE per concludere, gli stolti improduttivi stanno consumando il nostro futuro. Il Team Flare deve fare piazza pulita.

id: \bKnowledge is power, after all. Put it to good use. It is vital that this world becomes a better place. My desire... It is for a more beautiful world!
en: \bKnowledge is power, after all. Put it to good use. It is vital that this world becomes a better place. My desire... It is for a more beautiful world!
it: \bDopotutto, la conoscenza è potere. Usala bene. È fondamentale che questo mondo diventi un posto migliore. Il mio desiderio... è un mondo più bello!

id: \bLysandre: Excellent! But what are you really protecting? A tomorrow that will only end up being worse than today?
en: \bLysandre: Excellent! But what are you really protecting? A tomorrow that will only end up being worse than today?
it: \bElisio: Eccellente! Ma cosa stai proteggendo davvero? Un domani che finirà per essere peggiore di oggi?

id: \bIt's over... Fools with no vision will continue to befoul this beautiful world.
en: \bIt's over... Fools with no vision will continue to befoul this beautiful world.
it: \bÈ finita... Gli stolti senza visione continueranno a insudiciare questo mondo meraviglioso.

id: \bKukui: Hey there, nice to meet you! The name's Kukui. I hope we can be friends!
en: \bKukui: Hey there, nice to meet you! The name's Kukui. I hope we can be friends!
it: \bKukui: Ehi, piacere di conoscerti! Mi chiamo Kukui. Spero che diventeremo amici!

id: \bI love to understand Pokemon's potential and capabilities, so I let myself get hit with all kinds of moves so I can test their power!
en: \bI love to understand Pokemon's potential and capabilities, so I let myself get hit with all kinds of moves so I can test their power!
it: \bAdoro capire il potenziale e le capacità dei Pokémon, quindi mi faccio colpire da ogni tipo di mossa per metterne alla prova la potenza!

id: \bNow, you wanna go through my trial to make yourself stronger? That's right, put yourself to the test!
en: \bNow, you wanna go through my trial to make yourself stronger? That's right, put yourself to the test!
it: \bAllora, vuoi superare la mia prova per diventare più forte? Esatto, mettiti alla prova!

id: \bKukui: I couldn't win even though I went all out... But what a refreshing feeling! Woo!
en: \bKukui: I couldn't win even though I went all out...  But what a refreshing feeling! Woo!
it: \bKukui: Non sono riuscito a vincere nonostante abbia dato il massimo...  Ma che sensazione rinfrescante! Wooo!

id: \bWell, I always knew it would be a crushing defeat. I'm still glad I got to battle you. And I'm as thankful as I could be that I met you and your Pokémon!
en: \bWell, I always knew it would be a crushing defeat.  I'm still glad I got to battle you. And I'm as thankful as I could be that I met you and your Pokémon!
it: \bBeh, l'ho sempre saputo che sarebbe stata una sconfitta schiacciante.  Sono comunque felice di aver lottato con te. E sono più che grato di aver conosciuto te e i tuoi Pokémon!

id: \bGuzma: Greetings, cowering brat! The hated boss who beats you down, and beats you down, and never lets up... Yeah. Big bad Guzma is here!
en: \bGuzma: Greetings, cowering brat! The hated boss who beats you down, and beats you down, and never lets up... Yeah. Big bad Guzma is here!
it: \bGuzman: Salve, moccioso tremante! Il capo odiato che ti sconfigge, ti sconfigge e non molla mai... Già. Il grande e cattivo Guzman è qui!

id: \bWe've got all these moldy old traditions of gyms and trials, It's about time we cut out all that silly garbage and make something new for ourselves.
en: \bWe've got all these moldy old traditions of gyms and trials, It's about time we cut out all that silly garbage and make something new for ourselves.
it: \bAbbiamo tutte queste vecchie tradizioni ammuffite di Palestre e prove. È ora di eliminare tutta quella robaccia stupida e creare qualcosa di nuovo per noi.

id: \bAfter all, everyone already knows who the strongest Trainer is here. Wanna see what destruction looks like? Here it is in human form - it's your boy Guzma!
en: \bAfter all, everyone already knows who the strongest Trainer is here. Wanna see what destruction looks like? Here it is in human form - it's your boy Guzma!
it: \bDopotutto, qui tutti sanno già chi è l'Allenatore più forte. Vuoi vedere che aspetto ha la distruzione? Eccola in forma umana: è il tuo caro Guzman!

id: \bGuzma: I see. Great work... I guess. You had some real guts.
en: \bGuzma: I see. Great work... I guess. You had some real guts.
it: \bGuzman: Capisco. Ottimo lavoro... credo. Hai avuto del fegato.

id: \bIt was \PN, right? I'll remember you... as someone I'll be happy to beat down anytime!
en: \bIt was \PN, right? I'll remember you... as someone I'll be happy to beat down anytime!
it: \bEri \PN, giusto? Mi ricorderò di te... come qualcuno che sarò felice di stendere in qualunque momento!

id: \rLusamine: I am the president of the Aether Foundation. But please, just call me Lusamine. I'm so glad that we got to meet.
en: \rLusamine: I am the president of the Aether Foundation. But please, just call me Lusamine. I'm so glad that we got to meet.
it: \rSamina: Sono la presidentessa della Fondazione Aether. Ma ti prego, chiamami semplicemente Samina. Sono così felice che ci siamo incontrati.

id: \rThere are people like you, who travel the islands to learn more about Pokémon. There are also unfortunate people who harm Pokémon for reasons.
en: \rThere are people like you, who travel the islands to learn more about Pokémon. There are also unfortunate people who harm Pokémon for reasons.
it: \rCi sono persone come te, che viaggiano per le isole per conoscere meglio i Pokémon. Ci sono anche persone sciagurate che fanno del male ai Pokémon per i loro motivi.

id: \rI will be like a mother to all of those poor Pokémon and shower them with love. They will all be preserved for eternity in my collection.
en: \rI will be like a mother to all of those poor Pokémon and shower them with love. They will all be preserved for eternity in my collection.
it: \rSarò come una madre per tutti quei poveri Pokémon e li ricoprirò d'amore. Saranno tutti conservati per l'eternità nella mia collezione.

id: \rOh, don't you worry. You just leave everything up to me. Trust me, children would all be much happier if they'd only listen to the adults around them.
en: \rOh, don't you worry. You just leave everything up to me. Trust me, children would all be much happier if they'd only listen to the adults around them.
it: \rOh, non preoccuparti. Lascia fare tutto a me. Fidati, i bambini sarebbero molto più felici se solo ascoltassero gli adulti intorno a loro.

id: \rLusamine: What a disappointment... To think that you are all so small-minded...
en: \rLusamine: What a disappointment... To think that you are all so small-minded...
it: \rSamina: Che delusione... Pensare che siete tutti così meschini...

id: \rAll that I want is my precious beasts! I don't care about any of the rest of you! Just leave. I don't need you here... I don't need you any longer!
en: \rAll that I want is my precious beasts! I don't care about any of the rest of you! Just leave. I don't need you here... I don't need you any longer!
it: \rTutto ciò che voglio sono le mie preziose creature! Non m'importa niente di tutti voi! Andatevene e basta. Non ho bisogno di voi qui... Non ho più bisogno di voi!

id: \rCheryl: Hello, my name's Cheryl. I'm sincerely glad to meet you.
en: \rCheryl: Hello, my name's Cheryl. I'm sincerely glad to meet you.
it: \rCheryl: Ciao, mi chiamo Cheryl. Sono sinceramente felice di conoscerti.

id: \rYou're my opponent of the day? My Pokémon have been itching for a battle.
en: \rYou're my opponent of the day? My Pokémon have been itching for a battle.
it: \rSei tu il mio avversario di oggi? I miei Pokémon non vedono l'ora di lottare.

id: \rYou won't be able to tire them out one by one!
en: \rYou won't be able to tire them out one by one!
it: \rNon riuscirai a sfiancarli uno per uno!

id: \rCheryl: Thank you! My adorable Pokémon became a little tougher.
en: \rCheryl: Thank you! My adorable Pokémon became a little tougher.
it: \rCheryl: Grazie! I miei adorabili Pokémon sono diventati un po' più forti.

id: \rBeing a Trainer isn't easy. The more you battle, the more you discover. But, you know? I love Pokémon for that, too!
en: \rBeing a Trainer isn't easy. The more you battle, the more you discover. But, you know? I love Pokémon for that, too!
it: \rEssere un Allenatore non è facile. Più lotti, più scopri. Ma sai una cosa? Amo i Pokémon anche per questo!

id: \rMira: I'm Mira... I want to get tougher so I won't be such a scaredy-cat.
en: \rMira: I'm Mira... I want to get tougher so I won't be such a scaredy-cat.
it: \rMira: Sono Mira... Voglio diventare più forte per non essere più una fifona.

id: \rSo get ready, Mira will show you all of what she got!
en: \rSo get ready, Mira will show you all of what she got!
it: \rQuindi preparati, Mira ti mostrerà tutto quello che sa fare!

id: \rMira: Mira wonders if she can get very far in the Battle Tower.
en: \rMira: Mira wonders if she can get very far in the Battle Tower.
it: \rMira: Mira si chiede se riuscirà ad andare lontano nella Torre Lotta.

id: \rBut It seems you are always with your Pokémon. That's how you got to be so strong. Mira is beginning to understand!
en: \rBut It seems you are always with your Pokémon. That's how you got to be so strong. Mira is beginning to understand!
it: \rMa sembra che tu stia sempre con i tuoi Pokémon. È così che sei diventato tanto forte. Mira comincia a capire!

id: \bRiley: I'm Riley. I'm a Trainer, and yes, it is a bit odd that I would be training here.
en: \bRiley: I'm Riley. I'm a Trainer, and yes, it is a bit odd that I would be training here.
it: \bRiley: Sono Riley. Sono un Allenatore e sì, è un po' strano che io mi alleni qui.

id: \bPeople training here would be those with too much time on their hands. So let's hope we can give each other a tough time!
en: \bPeople training here would be those with too much time on their hands. So let's hope we can give each other a tough time!
it: \bChi si allena qui di solito ha troppo tempo libero. Quindi speriamo di metterci a dura prova a vicenda!

id: \bNow, we will be pulling out all the stops to put your Pokémon down.
en: \bNow, we will be pulling out all the stops to put your Pokémon down.
it: \bE ora non ci risparmieremo pur di mettere al tappeto i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bRiley: Know your enemy. If you know your opponent's Pokémon and what moves they use...
en: \bRiley: Know your enemy. If you know your opponent's Pokémon and what moves they use...
it: \bRiley: Conosci il tuo nemico. Se conosci i Pokémon del tuo avversario e le mosse che usano...

id: \bIf you have intelligence like that, your chances of winning are much improved.
en: \bIf you have intelligence like that, your chances of winning are much improved.
it: \bAvere informazioni del genere aumenta di molto le tue probabilità di vittoria.

id: \bBuck: Hehehe! Sorry! If you wanna be the greatest Trainer ever, that's going to be really tough. Because you're talking about me!
en: \bBuck: Hehehe! Sorry! If you wanna be the greatest Trainer ever, that's going to be really tough. Because you're talking about me!
it: \bBuck: Eheheh! Scusa! Se vuoi diventare il più grande Allenatore di sempre, sarà davvero dura. Perché stai parlando di me!

id: \bYou look puzzled. You really don't know anything, do you? Anyways, howdy, I'm Buck.
en: \bYou look puzzled. You really don't know anything, do you? Anyways, howdy, I'm Buck.
it: \bSembri confuso. Non sai proprio niente, eh? Comunque, salve, sono Buck.

id: \bI can feel my Pokémon shivering inside their Poké balls! It's out of anticipation, not fear!
en: \bI can feel my Pokémon shivering inside their Poké balls! It's out of anticipation, not fear!
it: \bSento i miei Pokémon tremare nelle loro Poké Ball! È per l'attesa, non per la paura!

id: \bBuck: Fweh! Too much! I guess I'll humble down and better my team on the field.
en: \bBuck: Fweh! Too much! I guess I'll humble down and better my team on the field.
it: \bBuck: Uff! Troppo forte! Credo che farò un po' di umiltà e migliorerò la mia squadra sul campo.

id: \bI'd better shape up on the field for a rematch against you here!
en: \bI'd better shape up on the field for a rematch against you here!
it: \bFarò meglio a rimettermi in forma sul campo per una rivincita contro di te qui!

id: \rMarley: I...am Marley. I... I don't like to talk... I choose my words carefully, but they may still hurt someone accidentally...
en: \rMarley: I...am Marley. I... I don't like to talk... I choose my words carefully, but they may still hurt someone accidentally...
it: \rMarley: Io... sono Marley. Io... non amo parlare... Scelgo le parole con cura, ma potrebbero comunque ferire qualcuno senza volerlo...

id: \rWhen I think of that, I clam up... So sorry about that...
en: \rWhen I think of that, I clam up... So sorry about that...
it: \rQuando ci penso, mi chiudo in me stessa... Scusami tanto...

id: \r...So? ...Are we going to battle? ...OK. I'll do my best.
en: \r...So? ...Are we going to battle? ...OK. I'll do my best.
it: \r...Allora? ...Lottiamo? ...OK. Farò del mio meglio.

id: \rMarley: ...You're so strong. It makes me feel happy. ...I don't know why. This is a strange feeling...
en: \rMarley: ...You're so strong. It makes me feel happy.  ...I don't know why. This is a strange feeling...
it: \rMarley: ...Sei così forte. Mi rende felice.  ...Non so perché. È una sensazione strana...

id: \r...I might like battling with you. ...Just a little. Only a tiny bit.
en: \r...I might like battling with you. ...Just a little. Only a tiny bit.
it: \r...Forse mi piace lottare con te. ...Solo un po'. Solo un pochino.

id: \bEusine: My name is Eusine. I'm on the trail of a Pokémon named Suicune. Glad to meet you.
en: \bEusine: My name is Eusine. I'm on the trail of a Pokémon named Suicune. Glad to meet you.
it: \bEusine: Mi chiamo Eusine. Sono sulle tracce di un Pokémon chiamato Suicune. Piacere di conoscerti.

id: \bThere seems to be more than meets the eye with you... My gut tells me you seem to have met Suicune before.
en: \bThere seems to be more than meets the eye with you... My gut tells me you seem to have met Suicune before.
it: \bIn te c'è più di quanto sembri... Il mio istinto mi dice che hai già incontrato Suicune.

id: \bMy desire to search for Suicune is far greater than yours... I won't stop following you until I've found out what I'm after!
en: \bMy desire to search for Suicune is far greater than yours... I won't stop following you until I've found out what I'm after!
it: \bIl mio desiderio di cercare Suicune è molto più grande del tuo... Non smetterò di seguirti finché non avrò trovato ciò che cerco!

id: \bEusine: Puff, puff... I am... no match for you. ...As I predicted.
en: \bEusine: Puff, puff... I am... no match for you. ...As I predicted.
it: \bEusine: Uff, uff... Non sono... alla tua altezza. ...Come previsto.

id: \bI have never seen a battle this intense! I have no regrets... Farewell for now. But I will come back to get what I'm looking from you!
en: \bI have never seen a battle this intense! I have no regrets... Farewell for now. But I will come back to get what I'm looking from you!
it: \bNon ho mai visto una lotta così intensa! Non ho rimpianti... Addio, per ora. Ma tornerò a prendermi da te ciò che cerco!

id: \bEmmet: I am Emmet. I am a Subway Boss. And I like winning more than anything else.
en: \bEmmet: I am Emmet. I am a Subway Boss. And I like winning more than anything else.
it: \bEmmet: Io sono Emmet. Sono un Capo Metrò. E mi piace vincere più di ogni altra cosa.

id: \bI am really serious. Really serious. Because if a battle is not serious, it is not fun.
en: \bI am really serious. Really serious. Because if a battle is not serious, it is not fun.
it: \bSono molto serio. Molto serio. Perché se una lotta non è seria, non è divertente.

id: \bSo everything's ready! Aim for victory! All aboard!
en: \bSo everything's ready! Aim for victory! All aboard!
it: \bAllora è tutto pronto! Punta alla vittoria! In carrozza!

id: \bEmmet: I lost against you. Because you are the strongest Trainer I've fought lately. You're a verrrrry strong Trainer! Yup! It was fun!
en: \bEmmet: I lost against you. Because you are the strongest Trainer I've fought lately. You're a verrrrry strong Trainer! Yup! It was fun!
it: \bEmmet: Ho perso contro di te. Perché sei l'Allenatore più forte che ho affrontato ultimamente. Sei un Allenatore fortissimooo! Sì! È stato divertente!

id: \bYou want to win, and I don't want to lose. That's real. When we clash in battles, I feel very excited!
en: \bYou want to win, and I don't want to lose. That's real. When we clash in battles, I feel very excited!
it: \bTu vuoi vincere e io non voglio perdere. Questa è la verità. Quando ci scontriamo in lotta, mi emoziono tantissimo!

id: \bIngo: I am the Subway Boss Ingo. Do you understand Pokémon well? Can you hold on to your principle?
en: \bIngo: I am the Subway Boss Ingo. Do you understand Pokémon well? Can you hold on to your principle?
it: \bIngo: Sono il Capo Metrò Ingo. Conosci bene i Pokémon? Riesci a tener fede ai tuoi principi?

id: \bWhat can I see after winning, winning, and winning? You cannot know what happens after winning without winning.
en: \bWhat can I see after winning, winning, and winning? You cannot know what happens after winning without winning.
it: \bCosa posso vedere dopo aver vinto, vinto e ancora vinto? Non puoi sapere cosa succede dopo la vittoria senza vincere.

id: \bTherefore, I will exert every possible effort to battle with you. All aboard!
en: \bTherefore, I will exert every possible effort to battle with you. All aboard!
it: \bPerciò metterò tutto il mio impegno nella lotta contro di te. In carrozza!

id: \bIngo: Bravo! Excellent!! I am glad that I fought so hard against a wonderful Trainer like you.
en: \bIngo: Bravo! Excellent!! I am glad that I fought so hard against a wonderful Trainer like you.
it: \bIngo: Bravo! Eccellente!! Sono felice di aver lottato così duramente contro un Allenatore meraviglioso come te.

id: \bYour talent has brought you to the destination called Victory! However, your journey has just started.
en: \bYour talent has brought you to the destination called Victory! However, your journey has just started.
it: \bIl tuo talento ti ha portato alla stazione chiamata Vittoria! Tuttavia, il tuo viaggio è appena cominciato.

id: \rThink about it, OK? Hehe.
en: \rThink about it, OK? Hehe.
it: \rPensaci, OK? Ehehe.

id: \rLyra: Awww. Guess I got the L this time. Tough luck.
en: \rLyra: Awww. Guess I got the L this time. Tough luck.
it: \rLyra: Uffa. Stavolta ho perso io. Pazienza.

id: \bEthan: Oh, hey? I'm Ethan. What 'cha doing here? On an adventure?
en: \bEthan: Oh, hey? I'm Ethan. What 'cha doing here?  On an adventure?
it: \bEthan: Oh, ciao! Io sono Ethan. Che ci fai qui? Sei in viaggio all'avventura?

id: \bI'm looking forward to battle against you, but let's be friends after this, ok?
en: \bI'm looking forward to battle against you, but let's be friends after this, ok?
it: \bNon vedo l'ora di lottare contro di te, ma dopo restiamo amici, ok?

id: \bMy desire to search for Suicune is far beyond yours... I won't stop following you until I've found out what I'm after!
en: \bMy desire to search for Suicune is far beyond yours... I won't stop following you until I've found out what I'm after!
it: \bIl mio desiderio di trovare Suicune è molto più forte del tuo... Non smetterò di seguirti finché non avrò trovato ciò che cerco!

id: \bNoland: Hey, I had a look at your Battle Swap data. You seem to have the right idea, but you're still square in your head!
en: \bNoland: Hey, I had a look at your Battle Swap data. You seem to have the right idea, but you're still square in your head!
it: \bNoland: Ehi, ho dato un'occhiata ai tuoi dati del Battle Swap. Sembri avere l'idea giusta, ma hai ancora la testa troppo rigida!

id: \bListen up, okay? Knowledge isn't only about reading books or doing desk work. It may as well be useless!
en: \bListen up, okay? Knowledge isn't only about reading books or doing desk work. It may as well be useless!
it: \bAscolta bene, ok? La conoscenza non è solo leggere libri o stare dietro una scrivania. Così rischia di essere inutile!

id: \bYou have to experience things with your heart and your body, understand? Shake out every last bit of your knowledge and bring it on!
en: \bYou have to experience things with your heart and your body, understand? Shake out every last bit of your knowledge and bring it on!
it: \bDevi vivere le cose col cuore e col corpo, capito? Tira fuori fino all'ultima briciola di quello che sai e fatti sotto!

id: \bNoland: Pfft, man! That's absolutely the last time I lose to you! We have to do this again, hey!
en: \bNoland: Pfft, man! That's absolutely the last time I lose to you! We have to do this again, hey!
it: \bNoland: Pfft, accidenti! È davvero l'ultima volta che perdo contro di te! Dobbiamo rifarlo, eh!

id: \bI'll come after you hard. No holds barred, understand?
en: \bI'll come after you hard. No holds barred, understand?
it: \bVerrò a prenderti con tutte le mie forze. Senza esclusione di colpi, capito?

id: \rGreta: Hey! Howdy! ...Wait, are you the challenger? I don't know how to say it, but... To put it bluntly, you look pretty weak.
en: \rGreta: Hey! Howdy! ...Wait, are you the challenger? I don't know how to say it, but... To put it bluntly, you look pretty weak.
it: \rGreta: Ehi! Ciao! ...Aspetta, sei tu lo sfidante? Non so come dirlo, ma... A dirla tutta, sembri parecchio debole.

id: \rAre you sure you're up for me? Hmm... Well, all right! We'll take things easy to start with!
en: \rAre you sure you're up for me? Hmm... Well, all right! We'll take things easy to start with!
it: \rSei sicuro di essere alla mia altezza? Mmh... Be', va bene! Cominciamo con calma!

id: \rOkay! Let's see you ignite my passion for battle!
en: \rOkay! Let's see you ignite my passion for battle!
it: \rOkay! Vediamo se riesci ad accendere la mia passione per la lotta!

id: \rGreta: Ow, wait a second! You are tough after all! I like you!
en: \rGreta: Ow, wait a second! You are tough after all! I like you!
it: \rGreta: Ahi, aspetta un attimo! Allora sei forte davvero! Mi piaci!

id: \rIf we ever battle again, I won't lose! Don't you forget it! Bye-bye!
en: \rIf we ever battle again, I won't lose! Don't you forget it! Bye-bye!
it: \rSe lotteremo di nuovo, non perderò! Non dimenticarlo! Ciao ciao!

id: \bTucker: Ahahah! Do you hear this crowd! They're all itching to see our match! Ahahah!
