en: \bTucker: Ahahah! Do you hear this crowd! They're all itching to see our match! Ahahah!
it: \bTucker: Ahahah! Senti questa folla? Non vedono l'ora di assistere al nostro incontro! Ahahah!

id: \bI bet you're twitching all over from the tension of getting to battle me! But don't worry about a thing!
en: \bI bet you're twitching all over from the tension of getting to battle me! But don't worry about a thing!
it: \bScommetto che stai tremando tutto per la tensione di lottare contro di me! Ma non preoccuparti di niente!

id: \bTucker, the star of the show, will bathe you in a brilliant glow! Right here and now! Let's see it!
en: \bTucker, the star of the show, will bathe you in a brilliant glow! Right here and now! Let's see it!
it: \bTucker, la star dello spettacolo, ti avvolgerà in un bagliore sfavillante! Qui e ora! Vediamo un po'!

id: \bTucker: You're strong, but above all, you have a unique charm!
en: \bTucker: You're strong, but above all, you have a unique charm!
it: \bTucker: Sei forte, ma soprattutto hai un fascino unico!

id: \bIn you, I see a definite potential for a superstar like me. I will very much look forward to our next encounter!
en: \bIn you, I see a definite potential for a superstar like me. I will very much look forward to our next encounter!
it: \bIn te vedo un potenziale certo da superstar, proprio come me. Non vedo l'ora del nostro prossimo incontro!

id: \bSpenser: Young one of a Trainer! Do you believe in your Pokémon? Can you believe them through and through?
en: \bSpenser: Young one of a Trainer! Do you believe in your Pokémon? Can you believe them through and through?
it: \bSpenser: Giovane Allenatore! Credi nei tuoi Pokémon? Riesci a credere in loro fino in fondo?

id: \bMy physical being is with Pokémon always! My heart beats as one with Pokémon always!
en: \bMy physical being is with Pokémon always! My heart beats as one with Pokémon always!
it: \bIl mio corpo è sempre con i Pokémon! Il mio cuore batte sempre all'unisono con i Pokémon!

id: \bIf your bonds of trust are frail, you will never beat my brethren! Prove it to me here!
en: \bIf your bonds of trust are frail, you will never beat my brethren! Prove it to me here!
it: \bSe i vostri legami di fiducia sono fragili, non batterai mai i miei fratelli! Dimostramelo qui!

id: \bSpenser: Well, that was some display! Even fully unleashed, my brethren could not overpower you.
en: \bSpenser: Well, that was some display! Even fully unleashed, my brethren could not overpower you.
it: \bSpenser: Bene, che dimostrazione! Nemmeno scatenati al massimo i miei fratelli sono riusciti a sopraffarti.

id: \bYou team spirit is truly admirable! Your Pokémon's eyes are truly clear and unclouded.
en: \bYou team spirit is truly admirable! Your Pokémon's eyes are truly clear and unclouded.
it: \bIl tuo spirito di squadra è davvero ammirevole! Gli occhi dei tuoi Pokémon sono davvero limpidi e sereni.

id: \rLucy: I am Lucy... I am the law here... For I am the Pike Queen...
en: \rLucy: I am Lucy... I am the law here... For I am the Pike Queen...
it: \rLucy: Io sono Lucy... Qui la legge sono io... Perché io sono la Regina Tubo...

id: \rYou already know it, but to advance, you must defeat me...
en: \rYou already know it, but to advance, you must defeat me...
it: \rLo sai già, ma per andare avanti devi sconfiggermi...

id: \rI'm not one for idle chatter. Hurry. Come on... Your luck... I hope you didn't use it all up here...
en: \rI'm not one for idle chatter. Hurry. Come on... Your luck... I hope you didn't use it all up here...
it: \rNon amo le chiacchiere inutili. Sbrigati. Avanti... La tua fortuna... Spero che tu non l'abbia esaurita tutta qui...

id: \rLucy: ...That's all there is... Disappear already...
en: \rLucy: ...That's all there is... Disappear already...
it: \rLucy: ...È tutto... Ora sparisci...

id: \r...But you, I won't forget... ...Ever...
en: \r...But you, I won't forget... ...Ever...
it: \r...Ma te, non ti dimenticherò... ...Mai...

id: \rAnabel: Greetings... My name is Anabel. I have heard several rumors about you...
en: \rAnabel: Greetings... My name is Anabel. I have heard several rumors about you...
it: \rAnabel: Saluti... Mi chiamo Anabel. Ho sentito diverse voci sul tuo conto...

id: \rIn all honesty, what I have heard does not seem attractive in any way... The reason I've come to see you... Well, there is but one reason...
en: \rIn all honesty, what I have heard does not seem attractive in any way... The reason I've come to see you... Well, there is but one reason...
it: \rA essere sincera, ciò che ho sentito non mi sembra affatto interessante... Il motivo per cui sono venuta a vederti... Be', c'è un solo motivo...

id: \rLet me see your talent in its entirety...
en: \rLet me see your talent in its entirety...
it: \rMostrami il tuo talento in tutta la sua interezza...

id: \rAnabel: Fufufu, nicely done... You have confidence in your Pokémon battling talent, don't you?
en: \rAnabel: Fufufu, nicely done... You have confidence in your Pokémon battling talent, don't you?
it: \rAnabel: Fufufu, ben fatto... Hai fiducia nel tuo talento per le lotte Pokémon, non è vero?

id: \rI urge you to keep battling and keep on winning. I will be waiting for you. Until the next time we meet...
en: \rI urge you to keep battling and keep on winning. I will be waiting for you. Until the next time we meet...
it: \rTi esorto a continuare a lottare e a vincere. Ti aspetterò. Fino al nostro prossimo incontro...

id: \bBrandon: Wouldn't you agree that explorations are the grandest of adventures? Your own wits! Your own strength! Your own Pokémon!
en: \bBrandon: Wouldn't you agree that explorations are the grandest of adventures? Your own wits! Your own strength! Your own Pokémon!
it: \bBrandon: Non sei d'accordo che le esplorazioni siano la più grandiosa delle avventure? Il tuo ingegno! La tua forza! I tuoi Pokémon!

id: \bAnd, above all, only your courage to lead you through unknown worlds...
en: \bAnd, above all, only your courage to lead you through unknown worlds...
it: \bE, soprattutto, solo il tuo coraggio a guidarti attraverso mondi sconosciuti...

id: \bAah yes, young adventurer, indeed this life is grand! Grand, it is! Now, then! Bring your courage to our battle!
en: \bAah yes, young adventurer, indeed this life is grand! Grand, it is! Now, then! Bring your courage to our battle!
it: \bAh sì, giovane avventuriero, questa vita è davvero grandiosa! Grandiosa, sì! E ora! Porta il tuo coraggio nella nostra lotta!

id: \bBrandon: Hahahah! Grand it was! Grand, yes, indeed! Well done!
en: \bBrandon: Hahahah! Grand it was! Grand, yes, indeed! Well done!
it: \bBrandon: Ahahahah! Grandioso! Grandioso davvero, sì! Ben fatto!

id: \bYoung explorer! You've bested me through and through! It just goes to show that I have much to learn still! May our paths cross again!
en: \bYoung explorer! You've bested me through and through! It just goes to show that I have much to learn still! May our paths cross again!
it: \bGiovane esploratore! Mi hai battuto su tutta la linea! Dimostra che ho ancora molto da imparare! Che le nostre strade possano incrociarsi di nuovo!

id: \bPalmer: So, you've come this far! As a trainer of age, I'll have to give you my best effort.
en: \bPalmer: So, you've come this far! As a trainer of age, I'll have to give you my best effort.
it: \bPalmer: Così sei arrivato fin qui! Da Allenatore maturo quale sei, dovrò impegnarmi al massimo.

id: \bThat's how the best Trainers show respect to each other. By battling all out as dedicated students of Pokémon!
en: \bThat's how the best Trainers show respect to each other. By battling all out as dedicated students of Pokémon!
it: \bÈ così che i migliori Allenatori si mostrano rispetto a vicenda. Lottando con tutte le forze, da veri studiosi dei Pokémon!

id: \bShow me the bond you've built with your Pokémon. Show me what you've learned through battles with other Trainers!
en: \bShow me the bond you've built with your Pokémon.  Show me what you've learned through battles with other Trainers!
it: \bMostrami il legame che hai costruito con i tuoi Pokémon.  Mostrami cosa hai imparato lottando con altri Allenatori!

id: \bPalmer: Bravo! I imagine many great Trainers will come to challenge me as you have just done. That's something I look forward to a great deal.
en: \bPalmer: Bravo! I imagine many great Trainers will come to challenge me as you have just done. That's something I look forward to a great deal.
it: \bPalmer: Bravo! Immagino che molti grandi Allenatori verranno a sfidarmi come hai appena fatto tu. È una cosa che attendo con ansia.

id: \bYou will become even more skilled. Keep battling Trainers from around the world and keep growing greater in stature!
en: \bYou will become even more skilled. Keep battling Trainers from around the world and keep growing greater in stature!
it: \bDiventerai ancora più abile. Continua a lottare con Allenatori di tutto il mondo e continua a crescere!

id: \rDahlia: No need to worry. Let chance do what it does. Like surprises from the game board, life goes through twists and turns.
en: \rDahlia: No need to worry. Let chance do what it does. Like surprises from the game board, life goes through twists and turns.
it: \rDahlia: Non c'è da preoccuparsi. Lascia che il caso faccia il suo corso. Come le sorprese di un gioco da tavolo, la vita è piena di colpi di scena.

id: \rThings will go as they will. But, enough of that. I know one thing for certain. You have arrived here not merely because you were lucky.
en: \rThings will go as they will. But, enough of that. I know one thing for certain. You have arrived here not merely because you were lucky.
it: \rLe cose andranno come devono andare. Ma basta così. Di una cosa sono certa. Non sei arrivato qui solo perché sei stato fortunato.

id: \rLet us not waste any time. I wish to test your skills myself!
en: \rLet us not waste any time. I wish to test your skills myself!
it: \rNon perdiamo altro tempo. Voglio mettere alla prova le tue abilità di persona!

id: \rDahlia: How fabulous of you! Your love of Pokémon shone through, and in turn, your Pokémon believed in you.
en: \rDahlia: How fabulous of you! Your love of Pokémon shone through, and in turn, your Pokémon believed in you.
it: \rDahlia: Che meraviglia! Il tuo amore per i Pokémon è emerso, e a loro volta i tuoi Pokémon hanno creduto in te.

id: \rThat is why you handled everything thrown your way splendidly. A most wonderful victory it was!
en: \rThat is why you handled everything thrown your way splendidly. A most wonderful victory it was!
it: \rEcco perché hai affrontato splendidamente tutto ciò che ti è capitato. È stata una vittoria davvero magnifica!

id: \bThorton: Bzweep! Sorry, don't mind me. What I'm using is an invention of mine. It's my data-analyzing machine telling me what you brought.
en: \bThorton: Bzweep! Sorry, don't mind me. What I'm using is an invention of mine. It's my data-analyzing machine telling me what you brought.
it: \bThorton: Bzzwip! Scusa, non badare a me. Sto usando una mia invenzione. È la mia macchina di analisi dati che mi dice cosa hai portato.

id: \bI see... I have to say, that's a good setup. Like say, 47%? Oh, don't let that number concern you!
en: \bI see... I have to say, that's a good setup. Like say, 47%? Oh, don't let that number concern you!
it: \bCapisco... Devo dire che è una buona formazione. Diciamo un 47%? Oh, non preoccuparti di quel numero!

id: \bAll righty, let's get going!
en: \bAll righty, let's get going!
it: \bBene, cominciamo!

id: \bThorton: Hmm... I got handed the loss here. It's not making me happy at all, losing.
en: \bThorton: Hmm... I got handed the loss here. It's not making me happy at all, losing.
it: \bThorton: Mmh... Stavolta mi è toccata la sconfitta. Perdere non mi rende affatto felice.

id: \bBut that's all right. Some things you learn from winning. But some things you learn by losing.
en: \bBut that's all right. Some things you learn from winning. But some things you learn by losing.
it: \bMa va bene così. Certe cose si imparano vincendo. Ma altre si imparano perdendo.

id: \bDarach: Welcome. As you know, Lady Caitlin, my employer, is not one to accept defeat willingly.
en: \bDarach: Welcome. As you know, Lady Caitlin, my employer, is not one to accept defeat willingly.
it: \bDarach: Benvenuto. Come saprai, Lady Caitlin, la mia padrona, non è una che accetta volentieri la sconfitta.

id: \bHowever, for a reason I'm not at liberty to disclose, she cannot battle here.
en: \bHowever, for a reason I'm not at liberty to disclose, she cannot battle here.
it: \bTuttavia, per un motivo che non posso rivelare, non può lottare qui.

id: \bConsequently, I, Darach, will do battle in her ladyship's place. Let me assure you that you won't be shortchanged by facing me.
en: \bConsequently, I, Darach, will do battle in her ladyship's place. Let me assure you that you won't be shortchanged by facing me.
it: \bDi conseguenza, io, Darach, lotterò al posto di sua signoria. Le assicuro che affrontando me non ci rimetterà.

id: \bDarach: I drew on every reserve of experience and etiquette handed down through our heritage of glorious servitude.
en: \bDarach: I drew on every reserve of experience and etiquette handed down through our heritage of glorious servitude.
it: \bDarach: Ho attinto a ogni riserva di esperienza e di etichetta tramandata dalla nostra gloriosa tradizione di servitù.

id: \bBut even then, I failed to fend off your stunning and inspiring challenge. I am humbled...
en: \bBut even then, I failed to fend off your stunning and inspiring challenge. I am humbled...
it: \bEppure non sono riuscito a respingere la sua sfida, straordinaria ed esaltante. Mi inchino...

id: \rArgenta: Here allows Trainers to mount challenges with their favorite Pokémon.
en: \rArgenta: Here allows Trainers to mount challenges with their favorite Pokémon.
it: \rArgenta: Qui gli Allenatori possono lanciare le loro sfide con il loro Pokémon preferito.

id: \rI imagine there were tense moments getting here with your chosen one. But understand that one shines the brightest when a challenge is overcome.
en: \rI imagine there were tense moments getting here with your chosen one. But understand that one shines the brightest when a challenge is overcome.
it: \rImmagino che arrivare fin qui con il tuo prescelto abbia avuto i suoi momenti di tensione. Ma sappi che si brilla di più quando si supera una sfida.

id: \rI am Argenta, and I will be your most daunting challenge. I dare you to overcome me.
en: \rI am Argenta, and I will be your most daunting challenge. I dare you to overcome me.
it: \rIo sono Argenta, e sarò la tua sfida più temibile. Ti sfido a superarmi.

id: \rArgenta: You must never forget there is a place where everyone can shine. That goes for any kind of Pokémon, too.
en: \rArgenta: You must never forget there is a place where everyone can shine. That goes for any kind of Pokémon, too.
it: \rArgenta: Non dimenticare mai che esiste un luogo dove tutti possono brillare. E questo vale anche per qualsiasi tipo di Pokémon.

id: \rSpread that message in your own words. It's one everyone should hear. And now, having lost, this lady has nothing left to say at all, but... Bye-bye!
en: \rSpread that message in your own words. It's one everyone should hear. And now, having lost, this lady has nothing left to say at all, but... Bye-bye!
it: \rDiffondi questo messaggio con parole tue. È un messaggio che tutti dovrebbero sentire. E ora, avendo perso, questa signora non ha proprio altro da dire, se non... Ciao ciao!

id: \bHitsu: You bought a Backstage Pass to meet us? *laughs*
en: \bHitsu: You bought a Backstage Pass to meet us?  *laughs*
it: \bHitsu: Hai comprato un Pass Backstage per incontrarci?  *ride*

id: \bYou know what that means, right? BONUS ROUND! And I can't take no for an answer.
en: \bYou know what that means, right? BONUS ROUND!  And I can't take no for an answer.
it: \bSai cosa significa, vero? ROUND BONUS!  E non accetto un no come risposta.

id: \bLet's not delay any further, shall we? Please! Defeat me!
en: \bLet's not delay any further, shall we? Please! Defeat me!
it: \bNon perdiamo altro tempo, che ne dici? Ti prego! Sconfiggimi!

id: \bHitsu: You did it! I am overwhelmed! You are the symbol of a true Pokemon master! Other than that, I have nothing much to say now, besides well done! The meet and greet is over. Ciaoz~
en: \bHitsu: You did it! I am overwhelmed! You are the symbol of a true Pokemon master! Other than that, I have nothing much to say now, besides well done! The meet and greet is over. Ciaoz~
it: \bHitsu: Ce l'hai fatta! Sono sopraffatto! Sei il simbolo di un vero maestro di Pokémon! A parte questo, non ho molto da dire, se non ben fatto! Il meet and greet è finito. Ciaoz~

id: \bHitsu: Hey, it was a good fight there! Don't be down about it, as I am not playing by the rules anyway. HAHA. Come back here again. You will be prepared. We will be waiting. Bye~
en: \bHitsu: Hey, it was a good fight there! Don't be down about it, as I am not playing by the rules anyway. HAHA. Come back here again. You will be prepared. We will be waiting. Bye~
it: \bHitsu: Ehi, è stata una bella lotta! Non abbatterti, tanto io non gioco secondo le regole. HAHA. Torna di nuovo qui. Sarai pronto. Ti aspetteremo. Ciao~

id: \bHitsu: Hey, you escaped the Mayhem Penitentiary! You must be an impressive trainer to do that!
en: \bHitsu: Hey, you escaped the Mayhem Penitentiary! You must be an impressive trainer to do that!
it: \bHitsu: Ehi, sei evaso dal Penitenziario Mayhem! Devi essere un Allenatore notevole per riuscirci!

id: \bBeyond this room, is the end of your Mayhem. You may get the reward you deserve there. BUT! Just one more. Bonus round. Pleaseeeee! Defeat me, and you will get extra rewards! I know your team should be fatigued now...
en: \bBeyond this room, is the end of your Mayhem. You may get the reward you deserve there. BUT! Just one more. Bonus round. Pleaseeeee! Defeat me, and you will get extra rewards! I know your team should be fatigued now...
it: \bOltre questa stanza c'è la fine del tuo Mayhem. Lì potrai ricevere la ricompensa che meriti. MA! Solo un'altra. Round bonus. Ti pregooo! Sconfiggimi e otterrai ricompense extra! So che la tua squadra dovrebbe essere stanca ormai...

id: \bThere, now I can't take no for an answer. Let's not delay any further, shall we?
en: \bThere, now I can't take no for an answer. Let's not delay any further, shall we?
it: \bEcco, ora non posso accettare un no come risposta. Non perdiamo altro tempo, che ne dici?

id: \bHitsu: You did it! I am overwhelmed! You are the symbol of a true Pokemon master. Here, you deserve this.
en: \bHitsu: You did it! I am overwhelmed! You are the symbol of a true Pokemon master. Here, you deserve this.
it: \bHitsu: Ce l'hai fatta! Sono sopraffatto! Sei il simbolo di un vero maestro di Pokémon. Tieni, te lo meriti.

id: 25 GC Credits have been awarded to you.
en: 25 GC Credits have been awarded to you.
it: Hai ricevuto 25 Crediti GC.

id: \bGo on. I have nothing much to say now, besides well done!
en: \bGo on. I have nothing much to say now, besides well done!
it: \bVai pure. Non ho molto da dire, se non ben fatto!

id: \bHitsu: Hey, it was a good fight there! Don't be down about it, as I am not playing by the rules anyway. HAHA.
en: \bHitsu: Hey, it was a good fight there! Don't be down about it, as I am not playing by the rules anyway. HAHA.
it: \bHitsu: Ehi, è stata una bella lotta! Non abbatterti, tanto io non gioco secondo le regole. HAHA.

id: \bCome back here again. You will be prepared. We will be waiting. Go on!
en: \bCome back here again. You will be prepared. We will be waiting. Go on!
it: \bTorna di nuovo qui. Sarai pronto. Ti aspetteremo. Vai pure!

id: \bLuc: Ara ara, you bought a pass just to meet us again? Want a bo'ohw'o'wo'er for that? Just kidding.
en: \bLuc: Ara ara, you bought a pass just to meet us again? Want a bo'ohw'o'wo'er for that? Just kidding.
it: \bLuc: Ara ara, hai comprato un pass solo per rivederci? Vuoi una bo'ohw'o'wo'er per questo? Scherzo.

id: \bSay less. Let's battle!
en: \bSay less. Let's battle!
it: \bNon serve aggiungere altro. Lottiamo!

id: \bLuc: Damn, nice one mate! I can't even be mad that I lost. Well done, and cheers for meeting me! Hasta la vista!
en: \bLuc: Damn, nice one mate! I can't even be mad that I lost. Well done, and cheers for meeting me! Hasta la vista!
it: \bLuc: Accidenti, bella questa, amico! Non riesco nemmeno ad arrabbiarmi per aver perso. Ben fatto, e grazie per essere venuto a trovarmi! Hasta la vista!

id: \bHaha, no hard feelings mate, since we're all breaking the rules-that-were-meant-to-be-broken here.
en: \bHaha, no hard feelings mate, since we're all breaking the rules-that-were-meant-to-be-broken here.
it: \bAhah, nessun rancore, amico, tanto qui stiamo tutti infrangendo le regole-fatte-per-essere-infrante.

id: \bWell, whenever you're ready again, I'll still be here.
en: \bWell, whenever you're ready again, I'll still be here.
it: \bBe', quando sarai di nuovo pronto, io sarò ancora qui.

id: \bLuc: Ara ara, well done on making it this far. Want a bo'ohw'o'wo'er? Just kidding.
en: \bLuc: Ara ara, well done on making it this far. Want a bo'ohw'o'wo'er? Just kidding.
it: \bLuc: Ara ara, complimenti per essere arrivato fin qui. Vuoi una bo'ohw'o'wo'er? Scherzo.

id: \bTough challenge, wasn't it? You're almost there mate, your rewards lie just behind me.
en: \bTough challenge, wasn't it? You're almost there mate, your rewards lie just behind me.
it: \bSfida tosta, vero? Ci sei quasi, amico, le tue ricompense sono proprio dietro di me.

id: \bI'll heal your team so you can ready up.
en: \bI'll heal your team so you can ready up.
it: \bCurerò la tua squadra così potrai prepararti.

id: \bHeh. That's right, your final opponent here is me!
en: \bHeh. That's right, your final opponent here is me!
it: \bEh. Proprio così, il tuo ultimo avversario qui sono io!

id: \bLuc: Damn, nice one mate! I can't even be mad that I lost.
en: \bLuc: Damn, nice one mate! I can't even be mad that I lost.
it: \bLuc: Accidenti, bella questa, amico! Non riesco nemmeno ad arrabbiarmi per aver perso.

id: \bI have nothing more to say now, except well done!
en: \bI have nothing more to say now, except well done!
it: \bNon ho altro da dire, se non ben fatto!

id: \bHaha, no hard feelings mate. It's not like Hitsu or Foul would be easier to beat anyway, since we're all breaking the rules-that-were-meant-to-be-broken here.
en: \bHaha, no hard feelings mate. It's not like Hitsu or Foul would be easier to beat anyway, since we're all breaking the rules-that-were-meant-to-be-broken here.
it: \bAhah, nessun rancore, amico. Non è che Hitsu o Foul sarebbero più facili da battere, tanto qui stiamo tutti infrangendo le regole-fatte-per-essere-infrante.

id: \bFoul: Oh! You're approaching me, on your own accord?
en: \bFoul: Oh! You're approaching me, on your own accord?
it: \bFoul: Oh! Ti stai avvicinando a me, di tua spontanea volontà?

id: \bFascinating indeed.
en: \bFascinating indeed.
it: \bAffascinante davvero.

id: \bNow amuse me by engaging in a battle with me! Surprise surprise!
en: \bNow amuse me by engaging in a battle with me! Surprise surprise!
it: \bOra divertimi sfidandomi in una lotta! Sorpresa sorpresa!

id: \bFoul: Tsk... Doesn't matter, there are those who possess much greater power than I do. You may leave after me.
en: \bFoul: Tsk... Doesn't matter, there are those who possess much greater power than I do. You may leave after me.
it: \bFoul: Tsk... Non importa, c'è chi possiede un potere molto più grande del mio. Puoi andare oltre me.

id: \bFoul: Of course you aren't able to defeat me. I am the master of foul plays!!!
en: \bFoul: Of course you aren't able to defeat me. I am the master of foul plays!!!
it: \bFoul: Ovvio che non riesci a sconfiggermi. Io sono il maestro dei colpi bassi!!!

id: \bFeeling angry? Come back for more beatings!
en: \bFeeling angry? Come back for more beatings!
it: \bTi senti arrabbiato? Torna a prenderne ancora!

id: \bFoul: Oh! You're approaching me? Even after all of that fighting you still chose to approach me.
en: \bFoul: Oh! You're approaching me?  Even after all of that fighting you still chose to approach me.
it: \bFoul: Oh! Ti stai avvicinando a me?  Anche dopo tutte quelle lotte hai comunque scelto di avvicinarti.

id: \bBut I don't want to fight with such a weak opponent. Let me heal you up first.
en: \bBut I don't want to fight with such a weak opponent. Let me heal you up first.
it: \bMa non voglio lottare con un avversario così debole. Prima lascia che ti curi.

id: \bNow let's see what kind of power you can muster to defeat me.
en: \bNow let's see what kind of power you can muster to defeat me.
it: \bOra vediamo che tipo di potere riesci a raccogliere per sconfiggermi.

id: \bFoul: Tsk... Doesn't matter if you can beat me here.
en: \bFoul: Tsk... Doesn't matter if you can beat me here.
it: \bFoul: Tsk... Non importa se riesci a battermi qui.

id: \bI can always come back to defeat you. And even if I can't, there are those who possess much greater power than I do.
en: \bI can always come back to defeat you. And even if I can't, there are those who possess much greater power than I do.
it: \bPosso sempre tornare a sconfiggerti. E anche se non ci riuscissi, c'è chi possiede un potere molto più grande del mio.

id: \rVermint: My, my, quite surprising. You've decided to battle me without true resolve?
en: \rVermint: My, my, quite surprising. You've decided to battle me without true resolve?
it: \rVermint: Bene, bene, che sorpresa. Hai deciso di sfidarmi senza una vera determinazione?

id: \rLet's see if you can stay enthusiastic.
en: \rLet's see if you can stay enthusiastic.
it: \rVediamo se riesci a mantenere il tuo entusiasmo.

id: \rVermint: That's surprising... My Minuend was wrong for once.
en: \rVermint: That's surprising... My Minuend was wrong for once.
it: \rVermint: Che sorpresa... Il mio Minuend per una volta si è sbagliato.

id: \r\PN, I'm looking forward towards your progress. And remember, I am always watching.
en: \r\PN, I'm looking forward towards your progress.  And remember, I am always watching.
it: \r\PN, attendo con ansia i tuoi progressi.  E ricorda, io ti osservo sempre.

id: \rVermint: A battle without true resolve just shows that you're not on the right path.
en: \rVermint: A battle without true resolve just shows that you're not on the right path.
it: \rVermint: Una lotta senza vera determinazione dimostra solo che non sei sulla strada giusta.

id: \rFind your own resolve and I shall judge it with my Minuend.
en: \rFind your own resolve and I shall judge it with my Minuend.
it: \rTrova la tua determinazione e io la giudicherò con il mio Minuend.

id: \rVermint: Oh? You've made it this far and you're still moving forward.
en: \rVermint: Oh? You've made it this far and you're still moving forward.
it: \rVermint: Oh? Sei arrivato fin qui e continui ad andare avanti.

id: \rVery well, let's see if you can keep that enthusiasm!
en: \rVery well, let's see if you can keep that enthusiasm!
it: \rMolto bene, vediamo se riesci a mantenere quell'entusiasmo!

id: \rVermint: I see... I've lost. I look forward to seeing your progress, \PN.
en: \rVermint: I see... I've lost. I look forward to seeing your progress, \PN.
it: \rVermint: Capisco... Ho perso. Attendo con ansia di vedere i tuoi progressi, \PN.

id: \rBut remember, I am always watching.
en: \rBut remember, I am always watching.
it: \rMa ricorda, io ti osservo sempre.

id: \rVermint: You lack strength and the resolve to move forward.
en: \rVermint: You lack strength and the resolve to move forward.
it: \rVermint: Ti mancano la forza e la determinazione per andare avanti.

id: \rYou shall not pass this horizon where both of your passion and resolve meet.
en: \rYou shall not pass this horizon where both of your passion and resolve meet.
it: \rNon supererai questo orizzonte dove la tua passione e la tua determinazione si incontrano.

id: \bLuc-ker: \PN, huh? Should've expected that.
en: \bLuc-ker: \PN, huh? Should've expected that.
it: \bLuc-ker: \PN, eh? Avrei dovuto aspettarmelo.

id: \bWell, since you're here, lemme tell you a lil' story.
en: \bWell, since you're here, lemme tell you a lil' story.
it: \bBe', visto che sei qui, lascia che ti racconti una storiella.

id: \bOnce upon a time, a teenager stumbled upon this world. He roamed the world far and wide, seeking to experience Ash's journey for himself.
en: \bOnce upon a time, a teenager stumbled upon this world. He roamed the world far and wide, seeking to experience Ash's journey for himself.
it: \bC'era una volta un ragazzo che si imbatté in questo mondo. Lo girò in lungo e in largo, cercando di vivere in prima persona il viaggio di Ash.

id: \bUntil one day, he'd finished the journey. But with nothing else to do in the world at that time, he decided to start over again, and again, and again.
en: \bUntil one day, he'd finished the journey. But with nothing else to do in the world at that time, he decided to start over again, and again, and again.
it: \bFinché un giorno terminò il viaggio. Ma non avendo nient'altro da fare nel mondo in quel momento, decise di ricominciare da capo, ancora, e ancora, e ancora.

id: \bBut of course, all good things must come to an end.
en: \bBut of course, all good things must come to an end.
it: \bMa ovviamente, tutte le cose belle hanno una fine.

id: \bOne day, when trying to exploit the system that he thought he'd grown so used to, it forcefully ejected him out, back into his original world.
en: \bOne day, when trying to exploit the system that he thought he'd grown so used to, it forcefully ejected him out, back into his original world.
it: \bUn giorno, mentre cercava di sfruttare il sistema a cui pensava di essersi abituato così bene, questo lo espulse con la forza, rispedendolo nel suo mondo d'origine.

id: \bAnd then after a while, he forgot about this world.
en: \bAnd then after a while, he forgot about this world.
it: \bE poi, dopo un po', si dimenticò di questo mondo.

id: \bThat was, until that world experienced a pandemic.
en: \bThat was, until that world experienced a pandemic.
it: \bAlmeno finché quel mondo non attraversò una pandemia.

id: \bThe teenager, now a few years older with some more knowledge and common sense, wanted to help out in improving this world.
en: \bThe teenager, now a few years older with some more knowledge and common sense, wanted to help out in improving this world.
it: \bIl ragazzo, ora più grande di qualche anno e con un po' più di conoscenza e buon senso, volle dare una mano a migliorare questo mondo.

id: \bSo he reached out to this world's creator, and was given the opportunity to do so.
en: \bSo he reached out to this world's creator, and was given the opportunity to do so.
it: \bCosì contattò il creatore di questo mondo, e gli fu data l'opportunità di farlo.

id: \bAnd that's when I was born. Luc-ker. (the hyphen is important by the way!)
en: \bAnd that's when I was born. Luc-ker. (the hyphen is important by the way!)
it: \bE fu allora che nacqui io. Luc-ker. (il trattino è importante, tra l'altro!)

id: \bA bit of trivia: That actually wasn't my original name! But that really doesn't matter now.
en: \bA bit of trivia: That actually wasn't my original name! But that really doesn't matter now.
it: \bUna curiosità: in realtà non era il mio nome originale! Ma ormai non ha davvero importanza.

id: \bAll you need to know is that I've been helping improve this world's systems for many years now, taking breaks every now and again.
en: \bAll you need to know is that I've been helping improve this world's systems for many years now, taking breaks every now and again.
it: \bTutto ciò che devi sapere è che da molti anni aiuto a migliorare i sistemi di questo mondo, prendendomi una pausa ogni tanto.

id: \bOf course, I would eventually meet Hitsu during this time.
en: \bOf course, I would eventually meet Hitsu during this time.
it: \bOvviamente, in questo periodo avrei finito per incontrare Hitsu.

id: \bWhen he first came up with the idea of the Grandeur Club, I never thought I'd be the one to facilitate it, but here we are.
en: \bWhen he first came up with the idea of the Grandeur Club, I never thought I'd be the one to facilitate it, but here we are.
it: \bQuando gli venne per la prima volta l'idea del Grandeur Club, non avrei mai pensato di essere io a realizzarlo, eppure eccoci qui.

id: \bWith trainers coming from all over the Pokémon universe, this is our love letter to the franchise.
en: \bWith trainers coming from all over the Pokémon universe, this is our love letter to the franchise.
it: \bCon Allenatori provenienti da tutto l'universo Pokémon, questa è la nostra lettera d'amore al franchise.

id: \bIf you couldn't tell, we also loved Pokémon Masters. So we wanted some trainers from there that you could battle here too!
en: \bIf you couldn't tell, we also loved Pokémon Masters.  So we wanted some trainers from there that you could battle here too!
it: \bSe non si fosse capito, abbiamo amato anche Pokémon Masters.  Così volevamo che anche qui potessi lottare con alcuni Allenatori di quel gioco!

id: \bI'm very happy with what we've accomplished. Of course, there were many, many struggles, but we've overcome them to get where we are today.
en: \bI'm very happy with what we've accomplished. Of course, there were many, many struggles, but we've overcome them to get where we are today.
it: \bSono molto felice di ciò che abbiamo realizzato. Ovviamente ci sono state tante, tantissime difficoltà, ma le abbiamo superate per arrivare dove siamo oggi.

id: \bAnd now, we're at the end of our shared journey together.
en: \bAnd now, we're at the end of our shared journey together.
it: \bE ora siamo alla fine del nostro viaggio condiviso.

id: \bKore ga watashitachi no Rakua desu!
en: \bKore ga watashitachi no Rakua desu!
it: \bKore ga watashitachi no Rakua desu!

id: \bWhat, you thought that was a hint to us adding in Gen 9? Hahaha!
en: \bWhat, you thought that was a hint to us adding in Gen 9? Hahaha!
it: \bCosa, pensavi fosse un indizio sull'aggiunta della Gen 9? Ahahah!

id: \bNah, I just liked the sound of saying that. Gen 9 isn't going to be added into the game unfortunately (or fortunately for myself, actually).
en: \bNah, I just liked the sound of saying that. Gen 9 isn't going to be added into the game unfortunately (or fortunately for myself, actually).
it: \bMa no, mi piaceva solo come suonava. Purtroppo la Gen 9 non verrà aggiunta al gioco (o per fortuna, per quanto mi riguarda).

id: \bThat being said, I do have to say ariagato to you as well, \PN. Without you, we would've never gotten this far.
en: \bThat being said, I do have to say ariagato to you as well, \PN. Without you, we would've never gotten this far.
it: \bDetto questo, devo dire ariagato anche a te, \PN. Senza di te non saremmo mai arrivati fin qui.

id: \bAs a thank you for letting us experience the end of our journey together, let me reward you with a battle.
en: \bAs a thank you for letting us experience the end of our journey together, let me reward you with a battle.
it: \bPer ringraziarti di averci fatto vivere insieme la fine del nostro viaggio, lascia che ti ricompensi con una lotta.

id: \bOh, you want to face off against me at my full power? You never cease to surprise me.
en: \bOh, you want to face off against me at my full power? You never cease to surprise me.
it: \bOh, vuoi affrontarmi al massimo della mia potenza? Non smetti mai di sorprendermi.

id: \bVery well. But don't say you weren't warned - this battle will use the mechanics of the Sync and Titan Challenges.
en: \bVery well. But don't say you weren't warned - this battle will use the mechanics of the Sync and Titan Challenges.
it: \bMolto bene. Ma non dire che non ti avevo avvertito: questa lotta userà le meccaniche della Sfida Sync e della Sfida dei Titani.

id: inhales and clears throat
en: inhales and clears throat
it: inspira e si schiarisce la gola

id: \bMite kudasai... watashi no furu power desu.
en: \bMite kudasai... watashi no furu power desu.
it: \bMite kudasai... watashi no furu power desu.

id: \bLuc-ker...
en: \bLuc-ker...
it: \bLuc-ker...

id: \bARUTIMETTO...
en: \bARUTIMETTO...
it: \bARUTIMETTO...

id: \bSUPEKUTAKURU,
en: \bSUPEKUTAKURU,
it: \bSUPEKUTAKURU,

id: \bYAAAAAAAAH!!!
en: \bYAAAAAAAAH!!!
it: \bYAAAAAAAAH!!!

id: \bThat didn't work, did it?
en: \bThat didn't work, did it?
it: \bNon ha funzionato, vero?

id: \bLuc: Phew! Even while breaking multiple system limits, I still can't beat you. You're truly an incredible trainer, \PN.
en: \bLuc: Phew! Even while breaking multiple system limits, I still can't beat you. You're truly an incredible trainer, \PN.
it: \bLuc: Uff! Nemmeno infrangendo diversi limiti del sistema riesco a batterti. Sei davvero un Allenatore incredibile, \PN.

id: \bOf course, I could've broken more limits, but I really don't want to destroy this world, y'know?
en: \bOf course, I could've broken more limits, but I really don't want to destroy this world, y'know?
it: \bOvviamente avrei potuto infrangere altri limiti, ma non voglio proprio distruggere questo mondo, capisci?

id: \bHere's where I'd give you a reward, but I've been programmed to not give you any if you've decided to only bully me :<(
en: \bHere's where I'd give you a reward, but I've been programmed to not give you any if you've decided to only bully me :<(
it: \bA questo punto ti darei una ricompensa, ma sono stato programmato per non dartene se hai deciso di fare solo il bullo con me :<(

id: \bAnyway, your reward for beating me. Three very special bo'ohw'o'wo'ers.
en: \bAnyway, your reward for beating me. Three very special bo'ohw'o'wo'ers.
it: \bComunque, ecco la tua ricompensa per avermi battuto. Tre bo'ohw'o'wo'er molto speciali.

id: \bLuc: Thanks for letting me go all-out! That felt pretty good.
en: \bLuc: Thanks for letting me go all-out! That felt pretty good.
it: \bLuc: Grazie per avermi lasciato dare il massimo! È stato bello.

id: \bDon't worry too much about the fact that you couldn't beat me! I was breaking multiple system limits after all.
en: \bDon't worry too much about the fact that you couldn't beat me! I was breaking multiple system limits after all.
it: \bNon preoccuparti troppo di non essere riuscito a battermi! Dopotutto stavo infrangendo diversi limiti del sistema.

id: \bBut then again... I did warn you. You should know from the trainers from the Sync challenge, right?
en: \bBut then again... I did warn you. You should know from the trainers from the Sync challenge, right?
it: \bMa d'altronde... Ti avevo avvertito. Dovresti saperlo dagli Allenatori della Sfida Sync, no?

id: \bBut then again... I did warn you. All's fair when it comes to the Grandeur Club, y'know?
en: \bBut then again... I did warn you. All's fair when it comes to the Grandeur Club, y'know?
it: \bMa d'altronde... Ti avevo avvertito. Al Grandeur Club tutto è lecito, capisci?

id: \bYou also did put up a pretty good fight, and pushed me to limits that no other trainer has before.
en: \bYou also did put up a pretty good fight, and pushed me to limits that no other trainer has before.
it: \bE poi hai lottato davvero bene, e mi hai spinto a limiti a cui nessun altro Allenatore mi aveva mai spinto.

id: \bAnyway, that's all for this place!
en: \bAnyway, that's all for this place!
it: \bComunque, per questo posto è tutto!

id: \bCome, let me take you back to where you belong.
en: \bCome, let me take you back to where you belong.
it: \bVieni, lascia che ti riporti dove appartieni.

id: \bWhen snow melts, spring arrives. Cherish your time together with your Pokémon.
en: \bWhen snow melts, spring arrives. Cherish your time together with your Pokémon.
it: \bQuando la neve si scioglie, arriva la primavera. Custodisci il tempo che trascorri con i tuoi Pokémon.

id: The door locks behind you...
en: The door locks behind you...
it: La porta si chiude a chiave alle tue spalle...

id: \bBrock: Show me your best!
en: \bBrock: Show me your best!
it: \bBrock: Mostrami il tuo meglio!

id: \rMisty: Are you ready, sweetie?
en: \rMisty: Are you ready, sweetie?
it: \rMisty: Sei pronto, tesoro?

id: \bLt. Surge: Pokémon battles are war! I'll show you and shock you into surrender!
en: \bLt. Surge: Pokémon battles are war! I'll show you and shock you into surrender!
it: \bLt. Surge: Le lotte Pokémon sono una guerra! Ti farò vedere io e ti fulminerò fino alla resa!

id: \rErika: Let my ladies demonstrate the art of Ikebana.
en: \rErika: Let my ladies demonstrate the art of Ikebana.
it: \rErika: Lascia che le mie signore ti mostrino l'arte dell'Ikebana.

id: \rSabrina: Let's find out who the victor will be.
en: \rSabrina: Let's find out who the victor will be.
it: \rSabrina: Scopriamo chi sarà il vincitore.

id: \rJanine: Hi! I'm Janine! Remember this name!
en: \rJanine: Hi! I'm Janine! Remember this name!
it: \rNina: Ciao! Sono Nina! Ricordati questo nome!

id: \bBill: Did you come to see my Pokémon collection? Check this out!
en: \bBill: Did you come to see my Pokémon collection? Check this out!
it: \bBill: Sei venuto a vedere la mia collezione di Pokémon? Guarda qua!

id: \bRyuki: Let our fiery spirits clash in a blaze of glory!
en: \bRyuki: Let our fiery spirits clash in a blaze of glory!
it: \bRyuki: Che i nostri spiriti ardenti si scontrino in un tripudio di gloria!

id: \rAgatha: Why are you here noseying about, pesky child.
en: \rAgatha: Why are you here noseying about, pesky child.
it: \rAgatha: Perché sei qui a ficcanasare, moccioso seccante?

id: \bTrace: I should check if your Pokémon really are doing well... with a battle!
en: \bTrace: I should check if your Pokémon really are doing well... with a battle!
it: \bTrace: Dovrei controllare se i tuoi Pokémon stanno davvero bene... con una lotta!

id: \bBlue: Show it to us - your true power!
en: \bBlue: Show it to us - your true power!
it: \bBlue: Mostracelo: il tuo vero potere!

id: \rLeaf: I noticed you got some good Pokemon there too, can I have it?
en: \rLeaf: I noticed you got some good Pokemon there too, can I have it?
it: \rLeaf: Ho notato che anche tu hai dei bei Pokémon, posso averne uno?

id: \bOak: Hello there! My name is Oak! People call me the Pokémon Professor! Here, come battle with me!
en: \bOak: Hello there! My name is Oak! People call me the Pokémon Professor! Here, come battle with me!
it: \bOak: Ciao a tutti! Il mio nome è Oak! La gente mi chiama il Professore dei Pokémon! Su, vieni a lottare con me!

id: \bGiovanni: For your insolence, you will feel a world of pain!
en: \bGiovanni: For your insolence, you will feel a world of pain!
it: \bGiovanni: Per la tua insolenza, conoscerai un mondo di dolore!

id: \bFalkner: I'll show you the real power of the glorious flying Pokémon! Winds, stay with me!
en: \bFalkner: I'll show you the real power of the glorious flying Pokémon! Winds, stay with me!
it: \bValerio: Ti mostrerò il vero potere dei gloriosi Pokémon Volante! Venti, restate con me!

id: \bBugsy: Let me demonstrate what I've learned from my studies.
en: \bBugsy: Let me demonstrate what I've learned from my studies.
it: \bRaffaello: Lascia che ti mostri ciò che ho imparato dai miei studi.

id: \rWhitney: You want a battle with me, the talented super-cute me? That's a warning hint!
en: \rWhitney: You want a battle with me, the talented super-cute me? That's a warning hint!
it: \rChiara: Vuoi lottare con me, la talentuosa e supercarina me? Questo è un avvertimento!

id: \bMorty: With a little more, I could see a future in which I meet the Pokémon of rainbow colors. You're going to help me reach that level!
en: \bMorty: With a little more, I could see a future in which I meet the Pokémon of rainbow colors. You're going to help me reach that level!
it: \bAngelo: Ancora un po' e potrei vedere un futuro in cui incontro il Pokémon dai colori dell'arcobaleno. Tu mi aiuterai a raggiungere quel livello!

id: \bChuck: Let me tell you, I'm tough enough to crush stones and shatter bones! Urggh! Oooarrgh!
en: \bChuck: Let me tell you, I'm tough enough to crush stones and shatter bones! Urggh! Oooarrgh!
it: \bFurio: Te lo dico io, sono così duro da frantumare pietre e spezzare ossa! Urggh! Oooarrgh!

id: \rJasmine: Oh... uh, hello. Do you love your Pokemon? May you prove it to me...?
en: \rJasmine: Oh... uh, hello. Do you love your Pokemon? May you prove it to me...?
it: \rJasmine: Oh... ehm, ciao. Vuoi bene ai tuoi Pokémon? Me lo dimostreresti...?

id: \bPryce: I, Pryce - the winter trainer - shall demonstrate my power!
en: \bPryce: I, Pryce - the winter trainer - shall demonstrate my power!
it: \bAlfredo: Io, Alfredo, l'Allenatore dell'inverno, ti mostrerò il mio potere!

id: \rClaire: I will use my full power against you. Let's do this!
en: \rClaire: I will use my full power against you. Let's do this!
it: \rSandra: Userò tutta la mia potenza contro di te. Diamoci dentro!

id: \bWill: Losing is not an option for us!
en: \bWill: Losing is not an option for us!
it: \bPino: Perdere non è un'opzione per noi!

id: \bKoga: Prepare to be the victim of my techniques... You shall see soon...
en: \bKoga: Prepare to be the victim of my techniques... You shall see soon...
it: \bKoga: Preparati a essere vittima delle mie tecniche... Presto vedrai...

id: \bBruno: Bow down to our overwhelming power. Hoo hah!
en: \bBruno: Bow down to our overwhelming power. Hoo hah!
it: \bBruno: Inchinati al nostro potere travolgente. Hoo hah!

id: \rKaren: Try me. Entertain me. Let's go.
en: \rKaren: Try me. Entertain me. Let's go.
it: \rKaren: Mettimi alla prova. Divertimi. Andiamo.

id: \bLance: It's time I tested you in battle. Are you ready?
en: \bLance: It's time I tested you in battle. Are you ready?
it: \bLance: È ora di metterti alla prova in una lotta. Sei pronto?

id: \bSilver: Pesky one. You do not seem to be strong.
en: \bSilver: Pesky one. You do not seem to be strong.
it: \bSilver: Seccatore. Non sembri affatto forte.

id: \rLyra: You are here looking for a challenge, am I right? Me too!
en: \rLyra: You are here looking for a challenge, am I right? Me too!
it: \rLyra: Sei qui in cerca di una sfida, vero? Anch'io!

id: \bEthan: I'm feeling good today, how 'bout a match? Right here, right now!
en: \bEthan: I'm feeling good today, how 'bout a match? Right here, right now!
it: \bEthan: Oggi mi sento in forma, che ne dici di un incontro? Qui e ora!

id: \bElm: Tell me, how do you raise your Pokemon? I will be expecting a great battle!
en: \bElm: Tell me, how do you raise your Pokemon? I will be expecting a great battle!
it: \bElm: Dimmi, come alleni i tuoi Pokémon? Mi aspetto una gran bella lotta!

id: \rRoxanne: Would you kindly demonstrate how you battle so I could learn? I would also see how much better I've become.
en: \rRoxanne: Would you kindly demonstrate how you battle so I could learn? I would also see how much better I've become.
it: \rPetra: Saresti così gentile da mostrarmi come lotti, così che io possa imparare? Vorrei anche vedere quanto sono migliorata.

id: \bBrawly: You wanna challenge me? Let's see what you're made of.
en: \bBrawly: You wanna challenge me? Let's see what you're made of.
it: \bRudi: Vuoi sfidarmi? Vediamo di che pasta sei fatto.

id: \bWattson: I'll make sparks fly from you! Don't say I didn't warn you!
en: \bWattson: I'll make sparks fly from you! Don't say I didn't warn you!
it: \bWalter:Ti farò sprizzare scintille! Non dire che non ti avevo avvertito!

id: \rFlannery: Brace yourself! Haiyaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
en: \rFlannery: Brace yourself! Haiyaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
it: \rFiammetta: Preparati! Haiyaaaaaaaaaaaaa!

id: \bNorman: You'd better give it your best shot. I'll do everything in my power to win!
en: \bNorman: You'd better give it your best shot. I'll do everything in my power to win!
it: \bNorman: Faresti meglio a dare il massimo. Farò tutto ciò che è in mio potere per vincere!

id: \rWinona: Witness the elegant choreography by us. Don't blink or you will regret it!
en: \rWinona: Witness the elegant choreography by us. Don't blink or you will regret it!
it: \rAlice: Ammira la nostra elegante coreografia. Non sbattere le palpebre o te ne pentirai!

id: \bTate: This combinations of ours! \rLiza: Can you beat it?
en: \bTate: This combinations of ours! \rLiza: Can you beat it?
it: \bTell: Questa nostra combinazione! \rPat: Riesci a batterla?

id: \bJuan: I guess a Coordinator could show you a trick or two today. Witness the grand illusion of water sculpted by us!
en: \bJuan: I guess a Coordinator could show you a trick or two today. Witness the grand illusion of water sculpted by us!
it: \bRodolfo: Direi che oggi un Coordinatore potrebbe mostrarti un paio di trucchi. Ammira la grande illusione d'acqua da noi scolpita!

id: \bSidney: I like that look you're giving me. I guess you'll give me a good match. Let's get down to it!
en: \bSidney: I like that look you're giving me. I guess you'll give me a good match. Let's get down to it!
it: \bFosco: Mi piace come mi guardi. Immagino che mi darai filo da torcere. Diamoci da fare!

id: \rPhoebe: Don't be afraid. Anyway, if you are looking for a challenge, see if you can hurt my friends!
en: \rPhoebe: Don't be afraid. Anyway, if you are looking for a challenge, see if you can hurt my friends!
it: \rEster: Non avere paura. Comunque, se cerchi una sfida, vediamo se riesci a ferire i miei amici!

id: \rGlacia: I wonder what are you going to show us. Bring it.
en: \rGlacia: I wonder what are you going to show us. Bring it.
it: \rFrida: Chissà cosa ci mostrerai. Fatti sotto.

id: \bDrake: For us to battle with Pokemon as partners, do you know what it takes? Do you know what is needed?
en: \bDrake: For us to battle with Pokemon as partners, do you know what it takes? Do you know what is needed?
it: \bDrake: Per lottare con i Pokémon come compagni, sai cosa serve? Sai di cosa c'è bisogno?

id: \bSteven: Give us your best shot!
en: \bSteven: Give us your best shot!
it: \bRocco: Dacci il meglio di te!

id: \bWallace: Who can most elegantly dance with their Pokemon? Who should exhibit the most graceful art in battle, you or me and my grand illusion of water?
en: \bWallace: Who can most elegantly dance with their Pokemon?  Who should exhibit the most graceful art in battle, you or me and my grand illusion of water?
it: \bAdriano: Chi sa danzare con più eleganza con i propri Pokémon?  Chi dovrebbe mostrare l'arte più aggraziata in lotta, tu o io con la mia grande illusione d'acqua?

id: \bWally: My Pokemon have given me courage and strength to fight. I have to win for their sake! So get ready!
en: \bWally: My Pokemon have given me courage and strength to fight. I have to win for their sake! So get ready!
it: \bWally: I miei Pokémon mi hanno dato il coraggio e la forza di lottare. Devo vincere per loro! Quindi preparati!

id: \rMay: Would you bring and show me all your Pokemon, in a battle with me? I'm so excited!
en: \rMay: Would you bring and show me all your Pokemon, in a battle with me? I'm so excited!
it: \rVera: Mi mostreresti tutti i tuoi Pokémon in una lotta con me? Sono così emozionata!

id: \bBrendan: You being here means that you may have faced and defeated my dad. But facing me is a different story! Here goes!
en: \bBrendan: You being here means that you may have faced and defeated my dad. But facing me is a different story! Here goes!
it: \bBrendan: Se sei qui, forse hai affrontato e sconfitto mio padre. Ma affrontare me è un'altra storia! Si comincia!

id: \bBirch: There are still many, many mysteries surrounding Pokémon. What's your secret in raising Pokemon then?
en: \bBirch: There are still many, many mysteries surrounding Pokémon. What's your secret in raising Pokemon then?
it: \bBirch: Ci sono ancora tantissimi misteri che circondano i Pokémon. Allora, qual è il tuo segreto per allenarli?

id: \bMaxie: That is why we, Team Magma, must increase the landmass of the world! Believe that this will lead to a future of eternal happiness for humanity!
en: \bMaxie: That is why we, Team Magma, must increase the landmass of the world! Believe that this will lead to a future of eternal happiness for humanity!
it: \bMax: Ecco perché noi del Team Magma dobbiamo espandere le terre emerse del mondo! Credete che questo porterà a un futuro di felicità eterna per l'umanità!

id: \bArchie: Pokémon suffer as a result of our actions. That's why I came to a decision, we, Team Aqua, will return everything to its unspoiled beginnings!
en: \bArchie: Pokémon suffer as a result of our actions. That's why I came to a decision, we, Team Aqua, will return everything to its unspoiled beginnings!
it: \bIvan: I Pokémon soffrono a causa delle nostre azioni. Per questo ho preso una decisione: noi del Team Idro riporteremo ogni cosa alle sue origini incontaminate!

id: \bRoark: This'll be rocking!
en: \bRoark: This'll be rocking!
it: \bPedro: Sarà una lotta da sballo!

id: \rGardenia: Let's get down to battle! A real quick one, OK?
en: \rGardenia: Let's get down to battle! A real quick one, OK?
it: \rGardenia: Passiamo alla lotta! Una cosa veloce, OK?

id: \rMaylene: I also take battling very seriously. Whenever you're ready!
en: \rMaylene: I also take battling very seriously. Whenever you're ready!
it: \rMarzia: Anch'io prendo le lotte molto sul serio. Quando vuoi!

id: \bCrasher Wake: Victory will be ours! Come on, let's get it done!
en: \bCrasher Wake: Victory will be ours! Come on, let's get it done!
it: \bOmar: La vittoria sarà nostra! Forza, facciamola finita!

id: \rFantina: Win I shall, non? I wish to show you battling à la danse classique.
en: \rFantina: Win I shall, non? I wish to show you battling à la danse classique.
it: \rFannie: Vincerò io, non? Voglio mostrarti la lotta à la danse classique.

id: \bByron: I'll take your challenge. I have the confidence to batter down your defense!
en: \bByron: I'll take your challenge. I have the confidence to batter down your defense!
it: \bFerruccio: Accetto la tua sfida. Ho la sicurezza necessaria per sfondare la tua difesa!

id: \rCandice: I should tell you, I'm tough, because I know how to focus. Get ready to lose!
en: \rCandice: I should tell you, I'm tough, because I know how to focus. Get ready to lose!
it: \rBianca: Ti avverto, sono tosta, perché so come concentrarmi. Preparati a perdere!

id: \bVolkner: I hope you're the one who'll make me remember how fun it is to battle.
en: \bVolkner: I hope you're the one who'll make me remember how fun it is to battle.
it: \bCorrado: Spero che sarai tu a farmi ricordare quanto è divertente lottare.

id: \bAaron: I want to become perfect, just like my bug Pokemon. Let me take you on!
en: \bAaron: I want to become perfect, just like my bug Pokemon.  Let me take you on!
it: \bAaron: Voglio diventare perfetto, proprio come i miei Pokémon Coleottero.  Ti sfido!

id: \rBertha: Well, would you show this old lady how much you've learned?
en: \rBertha: Well, would you show this old lady how much you've learned?
it: \rTerrie: Allora, vuoi mostrare a questa vecchietta quanto hai imparato?

id: \bFlint: All right, hotshot! Let's spice things up!
en: \bFlint: All right, hotshot! Let's spice things up!
it: \bVulcano: D'accordo, campione! Diamo un po' di pepe alle cose!

id: \rCynthia: There's no need for words. I, Cynthia, accept your challenge!
en: \rCynthia: There's no need for words. I, Cynthia, accept your challenge!
it: \rCamilla: Non servono parole. Io, Camilla, accetto la tua sfida!

id: \bBarry: Send out your Pokemon now! Or I am gonna fine you for 10 million!
en: \bBarry: Send out your Pokemon now! Or I am gonna fine you for 10 million!
it: \bBarry: Manda in campo i tuoi Pokémon, subito! O ti faccio una multa da 10 milioni!

id: \rDawn: Let me give you a hand, to see if you could beat me and move on!
en: \rDawn: Let me give you a hand, to see if you could beat me and move on!
it: \rLucinda: Lascia che ti dia una mano, per vedere se riesci a battermi e andare avanti!

id: \bLucas: Ready or not, let's have a go too!
en: \bLucas: Ready or not, let's have a go too!
it: \bLucas: Pronto o no, lottiamo anche noi!

id: \bRowan: Even now, I get a thrill when I'm with Pokémon, so let's begin our test on the bonds with our Pokemon.
en: \bRowan: Even now, I get a thrill when I'm with Pokémon, so let's begin our test on the bonds with our Pokemon.
it: \bRowan: Ancora oggi mi emoziono quando sto con i Pokémon, quindi diamo inizio alla nostra prova sul legame con i nostri Pokémon.

id: \bCyrus: The world must change. Then, who will change it? Me, Cyrus. And Team Galactic. I will make you regret paying heed to your heart!
en: \bCyrus: The world must change. Then, who will change it?  Me, Cyrus. And Team Galactic. I will make you regret paying heed to your heart!
it: \bCyrus: Il mondo deve cambiare. E chi lo cambierà?  Io, Cyrus. E il Team Galassia. Ti farò pentire di aver dato retta al tuo cuore!

id: \bCilan: Would you like to take part in this match against me? There's still much to learn for me.
en: \bCilan: Would you like to take part in this match against me? There's still much to learn for me.
it: \bSpighetto: Ti andrebbe di partecipare a questo incontro contro di me? Ho ancora molto da imparare.

id: \bChili: I'm going to show you what me and my blazing Pokemon can do!
en: \bChili: I'm going to show you what me and my blazing Pokemon can do!
it: \bChicco: Ti farò vedere di cosa siamo capaci io e i miei Pokémon ardenti!

id: \bCress: It shall be I and my esteemed Pokemon that you must face in battle. Would you be so kind to oblige?
en: \bCress: It shall be I and my esteemed Pokemon that you must face in battle. Would you be so kind to oblige?
it: \bMaisello: Saremo io e i miei stimati Pokémon ad affrontarti in lotta. Saresti così gentile da acconsentire?

id: \rLenora: I'm going to research how you battle with the Pokemon you've so lovingly raised. Curiosity is the spice of life!
en: \rLenora: I'm going to research how you battle with the Pokemon you've so lovingly raised. Curiosity is the spice of life!
it: \rAloé: Studierò come lotti con i Pokémon che hai cresciuto con tanto amore. La curiosità è il sale della vita!

id: \bBurgh: Ah hah! Lights' on! My Bug-type Pokemon are scurrying with excitement about getting to battle you!
en: \bBurgh: Ah hah! Lights' on! My Bug-type Pokemon are scurrying with excitement about getting to battle you!
it: \bArtemisio: Ah ah! Luci accese! I miei Pokémon di tipo Coleottero fremono all'idea di lottare contro di te!

id: \rElesa: Yes sweetie. I'm Elesa, the world famous model. Welcome to my main stage! My beloved Pokemon and your Pokemon shall compete.
en: \rElesa: Yes sweetie. I'm Elesa, the world famous model. Welcome to my main stage! My beloved Pokemon and your Pokemon shall compete.
it: \rCamelia: Sì, tesoro. Sono Camelia, la modella famosa in tutto il mondo. Benvenuto sul mio palco! I miei amati Pokémon sfideranno i tuoi.

id: \bClay: Harrumph! Kept me waitin', didn't ya, kid? So yer the Trainer they been talkin' about, huh.
en: \bClay: Harrumph! Kept me waitin', didn't ya, kid? So yer the Trainer they been talkin' about, huh.
it: \bRafan: Uff! Mi hai fatto aspettare, eh, ragazzo? Allora sei tu l'Allenatore di cui parlano tutti, eh.

id: \rSkyla: So, how about you and I have some fun?
en: \rSkyla: So, how about you and I have some fun?
it: \rAnemone: Allora, che ne dici se io e te ci divertiamo un po'?

id: \bBrycen: Receiving the support of your Pokémon makes you stronger. I'll show you this power I learned about, which is now etched in my heart.
en: \bBrycen: Receiving the support of your Pokémon makes you stronger. I'll show you this power I learned about, which is now etched in my heart.
it: \bSilvestro: Ricevere il sostegno dei tuoi Pokémon ti rende più forte. Ti mostrerò questo potere che ho imparato a conoscere e che ora è inciso nel mio cuore.

id: \rRoxie: I'm Roxie~! Listen up~! I'm gonna rock the audience right outta their seats~!
en: \rRoxie: I'm Roxie~! Listen up~! I'm gonna rock the audience right outta their seats~!
it: \rVelia: Sono Velia~! Ascoltate~! Farò saltare il pubblico dalle sedie~!

id: \bDrayden: Let's battle with everything we have: your skill, my experience, and the love we've raised our Pokemon with.
en: \bDrayden: Let's battle with everything we have: your skill, my experience, and the love we've raised our Pokemon with.
it: \bAristide: Lottiamo con tutto ciò che abbiamo: la tua abilità, la mia esperienza e l'amore con cui abbiamo cresciuto i nostri Pokémon.

id: \bMarlon: How 'bout you and I make some waves and sweep the audience away?
en: \bMarlon: How 'bout you and I make some waves and sweep the audience away?
it: \bCiprian: Che ne dici se io e te facciamo un po' d'onde e travolgiamo il pubblico?

id: \bGrimsley: What will be determined here is which of us can absorb the light and shine of this match. Let our fates begin.
en: \bGrimsley: What will be determined here is which of us can absorb the light and shine of this match. Let our fates begin.
it: \bMirton: Qui si deciderà chi di noi saprà assorbire la luce e lo splendore di questo incontro. Che il destino abbia inizio.

id: \rShauntal: Would you like to be the subject of my new novel?
en: \rShauntal: Would you like to be the subject of my new novel?
it: \rAntemia: Ti andrebbe di essere il protagonista del mio nuovo romanzo?

id: \bMarshal: It is my intention to test you. To take you to your limits of your strength. Kiai!
en: \bMarshal: It is my intention to test you. To take you to your limits of your strength. Kiai!
it: \bMarshal: È mia intenzione metterti alla prova. Portarti al limite della tua forza. Kiai!

id: \rCaitlin: Make your best effort not to bore me with a yawn-inducing battle. Clear?
en: \rCaitlin: Make your best effort not to bore me with a yawn-inducing battle. Clear?
it: \rCatlina: Fai del tuo meglio per non annoiarmi con una lotta soporifera. Chiaro?

id: \bAlder: I feel fired up when I see another trainer, and I wonder which one of us is stronger. The excitement builds to a fever pitch!
en: \bAlder: I feel fired up when I see another trainer, and I wonder which one of us is stronger. The excitement builds to a fever pitch!
it: \bNardo: Mi sento infiammare quando vedo un altro Allenatore e mi chiedo chi di noi sia il più forte. L'emozione sale alle stelle!

id: \bBenga: Hey, hey! Look at me! I want to battle with you! My Pokemon haven't been through enough!
en: \bBenga: Hey, hey! Look at me! I want to battle with you! My Pokemon haven't been through enough!
it: \bBenga: Ehi, ehi! Guardami! Voglio lottare con te! I miei Pokémon non hanno ancora fatto abbastanza esperienza!

id: \rIris: Hi! I'm Iris! People call me the girl who knows the hearts of dragons! Brace yourself! I'm going to defeat you!
en: \rIris: Hi! I'm Iris! People call me the girl who knows the hearts of dragons! Brace yourself! I'm going to defeat you!
it: \rIris: Ciao! Sono Iris! Mi chiamano la ragazza che conosce il cuore dei draghi! Preparati! Ti sconfiggerò!

id: \bHugh: Come at me with everything you got!
en: \bHugh: Come at me with everything you got!
it: \bHugh: Vieni avanti con tutto quello che hai!

id: \rHilda: This battle will be mine to win! I won't go down easy!
en: \rHilda: This battle will be mine to win! I won't go down easy!
it: \rHilda: Questa lotta la vinco io! Non mi arrenderò facilmente!

id: \bHilbert: I'm looking forward to battling against you, but let's be friends after this, ok?
en: \bHilbert: I'm looking forward to battling against you, but let's be friends after this, ok?
it: \bHilbert: Non vedo l'ora di lottare contro di te, ma dopo diventiamo amici, ok?

id: \rRosa: Would you please battle with me already? Yay hay!
en: \rRosa: Would you please battle with me already? Yay hay!
it: \rRosa: Allora, vuoi lottare con me sì o no? Evviva!

id: \rRoxanne: Hi, Roxanne here. I like to strategize before a battle, applying what I've studied until now.
en: \rRoxanne: Hi, Roxanne here. I like to strategize before a battle, applying what I've studied until now.
it: \rPetra: Ciao, sono Petra. Prima di una lotta mi piace elaborare una strategia, applicando quello che ho studiato finora.

id: \rI'm sure we have both experienced many battles, gaining immense knowledge on battling.
en: \rI'm sure we have both experienced many battles, gaining immense knowledge on battling.
it: \rSono sicura che abbiamo affrontato entrambi molte lotte, acquisendo un'enorme conoscenza in materia.

id: \bYour talent brought forth a wave of astonishment, overwhelming me. I look forward to it again. Ride on!
en: \bYour talent brought forth a wave of astonishment, overwhelming me. I look forward to it again. Ride on!
it: \bIl tuo talento ha scatenato un'ondata di stupore che mi ha travolto. Non vedo l'ora di rifarlo. Cavalca l'onda!

id: \bWattson: Aha! What a fine young soul brimming with vigor.
en: \bWattson: Aha! What a fine young soul brimming with vigor.
it: \bWalter: Ah ah! Che bell'animo giovane e pieno di vigore.

id: \rNo wonder the Pokémon that battle at my side got confused.
en: \rNo wonder the Pokémon that battle at my side got confused.
it: \rNon c'è da stupirsi che i Pokémon che lottano al mio fianco si siano confusi.

id: \rWitness the elegant choreography by us. Don't blink or you'll regret it!
en: \rWitness the elegant choreography by us. Don't blink or you'll regret it!
it: \rAmmira la nostra elegante coreografia. Non battere ciglio o te ne pentirai!

id: \rWinona: I see you're one with your Pokémon as well. I recognize your talent.
en: \rWinona: I see you're one with your Pokémon as well. I recognize your talent.
it: \rAlice: Vedo che anche tu sei tutt'uno con i tuoi Pokémon. Riconosco il tuo talento.

id: \bWe don't need to talk... \r...because we can each tell...
en: \bWe don't need to talk... \r...because we can each tell...
it: \bNon serve parlare... \r...perché ognuno di noi sa...

id: \b...what the other is thinking... \r...all in our minds!
en: \b...what the other is thinking... \r...all in our minds!
it: \b...cosa pensa l'altro... \r...tutto nella nostra mente!

id: \bTate: The bond between you and your Pokémon... \rLiza: ...was far stronger than ours. We can tell.
en: \bTate: The bond between you and your Pokémon... \rLiza: ...was far stronger than ours. We can tell.
it: \bTell: Il legame tra te e i tuoi Pokémon... \rPat: ...era molto più forte del nostro. Lo sentiamo.

id: \bSidney: They said I was a punk, but I showed them what the dark side's beauties were made of!
en: \bSidney: They said I was a punk, but I showed them what the dark side's beauties were made of!
it: \bFosco: Dicevano che ero un teppista, ma ho mostrato loro di che pasta sono fatte le bellezze del lato oscuro!

id: \bSidney: Listen to what this loser has to say. You've got a long road ahead of you, but you've got what it takes.
en: \bSidney: Listen to what this loser has to say.  You've got a long road ahead of you, but you've got what it takes.
it: \bFosco: Ascolta cos'ha da dirti questo perdente.  Hai ancora tanta strada davanti, ma hai la stoffa giusta.

id: \rPhoebe: Uh-huh... Uh-huh... Hahaha! You're right. Oh? Gimme a minute... Hi! My friend's telling me that you're looking for me.
en: \rPhoebe: Uh-huh... Uh-huh... Hahaha! You're right.  Oh? Gimme a minute... Hi! My friend's telling me that you're looking for me.
it: \rEster: Ah-ah... Ah-ah... Ahahah! Hai ragione.  Oh? Dammi un attimo... Ciao! Il mio amico mi dice che mi stai cercando.

id: \rDon't be afraid. Anyway, if you're looking for a challenge, see if you can hurt my friends!
en: \rDon't be afraid. Anyway, if you're looking for a challenge, see if you can hurt my friends!
it: \rNon avere paura. Comunque, se cerchi una sfida, vediamo se riesci a ferire i miei amici!

id: \rI'd like to see how far your bond can carry you. Don't bring us shame by losing!
en: \rI'd like to see how far your bond can carry you.  Don't bring us shame by losing!
it: \rVorrei vedere fin dove può portarti il vostro legame.  Non farci fare brutta figura perdendo!

id: \rI wonder what you're going to show me. Bring it.
en: \rI wonder what you're going to show me. Bring it.
it: \rChissà cosa mi mostrerai. Fatti sotto.

id: \rGlacia: What a relief, how fiery that was! Spirits burning so high that my icy moves pale in comparison.
en: \rGlacia: What a relief, how fiery that was! Spirits burning so high that my icy moves pale in comparison.
it: \rFrida: Che sollievo, che ardore! Uno spirito così infuocato che le mie mosse gelide impallidiscono al confronto.

id: \bSteven: You... What did you see on your journey with your Pokémon? What did you feel, meeting so many Trainers like yourself?
en: \bSteven: You... What did you see on your journey with your Pokémon? What did you feel, meeting so many Trainers like yourself?
it: \bRocco: Tu... Cos'hai visto nel tuo viaggio con i tuoi Pokémon? Cos'hai provato incontrando tanti Allenatori come te?

id: \bHey! Hey!! You'd better keep aiming higher and promise to come back and challenge me! Else I will get to the top in no time!
en: \bHey! Hey!! You'd better keep aiming higher and promise to come back and challenge me! Else I will get to the top in no time!
it: \bEhi! Ehi!! Faresti meglio a puntare sempre più in alto e a promettermi che tornerai a sfidarmi! Altrimenti arriverò in cima in un attimo!

id: \bYou're amazing. You've got the proof that you're a trainer your Pokémon can be proud of! See you!
en: \bYou're amazing. You've got the proof that you're a trainer your Pokémon can be proud of! See you!
it: \bSei straordinario. Hai la prova di essere un Allenatore di cui i tuoi Pokémon possono andare fieri! Ci vediamo!

id: \rYou've gotta do your best so that I won't be wiping you out in one sweep!
en: \rYou've gotta do your best so that I won't be wiping you out in one sweep!
it: \rDevi fare del tuo meglio, così non ti spazzerò via in un colpo solo!

id: \rJuniper: Having Pokémon battles between one another deepens the bonds between people and Pokémon. So, are you ready?
en: \rJuniper: Having Pokémon battles between one another deepens the bonds between people and Pokémon. So, are you ready?
it: \rAralia: Le lotte tra Pokémon rafforzano i legami tra le persone e i Pokémon. Allora, sei pronto?

id: \bN: Well, let me hear your Pokémon's voice! I wanna understand you. Show me!
en: \bN: Well, let me hear your Pokémon's voice! I wanna understand you. Show me!
it: \bN: Allora, fammi sentire la voce dei tuoi Pokémon! Voglio capirti. Mostrami!

id: \bGhetsis: We must liberate the Pokémon! Then, and only then, will humans and Pokémon truly be equals!!!
en: \bGhetsis: We must liberate the Pokémon! Then, and only then, will humans and Pokémon truly be equals!!!
it: \bGhecis: Dobbiamo liberare i Pokémon! Allora, e solo allora, umani e Pokémon saranno davvero uguali!!!

id: \rViola: Now come at me! I, Viola, will take you on!
en: \rViola: Now come at me! I, Viola, will take you on!
it: \rVioletta: Ora fatti sotto! Io, Violetta, ti affronterò!

id: \bGrant: I hope you'll show me that your skill as a trainer surpasses even mine.
en: \bGrant: I hope you'll show me that your skill as a trainer surpasses even mine.
it: \bLino: Spero che mi dimostrerai che la tua abilità di Allenatore supera persino la mia.

id: \rKorrina: Haha! Time for Lady Korrina's grand appearance!
en: \rKorrina: Haha! Time for Lady Korrina's grand appearance!
it: \rOrnella: Ahah! È l'ora della grande entrata in scena di Lady Ornella!

id: \bRamos: The survival of plants is a sign of their strength. Yeh sure yer up to facing all that?
en: \bRamos: The survival of plants is a sign of their strength. Yeh sure yer up to facing all that?
it: \bRamos: La sopravvivenza delle piante è segno della loro forza. Sei sicuro di poter affrontare tutto questo?

id: \bClemont: Hi! I like my Pokemon battles how i like my inventions. HIGH-VOLTAGE!
en: \bClemont: Hi! I like my Pokemon battles how i like my inventions. HIGH-VOLTAGE!
it: \bLem: Ciao! Le lotte Pokémon mi piacciono come le mie invenzioni. AD ALTA TENSIONE!

id: \rValerie: The elusive Fairies may appear frail as a breeze and delicate as a bloom, but watch out.
en: \rValerie: The elusive Fairies may appear frail as a breeze and delicate as a bloom, but watch out.
it: \rValérie: Le sfuggenti fate possono sembrare fragili come una brezza e delicate come un fiore, ma attento.

id: \rOlympia: This is a ritual to decide your fate and future. The battle begins!
en: \rOlympia: This is a ritual to decide your fate and future. The battle begins!
it: \rAstra: Questo è un rituale che deciderà il tuo destino e il tuo futuro. Che la lotta abbia inizio!

id: \bWulfric: Depending on which Pokémon you choose, I could be your most challenging opponent yet or I could be a total pushover.
en: \bWulfric: Depending on which Pokémon you choose, I could be your most challenging opponent yet or I could be a total pushover.
it: \bEdel: A seconda dei Pokémon che sceglierai, potrei essere l'avversario più difficile che tu abbia mai affrontato o un vero pivello.

id: \rMalva: I'm burning up, runt!
en: \rMalva: I'm burning up, runt!
it: \rMalva: Sto bruciando, moccioso!

id: \bSiebold: To devote yourself entirely to such a life, made up of fleeting experiences, that is truly artful.
en: \bSiebold: To devote yourself entirely to such a life, made up of fleeting experiences, that is truly artful.
it: \bNarciso: Dedicarsi interamente a una vita fatta di esperienze fugaci: questa sì che è arte.

id: \bWikstrom: Let us alll give our word that our contest shall be fair and honorable. Ready? En garde!
en: \bWikstrom: Let us alll give our word that our contest shall be fair and honorable. Ready? En garde!
it: \bTimeos: Diamo tutti la nostra parola che la nostra sfida sarà leale e onorevole. Pronto? In guardia!

id: \rDrasna: Facing you will make my Pokémon grow like weeds!
en: \rDrasna: Facing you will make my Pokémon grow like weeds!
it: \rDrasna: Affrontarti farà crescere i miei Pokémon come l'erba!

id: \rDiantha: You know, I'd really love to learn more about how a strong Trainer like you raises your Pokémon, brimming with hope for the future.
en: \rDiantha: You know, I'd really love to learn more about how a strong Trainer like you raises your Pokémon, brimming with hope for the future.
it: \rDiantha: Sai, mi piacerebbe davvero scoprire di più su come un Allenatore forte come te cresce i suoi Pokémon, colmo di speranza per il futuro.

id: \rShauna: I'm sure we're gonna be great friends. Hey! Can we see the Pokémon now? I want to meet them too!
en: \rShauna: I'm sure we're gonna be great friends. Hey! Can we see the Pokémon now? I want to meet them too!
it: \rShana: Sono sicura che diventeremo grandi amici. Ehi! Possiamo vedere i Pokémon adesso? Voglio conoscerli anch'io!

id: \bTierno: Anyway, can we have a Pokémon battle?
en: \bTierno: Anyway, can we have a Pokémon battle?
it: \bTierno: Comunque, possiamo fare una lotta Pokémon?

id: \bTrevor: I am on the journey with my Pokedex to travel high mountains and wide seas, but that doesn't mean I can't battle. Let's go!
en: \bTrevor: I am on the journey with my Pokedex to travel high mountains and wide seas, but that doesn't mean I can't battle. Let's go!
it: \bTrevor: Sto viaggiando con il mio Pokédex tra alte montagne e mari sconfinati, ma questo non vuol dire che non possa lottare. Andiamo!

id: \rSerena: Woohoo! Can't wait to see what we can do! Eeheehee, we're going to get started!
en: \rSerena: Woohoo! Can't wait to see what we can do!  Eeheehee, we're going to get started!
it: \rSerena: Evviva! Non vedo l'ora di vedere cosa sappiamo fare!  Ihihih, si comincia!

id: \bCalem: All right, let's do this. Come on, everyone!
en: \bCalem: All right, let's do this. Come on, everyone!
it: \bCalem: D'accordo, facciamolo. Forza, ragazzi!

id: \bSycamore: Let's all have a Pokémon battle!
en: \bSycamore: Let's all have a Pokémon battle!
it: \bPlatan: Facciamo tutti una lotta Pokémon!

id: \bLysandre: My desire... it is for a more beautiful world!
en: \bLysandre: My desire... it is for a more beautiful world!
it: \bElisio: Il mio desiderio... è un mondo più bello!

id: \bIlima: Behold the magnificent Pokémon of the one and only Ilima!
en: \bIlima: Behold the magnificent Pokémon of the one and only Ilima!
it: \bIlima: Ammirate i magnifici Pokémon dell'unico e inimitabile Ilima!

id: \rLana: I'm going to show you what a serious Lana can do!
en: \rLana: I'm going to show you what a serious Lana can do!
it: \rSuiren: Ti farò vedere di cosa è capace una Suiren seria!

id: \bKiawe: I hope you bring that fire with you and burn up my challenge!!
en: \bKiawe: I hope you bring that fire with you and burn up my challenge!!
it: \bKiawe: Spero che porterai quel fuoco con te e incendierai la mia prova!!

id: \rMallow: Let's get us cooking into the heat of battle!
en: \rMallow: Let's get us cooking into the heat of battle!
it: \rIbis: Mettiamoci ai fornelli nel calore della lotta!

id: \bSophecles: Um! Could you teach me some tips on confidence while battling?
en: \bSophecles: Um! Could you teach me some tips on confidence while battling?
it: \bChrys: Ehm! Potresti darmi qualche consiglio su come avere fiducia in me stesso durante le lotte?

id: \rMina: Maybe your battling skills will be a masterpiece! Let's get going!
en: \rMina: Maybe your battling skills will be a masterpiece!  Let's get going!
it: \rMina: Forse le tue abilità in lotta saranno un capolavoro!  Cominciamo!

id: \rAcerola: Maybe our battle will be one to be told in books for centuries too!
en: \rAcerola: Maybe our battle will be one to be told in books for centuries too!
it: \rAcerola: Magari anche la nostra lotta verrà raccontata nei libri per secoli!

id: \rHapu: Looks like you are going to make a fine tale for yourself. Time to get serious.
en: \rHapu: Looks like you are going to make a fine tale for yourself. Time to get serious.
it: \rHapu: Sembra che tu stia per scrivere una bella storia. È ora di fare sul serio.

id: \bNanu: Don't take it too serious now. You'll tire yourself out if you're always in a rush.
en: \bNanu: Don't take it too serious now. You'll tire yourself out if you're always in a rush.
it: \bNanu: Non prenderla troppo sul serio. Se vai sempre di fretta, finirai per stancarti.

id: \rOlivia: You can count on me, kid. Get ready for your hardest Pokémon battle yet!
en: \rOlivia: You can count on me, kid. Get ready for your hardest Pokémon battle yet!
it: \rOlivia: Puoi contare su di me, ragazzo. Preparati alla lotta Pokémon più dura che tu abbia mai affrontato!

id: \rKahili: Let's see how far we can fly. The winds of victory will blow for me and my Pokémon!
en: \rKahili: Let's see how far we can fly. The winds of victory will blow for me and my Pokémon!
it: \rKahili: Vediamo fin dove riusciamo a volare. I venti della vittoria soffieranno per me e i miei Pokémon!

id: \bMolayne: Now I've got to do what I can to keep up with the others. Let's battle!
en: \bMolayne: Now I've got to do what I can to keep up with the others. Let's battle!
it: \bMolayne: Ora devo fare il possibile per stare al passo con gli altri. Lottiamo!

id: \bHala: Old Hala here will also be going all out! Let us clash!
en: \bHala: Old Hala here will also be going all out! Let us clash!
it: \bHala: Anche il vecchio Hala darà il massimo! Scontriamoci!

id: \bHau: I wanna do all the fun stuff! Let's battle!
en: \bHau: I wanna do all the fun stuff! Let's battle!
it: \bHau: Voglio fare tutte le cose divertenti! Lottiamo!

id: \rLillie: I'll do my best so that no Pokémon have to end up getting hurt!
en: \rLillie: I'll do my best so that no Pokémon have to end up getting hurt!
it: \rLylia: Farò del mio meglio perché nessun Pokémon debba farsi male!

id: \bGladion: Battle me. I won't take no for an answer.
en: \bGladion: Battle me. I won't take no for an answer.
it: \bIridio: Lotta con me. Non accetto un no come risposta.
